About the Practice Area – Information & Communications Technologies (ICT)

ICT Advisory helps global clients drive sustainable growth through strategic consulting, market intelligence, and technology-led business transformation. It serves technology vendors, service providers, government bodies, and enterprises worldwide, delivering actionable insights that enhance competitiveness, mitigate risks, and create long-term value.

About the Role

As Senior Vice President, you will lead strategic advisory engagements, guide C-suite executives as a Growth Pipeline Coach, and drive thought leadership and business transformation. You will own the Practice Area’s strategy, revenue growth, consulting excellence, client relationships, and leadership development while expanding Frost & Sullivan’s global advisory business.

.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead strategic consulting engagements, advising C-suite executives on growth strategy, market positioning, business transformation, and emerging industry trends.

  • Champion Frost & Sullivan’s Growth Pipeline Engine (GPE), facilitating executive Growth Dialogues and identifying actionable growth opportunities.

  • Drive consulting excellence, ensuring high-quality delivery, effective resource utilisation, and strong client outcomes.

  • Build trusted relationships with senior executives, develop strategic partnerships, and lead high-value client engagements.

  • Own Practice Area strategy, revenue growth, business development, and commercial performance.

  • Develop and commercialise Growth Pipeline Advisory (GPAD), Growth Pipeline-as-a-Service (GPaaS), and differentiated consulting offerings.

  • Lead thought leadership initiatives, develop proprietary methodologies, and represent Frost & Sullivan at industry forums and executive events.

  • Mentor senior consultants, develop future leaders, and foster collaboration across practices.

Required Competencies

  • Education:Bachelor’s degree in Business, Economics, Engineering, Technology, or a related field; postgraduate qualification preferred.

  • Experience:13+ years in consulting, strategic advisory, or professional services, preferably in technology, telecommunications, or related industries.

  • Strategic & Commercial Acumen:Proven ability to drive business strategy, revenue growth, and new market opportunities.

  • Consulting & Industry Expertise:Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to translate market intelligence into actionable recommendations.

  • Executive Client Leadership:Experience advising C-suite executives, building strategic relationships, and securing high-value engagements.

  • Communication & Thought Leadership:Excellent English communication, executive presentation, and stakeholder influencing skills.

  • Practice & People Leadership:Proven ability to lead consulting teams, ensure delivery excellence, and develop future leaders.

  • Growth Mindset:Entrepreneurial, collaborative, and commercially driven, with the ability to identify emerging trends and develop innovative advisory offerings.

  • What will make you succeed at Frost & Sullivan?..

    You need to be-

    • Wildly curious and entrepreneurial
    • Committed to customer success
    • A self-starter invested in your future
    • A persuasive communicator
    • Deeply Analytical
    • Excited about Disruptive Trends

    Benefits

    • A friendly work environment with an ‘open door’ policy
    • A strong career path with growth opportunities.
    • Be part of a global team that strives for excellence, and fosters an Olympic spirit
    • Feed your intellectual curiosity by collaborating across all levels of the company across the globe
    • Global Recognition - President’s Club & Chairman’s Club Awards
    • Continuous learning and coaching
    • Flexible work policy

    About Frost & Sullivan

    Frost & Sullivan, the Transformational Growth Journey Company, has spent more than 65 years partnering with clients to develop transformational growth strategies by focusing on innovation and growth opportunities driven by disruptive technologies, mega trends, emerging markets and new business models. Today, more than ever before, companies must innovate, not only to survive, but thrive in the future. Our Growth Pipeline Management (GPM) system supports clients by identifying and evaluating new growth opportunities and serves as the foundation for continuous growth. This is your opportunity to be part of a revolutionary global team that truly inspires positive global changes by innovating to zero. Learn more about Frost & Sullivan at

raw.description:
Consensus Cloud Solutions is a publicly traded, leading digital cloud fax and interoperability solutions organization in the United States and globally, focusing on connecting and empowering healthcare providers, payers, care teams, and technology innovators to unify multiple systems that wouldn’t otherwise talk to each other. Consensus is a trailblazer in our industry and believes that data transformation will reshape the world of healthcare.

Founded over 25 years ago, Consensus leverages its technology heritage to move from simple digital documents to advanced healthcare standards (HL7/FHIR) for secure data transport, as well as Natural Language Processing (NLP) and Artificial Intelligence (AI) to convert unstructured to structured, analytics-ready data, helping users unveil information that is meaningful and actionable for better patient care.

Consensus leads the industry in data exchange solutions and we’re only getting started! With exciting new initiatives on the horizon, we are continuing our strategic expansion and we are looking to add to our diverse team of innovators.

Now is the ideal time to join us in our mission to solve healthcare’s biggest challenges, and work collaboratively with a diverse team of like-minded self-starters and partners to accomplish it.

Consensus Cloud Solutions is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive and equitable environment for all employees. We offer many remote and hybrid career opportunities.

How you will impact the organization…

The organization is seeking a pragmatic developer who understands that the landscape of software engineering is shifting. The purpose of this role is to balance leveraging AI for rapid, intuitive "Vibe Coding" with the technical discipline of "Spec-Driven Development" to build superior products. This individual must know how to utilize LLMs for creative exploration while pinning down maintainability through strict technical specifications.

The value you will deliver…

  • Hybrid Development: Transition effectively between rapid AI-assisted iteration and disciplined, manual engineering throughout the feature lifecycle.
  • Tooling Integration: Utilize Amazon Kiro as a primary driver within the AWS environment while remaining proficient in the broader ecosystem, including Cursor and GitHub Copilot.
  • System Architecture: Design and maintain modular, readable structures that AI agents work within to ensure clarity for human colleagues.
  • Prompt & Spec Engineering: Author high-quality technical prompts and formal specifications to minimize hallucination and maximize logic accuracy.
  • Code Quality Control: Act as the final auditor for all AI-assisted contributions to ensure they meet internal standards and security protocols.
  • Testing & Documentation: Employ Test-Driven Development (TDD) and write clear technical documentation to serve as the source of truth for AI tools.
  • Perform other duties and responsibilities as required, assigned, or requested. Consensus reserves the right to add or change duties at any time.

What you will bring to the table…

  • 7+ years of professional full-stack development experience.
  • Experience with Java, Python, Node.JS, and JavaScript.
  • Experience building and shipping products using AI-assisted engineering disciplines or "vibe-to-spec" workflows.
  • Pragmatic Engineering: The ability to prioritize stability and performance over speed, while still utilizing AI to accelerate the development lifecycle.
  • AI-Native Tooling Mastery: Advanced proficiency with Amazon Kiro, Cursor, and GitHub Copilot, coupled with an understanding of the broader AI-agent ecosystem.
  • Full-Stack Architecture: Strong grasp of CS fundamentals, including system design, API architecture, and database management (SQL/NoSQL).
  • Analytical Thinking: A deep-seated need to understand the "why" behind generated code; ability to debug and optimize complex logic manually.
  • Testing & Documentation: Mastery of Test-Driven Development (TDD) and the ability to write precise technical documentation that guides AI tools.
  • AWS Proficiency: General comfort navigating AWS services and managing cloud deployment pipelines.

You will stand out if you also have…

  • Experience with various AI-native agents and emerging IDEs.
  • Active involvement in the AI-engineering community or a portfolio showcasing AI-augmented projects.

Additional details…

  • Location requirements: Fully remote within the U.S. (Los Angeles or Las Vegas preferred.)
  • Travel requirements: Up to 10% travel.
  • Physical requirements: Must be able to sit for long periods, as well as, handle long periods of screen time.
  • Technology requirements: Reliable, high speed internet.
  • Eligible for sponsorship: No

The salary range for this role is $140,000 - $197,500 USD annually. The total compensation package for this position is negotiable and may also include annual performance bonus, ESPP, enhanced time off packages and benefits. This job doesn't have an expiration date and will remain open until a qualified candidate is hired.

We are not accepting agency submissions for this role.

To learn more about us visit consensus.com

raw.description:
ABOUT GREYSTAR


Greystar is a leading, fully integrated global real estate platform offering expertise in property management, investment management, development, and construction services in institutional-quality rental housing. Headquartered in Charleston, South Carolina, Greystar manages and operates over $350 billion of real estate in more than 260 markets globally with offices throughout North America, Europe, South America, and the Asia-Pacific region. Greystar is the largest operator of apartments in the United States, managing over one million units/beds globally. Across its platforms, Greystar has nearly $79 billion of assets under management, including over $34 billion of development assets and over $36.5 billion of regulatory assets under management. Greystar was founded by Bob Faith in 1993 to become a provider of world-class service in the rental residential real estate business. To learn more, visit .

JOB DESCRIPTION SUMMARY

This role applies generally accepted accounting principles (GAAP) to analyze financial information, reconcile financial statements, prepare general and standard journal entries, assist in budget development, and prepare standard accounting and financial reports for management.

JOB DESCRIPTION

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Compiles and analyzes financial information in preparation for entry into various financial statements and accounting reports, and makes appropriate journal entries for recording in the general ledger by checking calculations, reviewing basis for figures, and balancing and reconciling figures.
  • Reviews budget, revenue, expense, payroll entries, invoices, and other accounting documents, and researches and resolves discrepancies as necessary.
  • Performs bank reconciliations and wire transfers for deposit, makes mortgage payments and distributions, and ensures accuracy.
  • Maintains and coordinates accounting control procedures by analyzing revenue and expenditure trends and recommending appropriate budget levels to ensure expenditure control.
  • Analyzes and reviews accounting and financial resources for property acquisitions, dispositions, and closings and budgets and expenditures for local, state, federal, private funding, contracts, grants, and other corporate financial and accounting transactions.
  • Acts as liaison to internal and external auditors by explaining journal entries and financial transactions, providing research data and information as requested, and answering questions necessary to complete the audit in a timely manner.
  • Communicates with on-site and other property managers to assist in completing pre-close and close activities, answer questions, provide support, and ensure timely completion of accounting processes for on-time client and Company reporting.
  • Completes various financial, accounting, administrative, and other reports and analyses, and performs other duties as assigned or as necessary.

BASIC KNOWLEDGE & QUALIFICATIONS:

  • Bachelor’s/Master’s degree in Accounting, Finance, Business, or related field, from an accredited college or university.
  • 3 years of minimum relevant experience in accounting or a financial setting, with experience that demonstrates the application and usage of generally accepted accounting principles (GAAP).
  • Employment history that demonstrates the application and usage of an accounting and financial background sufficient to analyze financial data and prepare financial reports in accordance with accounting, finance, budgeting, and cost control principles.
  • Must be proactive, self-directed, highly motivated, and possess skills in time management in order to manage multiple projects simultaneously.

SPECIALIZED SKILLS:

  • Demonstrated proficiency in internet, word processing, spreadsheet, and database management programs in order to complete required reports.
  • Strong analytical skills and familiarity with financial and property management systems (Yardi, One Site, etc.).
  • Comprehensive understanding of accounting and finance best practices as well as relevant laws and regulations.

TRAVEL / PHYSICAL DEMANDS:

  • Team members work in an office or a remote work environment. No special physical demands are required.
  • Rare or occasional travel may be required to attend business meetings, training programs, or other situations necessary for the accomplishment of some or all of the daily responsibilities of this position.
  • Job demands may require long periods of sitting.

The salary range for this position is $60,000 - $70,000.


Additional Compensation:


Many factors go into determining employee pay within the posted range including business requirements, prior experience, current skills and geographical location.

  • Corporate Positions: In addition to the base salary, this role may be eligible to participate in a quarterly or annual bonus program based on individual and company performance.
  • Onsite Property Positions: In addition to the base salary, this role may be eligible to participate in weekly, monthly, and/or quarterly bonus programs.

Robust Benefits Offered*:

  • Competitive Medical, Dental, Vision, and Disability & Life insurance benefits. Low (free basic) employee Medical costs for employee-only coverage.
  • Generous Paid Time off. All new hires start with 15 days of vacation, 4 personal days, 10 sick days, and 11 paid holidays. Plus your birthday off after 1 year of service! Additional vacation accrued with tenure.
  • For onsite team members, onsite housing discount at Greystar-managed communities are available subject to discount and unit availability.
  • 6-Week Paid Sabbatical after 10 years of service (and every 5 years thereafter).
  • 401(k) with Company Match up to 6% of pay after 6 months of service.
  • Paid Parental Leave and lifetime Fertility Benefit reimbursement up to $10,000 (includes adoption or surrogacy).
  • Employee Assistance Program.
  • Critical Illness, Accident, Hospital Indemnity, Pet Insurance and Legal Plans.
  • Charitable giving program and benefits.

*Benefits offered for full-time employees. For Union and Prevailing Wage roles, compensation and benefits may vary from the listed information above due to Collective Bargaining Agreements and/or local governing authority.


Greystar will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records.


Greystar is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate in employment on the basis of race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy, sexual orientation, and gender identity), national origin, age, disability, genetic information, military or veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.


This position may be performed remotely anywhere within the United States except the state of Alaska.


Important Notice: Greystar will never request your banking details or other sensitive personal information during the interview process. Greystar does not conduct any interviews via text or messaging, and all communication will come from official Greystar email addresses (@greystar.com). If you receive suspicious requests, please report them immediately to .

November 26, 2026

raw.description:
Are you an engineering leader who has scaled a SaaS organization through managers and turned AI-assisted development into measurable results?

CXT Software provides the technology backbone for courier, route delivery, and healthcare logistics companies. Our customers run their daily physical operations on our software, so reliability, predictable delivery, and strong regression control are not optional.

We are looking for an AI-Native VP of Software Engineering to lead our engineering and SaaS operations organization end to end and to define how it builds and runs software in the AI era. You will own people, architecture, quality, delivery, production reliability, and customer outcomes. Our stack is .NET, C#, JavaScript/TypeScript, Angular, SQL, MAUI, and Azure PaaS.

Reporting to the CTO, you will shape how we build and run software with AI, verify adoption through real behavior rather than dashboards, and shape its evolution with evidence. You will be measured on quality, reliability, cycle time, predictability, and customer impact.

If you want to lead a serious engineering organization and define how it works with AI, we would love to hear from you.

Responsibilties

  • Lead, hire, and develop Directors, architects, and their teams; set and hold the hiring bar.
  • Make AI-assisted development, testing, review, and operations the way the organization works; verify adoption through real behavior, not dashboards; and coach leaders and skeptical senior engineers through the change.
  • Run engineering experiments with baselines and clear scale, modify, or stop decisions.
  • Own quality, releases, and production reliability: uptime and SLAs, on-call, incidents, security operations, and cloud cost.
  • Own architecture across our products, including legacy modernization and standards for AI-generated code.
  • Plan and deliver the roadmap with Product, raise trade-offs early, and drive customer escalations to root cause with Customer Success.

Requirements

  • Degree in Computer Science or a related field, or equivalent experience
  • 12+ years in software engineering, including 5+ years in engineering leadership and 2+ years managing managers.
  • Led a multi-team engineering organization through managers, across several products with separate codebases, including legacy modernization.
  • Led engineering for a B2B SaaS product and owned its production operations through a team: reliability, on-call, incidents, security operations, and cloud cost.
  • Uses AI coding assistants and agents in production work today, and has led their adoption across multiple teams with measured results.
  • Designed and run engineering experiments with baselines, success metrics, and clear decision criteria.
  • Hands-on experience running flow-based delivery (Kanban or similar) at scale, with CI/CD, automated testing, and release management.
  • Still reads code and reviews architecture; experience in our stack is a plus.
  • Led a remote, distributed engineering organization; professional English; regular overlap with North American business hours.

Nice to have

  • Software architect or Staff/Principal engineer background.
  • Logistics, routing, dispatch, courier, or healthcare operations software.
  • Azure managed services, infrastructure as code, SRE, SOC 2, or FinOps.
  • Integrating teams that join through acquisition, or running engineering across multiple business units.
  • Building AI-enabled product features such as embedded agents, MCP connectors, or AI vision.

Benefits

More than just perks, they're part of what makes working at CXT Software great.

  • Access to leading AI engineering tools and platforms, and a real mandate to shape how they are used across the organization.
  • 100% remote and global: live your best life wherever that may be, and never lose out on career opportunities because of it.
  • Flexible work hours: we work asynchronously and care about results and customer satisfaction, not when you're online.
  • Dedicated growth path: consistent, meaningful feedback and support toward your career goals.
  • Access to leading tools, playbooks, and technology across the Ionic portfolio.
  • Engaging community: coffee chats, happy hours, cooking classes, book clubs, and more.
CXT Software is an equal opportunity employer. This is a fully remote independent contractor engagement and is not eligible for company-sponsored employee benefit programs. We welcome applications from any country where we can lawfully engage you. If you need an accommodation during the application process, you can request it once you apply.

The Senior Stock Plan Services Associate performs advanced operational support activities for Stock Plan Services and serves as a subject matter expert (SME) in equity compensation operations, brokerage processes, and stock plan transaction workflows. This role independently processes complex transactions, resolves escalated operational issues, provides technical guidance to teammates and internal business partners, and supports operational excellence through continuous improvement and a strong control environment.

The Senior Stock Plan Services Associate partners with Operations, Supervision, Compliance, Trade Desk, Payroll, Legal, Technology, and client-facing teams to support accurate execution of stock plan activities, regulatory compliance, and a high-quality participant experience.

What You Will Do

  • Serve as a subject matter expert across Stock Plan Services operations, equity compensation processes, brokerage operations, and securities transaction workflows.

  • Perform Principal Review and acceptance of new account applications in accordance with applicable policies, procedures, and regulatory requirements.

  • Process and review complex stock plan transactions, reconciliations, operational exceptions, and participant account activity.

  • Prioritize workload across operational functions to meet established service-level commitments.

  • Provide technical guidance to associates and internal business partners on complex stock plan processes and escalated operational issues.

  • Research, resolve, review, and approve complex operational exceptions within established policies, procedures, and authority levels.

  • Support operational processing for equity compensation programs, including restricted stock units (RSUs), stock options, employee stock purchase plans (ESPPs), Rule 10b5-1 trading programs, and related stock plan events.

  • Evaluate and recommend workflow efficiencies, operational improvements, control enhancements, and risk-mitigation opportunities.

  • Support team leadership through transaction reviews, audits, reporting, quality initiatives, and operational-readiness activities.

  • Implement applicable regulatory and procedural changes within operational processes while maintaining appropriate controls.

  • Partner with Operations, Supervision, Compliance, Trade Desk, Payroll, Legal, Technology, and client-facing teams to resolve operational issues and support business initiatives.

  • Mentor associates by sharing technical knowledge, supporting training efforts, and promoting operational best practices.

  • Perform other duties as assigned.

What You Will Bring

  • Bachelor's degree in Business, Finance, or a related field; in lieu of a degree, four additional years of financial services experience.

  • Minimum of four years of financial services experience

  • FINRA Series 7 registration required.

  • FINRA Series 24 registrations required within corporate established timelines. Fully licensed candidates are preferred.

  • FINRA Fingerprinting required.

  • Advanced knowledge of stock plan administration, brokerage operations, equity compensation programs, and securities transaction processing.

  • Experience supporting operational controls, audits, compliance activities, and risk management.

  • Strong analytical, organizational, communication, and problem-solving skills, with the ability to influence without direct authority.

What Will Set You Apart

  • Experience supporting stock plan services, brokerage operations, equity compensation programs, or securities operations.

  • Experience with Pershing NetX360.

  • Certified Equity Professional (CEP) designation.

  • Direct operational experience supporting RSUs, stock options, ESPPs, and Rule 10b5-1 trading programs.

  • Experience resolving complex or escalated securities transaction and participant-account issues.

***Applicants must be authorized to work for any employer in the U.S. We are unable to sponsor or take over sponsorship of an employment visa at this time, including CPT/OPT.***

What we offer you

We offer an array of diverse and inclusive benefits regardless of where you are in your career. We believe that providing our employees with the means to lead healthy balanced lives results in the best possible work performance.

  • Medical, dental, vision and life insurance
  • Retirement savings – 401(k) plan with generous company matching contributions (up to 6%), financial advisory services, potential company discretionary contribution, and a broad investment lineup
  • Tuition reimbursement up to $5,250/year
  • Business-casual environment that includes the option to wear jeans
  • Generous paid time off upon hire – including a paid time off program plus ten paid company holidays and three floating holidays each calendar year
  • Paid volunteer time — 16 hours per calendar year
  • Leave of absence programs – including paid parental leave, paid short- and long-term disability, and Family and Medical Leave (FMLA)
  • Business Resource Groups (BRGs) – BRGs facilitate inclusion and collaboration across our business internally and throughout the communities where we live, work and play. BRGs are open to all.

Base Salary Range

$65,600.00 - $92,675.00

The salary range above shows the typical minimum to maximum base salary range for this position in the location listed. Non-sales positions have the opportunity to participate in a bonus program. Sales positions are eligible for sales incentives, and in some instances a bonus plan, whereby total compensation may far exceed base salary depending on individual performance. Actual compensation offered may vary from posted hiring range based upon geographic location, work experience, education, licensure requirements and/or skill level and will be finalized at the time of offer.

Equal opportunity employer • Drug-free workplace

We are an equal opportunity employer with a commitment to diversity. All individuals, regardless of personal characteristics, are encouraged to apply. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age (40 and over), race, color, national origin, ancestry, sex, sexual orientation, gender, gender identity, gender expression, marital status, pregnancy, religion, physical or mental disability, military or veteran status, genetic information, or any other status protected by applicable state or local law.

You must have reliable connectivity from an internet service provider that is fiber, cable or DSL internet. Other necessary computer equipment, will be provided. Futures start here. Where first steps, new friendships, and confident learners are born. At KinderCare Learning Companies, the first and only early childhood education provider recognized with the Gallup Exceptional Workplace Award, we offer a variety of early education and child care options for families. Whether it’s KinderCare Learning Centers, Champions, or Crème de la Crème, we build confidence for kids, families, and the future we share. And we want you to join us in shaping it—in neighborhoods, at work, and in schools nationwide.

Our teachers, center staff, and field leaders are the heart and soul of our business. When you join us, you’ll be directly supporting children and their education every day and experiencing the trials and triumphs that come with that responsibility. But you’ll never be alone. You’ll do it all with a village of dedicated and passionate humans who care as much about helping kids reach their highest potential as you do. The best part? Seeing the positive impact you’re making on the lives of young learners and their families—and knowing that your work matters. 

We have an exciting opportunity for a District Leader to lead and manage a portfolio of centers in a dynamic market. If you are passionate about leading and coaching others to deliver amazing experiences, the District Leader role could be for you! raw.excerpt: Thanks for your interest in Oklo!  We are searching for a Plant Process Simulation Engineer to join our engineering team.
raw.description:
Thanks for your interest in Oklo! We are searching for a Plant Process Simulation Engineer to join our engineering team. We are looking to fill this position immediately.

Position Description

Oklo is looking for an experienced process simulation engineer to be responsible for the development and ownership of the plant process simulation model for the Aurora power plant to inform design, operations, and plant dynamics.

Specific responsibilities may include:

  • Generate and own a plant process simulation model in AVEVA Process Simulation, ASPEN/HYSYS, Siemens Flomaster, or similar tool, that models and creates both transient and steady state plant performance results.
  • Iteratively model existing and future plant equipment and maintain the model as new design parameters and drawings are produced.
  • Establish automated plant model development to accelerate design decision making and inform plant economics and operations.
  • Use equipment specifications and performance results to generate and implement detailed equipment component models.
  • Work in cross disciplinary teams, including process engineering, instrumentation and control, power generation and distribution teams.
  • Generate technical documentation and reports to be included in regulatory filings and internal/external technical reports showing plant and equipment performance.

Minimum Qualifications:

  • A bachelor’s degree in chemical, mechanical, nuclear, aerospace engineering or related engineering discipline
  • At least 5 years of experience in the development or modeling of plant processes in the power generation, petroleum, chemical, or other similar industries
  • Broad familiarity with engineering principles, with strong systems engineering and operations intuition
  • Strong knowledge of plant thermodynamic cycle and process fluid modeling at an equipment and plant-level

Bonus Qualifications:

  • Experience with building power conversion system process simulation models
  • Experience with designing process systems in power or chemical industries

Competencies

We are looking for a Plant Process Simulation Engineer that is:

  • Passionate about clean energy
  • Passionate about making advanced fission a reality
  • Willing and able to learn quickly
  • Willing to think differently and do things in new ways
  • Comfortable in a fast-paced, highly iterative environment
  • Excited to think creatively, critically, and reflectively about the problems they are solving while not leaning only on what has been done before
  • Willing to propose novel and creative solutions to technical problems
  • Able to communicate technical content and results both verbally and in writing

Who you are:

A startup person: You aren't driven by titles or hierarchy, and prefer efficiency to excess process. You don't need or expect to have a lot of guidance but you enjoy working in a fast-paced team. If you prefer the culture and feel of a large organization, that is great, but you likely won’t enjoy working with us! There is plenty of important work and plenty of good opportunities with organizations like that.

Motivated: You are self-motivated. You bring an enthusiasm to the team, and imbue a sense of passion that goes beyond clocking in and clocking out. This isn’t about a fake or arbitrary “pieces of flair” mentality or lack of work-life balance! It is about being a part of the vision and feeling a part of reaching team goals.

A team-player: Oklo genuinely is a team. We aren’t about taking credit for ourselves, and we aren’t about pushing blame to others. We do incredible things because we work as a team.

An excellent communicator: We need a person who is not only technically competent but also a clear and upbeat communicator.

Creative: Being creative means that when things fall outside clear scopes or processes or problems arise without clear solutions, you are able to identify it as well as invent ways to solve a problem or fill a need without micromanagement. The successful person in this job will not only be creative, but also enjoy being creative and solving open-ended problems which may change day-by-day.

Detail-oriented: This focus is a big part of excellence, consistency, and quality. Excellent grammar and spelling matter for both good communication as well as the image of the company that we put forward.

About Oklo travel requirements:

Oklo requires remote employees to travel to headquarters (Santa Clara, CA) twice a quarter annually, based on business or team needs, including attendance at team meetings, off-sites, and other company events or gatherings. For the first two weeks of onboarding, employees are required to be in person at headquarters in Santa Clara, CA.

About Oklo compensation:

Salary: $115,000 - $150,000 base salary, performance incentives, and equity.

Oklo offers flexible time off, equity, bonuses, competitive pay, 401(k), health insurance (with employer contribution), HSA, FSA, flexible work hours, wellness credits, and other benefits.

This position may involve access to information subject to U.S. export control laws. Only applicants who meet the definition of a U.S. person under applicable laws may be eligible.

About Oklo Inc.: Oklo Inc. is developing fast fission power plants to deliver clean, reliable, and affordable energy at scale; establishing a domestic supply chain for critical radioisotopes; and advancing nuclear fuel recycling to convert nuclear waste into clean energy. Oklo was the first to receive a site use permit from the U.S. Department of Energy for a commercial advanced fission plant, was awarded fuel material from Idaho National Laboratory, and submitted the first custom combined license application for an advanced reactor to the U.S. Nuclear Regulatory Commission. Oklo is also developing advanced fuel recycling technologies in collaboration with the U.S. Department of Energy and U.S. National Laboratories.

#CHOP: Oklo’s Values
Collaboration: We go further, together. We bring diverse perspectives, listen actively, and build trust through transparency and respect. We work across disciplines, sharing ownership to turn complex challenges into shared successes.
Humility: We are team players who act for the good of the company and for the world. We are focused on our mission, not personal recognition.
Ownership: We take pride in what we do and how we do it. We are proactive in finding solutions and see tasks through to completion. We are committed to delivering on our promises to provide clean, reliable, and affordable energy.
Pathfinding: We chart new ground where no path exists by approaching challenges with curiosity, courage, and creativity while navigating ambiguity.

Candidates should be aware that employment may be contingent upon successful completion of a drug screening, and employees may be subject to drug testing at any time in accordance with company policy and applicable laws.

Recruitment Fraud Disclaimer

Oklo is aware of recent recruitment fraud attempts targeting job seekers. Please be cautious of anyone claiming to represent Oklo who does not contact you from an official Oklo email address.

All legitimate communications from our recruiting team— including application updates, interview requests, and job offers — will come exclusively from an @oklo.com email. Oklo will never ask for sensitive personal information, payments, or account credentials during the hiring process.

If you receive suspicious outreach or have concerns about the authenticity of any communication claiming to be from Oklo, please contact us through the official channels listed on our website.

Creates plans to enable Lumen's network in support of multi-gig services/products for residential and business customers. Manages the network elements and evaluates capacity utilization. Forecasts and trends bandwidth growth to produce capacity triggers for bandwidth relief. Submits projects based on capacity triggers. These activities are in support of both Inside & Outside Plant planning activities in the assigned wire centers

  • Develop electronics, fiber feeder and distribution desktop costing estimate for new residential & overbuild projects.

  • Develop planning handoff package to engineering partners.
  • Anticipate capacity requirements in the network utilizing forecast data, existing network inventory data, strategic planning data.

  • Perform other strategic planning activities including but not limited to Grants, RDOF, as business needs dictate.
  • Perform other support activities including but not limited to road moves, rehab, DSI growth & HSI augment.

Position Purpose: Serves as an individual contributor and subject matter expert responsible for supporting the day-to-day execution of the Medicare Compliance Advisory program in alignment with CMS requirements and applicable federal and state regulations. Provides trusted advisory support to business and compliance leadership by providing regulatory guidance, conducting research and analysis, tracking issues, contributing to audit readiness and supporting compliance workplan activities. This role partners closely with the Sr. Manager, Medicare Compliance Advisory, to ensure accurate interpretation of CMS requirements, timely completion of assignments, and consistent documentation of compliance risks, trends, and corrective actions.


  • Execute the Medicare Compliance Program in alignment with CMS and applicable federal and state regulations, ensuring prevention, detection, and correction of noncompliance and FWA.
  • Interprets and translates federal, state, and contractual requirements into clear, actionable compliance guidance for business stakeholders, ensuring consistent understanding and application across operations.
  • Develops and coordinates regulatory communications, including responses to inquiries, issue summaries, and disclosures, while serving as a liaison with internal stakeholders and external regulators as appropriate.
  • Supports the preparation, validation, and submission of regulatory reports, attestations, and filings, ensuring accuracy, completeness, and timeliness of all deliverables.
  • Proactively identifies compliance risks and evaluates business processes to assess exposure, provide risk stratification, and recommend mitigation strategies.
  • Leads or supports issue identification, root cause analysis, and development of corrective action plans to ensure effective and compliant resolution of identified gaps.
  • Provides subject matter expertise to audit and monitoring activities, including supporting audit scope development, testing strategies, and ongoing compliance oversight.
  • Partners with internal and external stakeholders to support audit execution, regulatory reviews, and ongoing audit readiness activities.
  • Evaluates remediation plans and validates corrective actions to ensure sustainable and compliant resolution of issues, including assessment of regulatory reporting or disclosure requirements.
  • Contributes to the development and delivery of compliance training, while mentoring stakeholders on regulatory requirements, policies, and best practices.
  • Reviews and assesses policies, procedures, and business processes to ensure alignment with regulatory and contractual requirements and organizational standards.
  • Leads or contributes to cross-functional initiatives to enhance compliance processes, drive operational efficiency, and align compliance activities with organizational objectives.
  • Monitors regulatory developments and industry trends to identify emerging risks and support continuous improvement of compliance programs.
  • Collaborates with compliance, legal, audit, and operational partners to ensure coordinated execution of compliance activities across business areas.
  • Performs other duties as assigned.
  • Complies with all policies and standards.

Education/Experience:

  • Bachelor’s degree in a related field (e.g., healthcare administration, public health, policy) or equivalent experience required. Master's Degree or Juris Doctor preferred.
  • 5+ years Compliance, regulatory, operations, or risk management within a regulated industry (e.g., healthcare, managed care, insurance, or public sector).
  • 4+ years Compliance advisory experience to include regulatory research and drafting compliance guidance, assessing risk, issue tracking, auditing / monitoring, and overseeing the development and implementation of correction action plans required.
  • 2+ years experience supporting managed care, Medicare Advantage/Part D, or Dual Eligible (DSNP) programs.
  • Foundational knowledge of Medicare regulations, including CMS guidance and compliance expectations (e.g., Parts C & D)
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills.
  • Strong analytical, organizational and documentation skills with attention to detail.
  • Ability to manage multiple assignments and meet deadlines in a fast-paced environment.
  • Certified in Healthcare Compliance (CHC) preferred.
  • Familiarity with CMS audit protocols, program audits, or monitoring activities preferred.
  • Experience working in a matrixed or cross-functional environment preferred.

About the Role

You will combine experimentation, SEO, GEO, and AEO into one growth roadmap. You will partner with the Web Developer owning technical implementation, so your focus is strategy, content, insight, and measurable growth.

Strategy and experimentation

SEO, GEO, and AEO

Analytics and insight

About Us

A proud member of the Quanta Services family of companies, Ampacity, LLC (Ampacity) delivers a forward-thinking approach to structural and electrical solutions for clean energy transition projects. From design, kitting, and installation to comprehensive electrical procurement, Ampacity specializes in expert-engineered, field-ready solutions that accelerate project timelines and maximize impact. Made up of more than 350 passionate professionals committed to simplifying complexity across the energy value chain, Ampacity empowers customers to build smarter, faster, and more efficiently­—with the most reliable technology in the industry. Headquartered in California, Ampacity maintains facilities in Mississippi, Kentucky, and Iowa, with offices in Florida, Georgia, and Vermont. Since 2014, Ampacity has delivered nearly eight gigawatts of fully engineered clean energy systems across North America.

About this Role

The Compliance Administrator at Ampacity keeps the company audit-ready year-round. You own the day-to-day work behind SOC reporting, PII and data privacy controls, NetSuite access governance, and IT general controls (ITGC): collecting evidence, tracking requests, and making sure controls operate as documented.

This is a 100% remote role.Salary Range: $70,000 - $80,000 + Discretionary Bonus + Benefits

What You'll Do

SOC Compliance (SOC 1 / SOC 2)

  • Coordinate SOC audit readiness and the annual audit cycle with control owners and external auditors
  • Maintain the control matrix, narratives, and system descriptions as processes and systems change
  • Monitor control testing, log exceptions, and track remediation to closure
  • Collect and review vendor SOC reports, documenting CUECs and exceptions

PII and Data Privacy

  • Maintain the inventory of systems that store or process PII
  • Support data classification, retention, and disposal in line with policy and regulations
  • Track privacy requests, incidents, and corrective actions through resolution

NetSuite Access Governance

  • Run periodic access reviews of NetSuite and PII-bearing systems: collect manager sign-offs and document results
  • Monitor SoD conflicts, stale or excessive access, and privileged accounts, and drive them to resolution
  • Verify joiner, mover, and leaver changes were approved and completed on time

ITGC Requests and Evidence

  • Create, assign, and track auditor and ITGC requests (PBC) across access, change management, backup and recovery, and IT operations
  • Gather evidence (screenshots, reports, tickets, approvals, populations) and check it for completeness, accuracy, and date range before submission
  • Confirm role and permission changes have proper approval and documentation

Documentation and Reporting

  • Maintain the central repository of policies, procedures, and audit artifacts, and update them on a regular schedule
  • Report status on open requests, exceptions, and remediation to leadership
  • Maintain the compliance calendar for recurring activities such as quarterly access reviews and annual policy reviews
  • This role will evolve over time with the needs of the business.

What You'll Bring

  • 2+ years in compliance, internal audit, IT audit, or risk, with a bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Information Systems, or a related field (or equivalent experience)
  • Working knowledge of SOC 1 / SOC 2, ITGC domains (access, change management, operations), and PII and data privacy basics
  • Hands-on with roles, permissions, and user administration in NetSuite or a comparable ERP
  • Able to manage many requests and deadlines at once, and comfortable working in Excel and tracking tools
  • Clear writing, and the ability to ask non-technical teams for evidence without friction

What You'll Get

  • Competitive pay and 401k — because your work should be rewarded fairly
  • Time off you'll actually use: vacation, sick days, holidays, parental, and bereavement leave
  • Full medical, dental, and vision coverage, plus extra support when you need it
  • Wellness resources to help you show up as your best self, at work and at home
  • Real room to grow — we promote from within and invest in your development

Equal Opportunity Employer

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment and will not be discriminated against on the basis of race, color, religion, national origin or ancestry, sex (including gender, pregnancy, sexual orientation, and/or gender identity), age, disability, genetic information, veteran status, and/or any other basis protected by applicable federal, state or local law.We are an Equal Opportunity Employer, including disability and protected veteran status. We prohibit all types of discrimination and are committed to providing access and equal opportunity for individuals with disabilities. We support social enterprises through an impact incubator, funded by donations and grants, and through impact investment funds financed by investment capital. Since 1997, NESsT has financed more than 309 enterprises, improving the lives of over 3.3 million people across emerging markets.

Position Overview

NESsT is seeking a detail-oriented and motivated Accounting & Finance Associate to join our team in Brazil.

The role will provide operational support for NESsT’s financial and accounting processes, helping ensure that the organization meets its compliance obligations and maintains accurate, reliable, and timely financial records.

The position reports to the Global Controller, with a secondary reporting line to the Brazil Country Director, and works closely with the CFO and Global Finance Team.

  • Coordinate with external accounting and payroll providers.

  • Excellent attention to detail and the ability to handle confidential information responsibly.

Preferred

At Arkatechture, we have a simple shared mission: to build a sustainable organization built upon three pillars: Do something meaningful, With a great team, Earning what you deserve.

Founded in 2012, Arkatechture has grown into a nationally recognized data and technology company, partnering with organizations across the fintech, AI, and financial services spaces. We combine deep industry knowledge with technical expertise to help our clients unlock the full potential of their data. Whether it’s modernizing infrastructure, building analytics platforms, or leveraging AI for smarter decision-making, we thrive at the intersection of innovation and impact.

Our team is made up of curious, collaborative, and community-minded professionals who are passionate about solving complex problems and staying ahead of what’s next in data and technology. The Position

Arkatechture is seeking a Software Engineer to join our Support Services team, supporting our Arkalytics platform and related data warehousing and analytics solutions.
This role combines software engineering, cloud operations, and customer support. You'll investigate complex production issues, develop permanent solutions, improve platform reliability, and build tools and automation that make our products better for customers and teammates alike.

You'll work closely with engineers, customers, and product experts to resolve technical challenges while continuously improving the stability, performance, and scalability of our platform.

Please send a cover letter and resume with your application. You must submit both documents to be considered for the position. We’re building a diverse team of people who care about doing meaningful work with great people. If that excites you, apply and let’s start the conversation.

To help us get to know you, please include your resume and answer the following question in the cover letter section of your application:
Describe a production issue or customer-facing technical problem you personally investigated and resolved. What was the issue, how did you troubleshoot it, what tools, logs, queries, or data did you use to identify the root cause, and what did you ultimately change or implement to resolve it? (250 words or less.)

  • Improve monitoring, alerting, logging, and operational tooling.
  • Collaborate with Support Services, Customer Success, Product, and Engineering teams to resolve customer issues efficiently.
  • Participate in Tier 2 and Tier 3 production support and shared on-call rotations.
  • Contribute to system documentation, knowledge sharing, and continuous process improvements.
  • Participate in code reviews and help maintain high engineering standards.
  • Stay current with emerging technologies and recommend improvements that enhance our platform.
  • Additional responsibilities as assigned.

Skills, Knowledge and Expertise

  • 3+ years of professional software engineering experience.
  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.
  • Proficiency developing or supporting applications in AWS.
  • Strong programming skills in Python or another object-oriented language.
  • Solid SQL skills and experience working with relational databases (Snowflake or Databricks).
  • Familiarity with REST APIs, SDKs, and command-line tools.
  • Ability to work with structured data formats such as JSON, XML, and CSV.
  • Strong troubleshooting, debugging, and root cause analysis skills in production environments.
  • Familiarity with containerized and cloud-native technologies such as Docker, ECS, Fargate, Kubernetes, or microservices is a plus.
  • Knowledge of NoSQL databases such as DynamoDB is a plus.
  • Comfort working in Linux or Unix environments.
  • Understanding of data warehousing, business intelligence, or analytics platforms.
  • Familiarity with Git, Jira, Confluence, and Slack.
  • Experience working in Agile software development environments.
  • AWS certification is preferred, or a willingness to obtain one.
  • Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines and DevOps practices is a plus.
  • Financial services industry experience is a plus.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain technical concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences.
  • A collaborative mindset, intellectual curiosity, and a passion for continuous learning.

When our values align, there's no limit to what we can achieve.

At Parexel, we all share the same goal - to improve the world's health. From clinical trials to regulatory, consulting, and market access, every clinical development solution we provide is underpinned by something special - a deep conviction in what we do.

Each of us, no matter what we do at Parexel, contributes to the development of a therapy that ultimately will benefit a patient. We take our work personally, we do it with empathy and we're committed to making a difference.

About Parexel


Parexel is a leading global clinical development partner delivering insights-driven clinical and consulting solutions to the life sciences industry. With 22,000+ employees worldwide, we partner with biopharmaceutical companies and research sites to design and deliver patient-focused clinical trials that broaden access and make research a care option for anyone, anywhere.

We work with focus, agility, and shared purpose, moving with urgency to address patient needs and accelerate the delivery of new therapies. We embrace bold thinking, adapt quickly to change, and continually raise the bar for the speed and quality of clinical research. We are expanding our team and seeking talented individuals to help drive industry-leading innovation, With Heart®.

About the Role

We are seeking a Senior Clinical Data Associate to join our team in South Africa in a remote capacity.


As a Senior Clinical Data Associate, you will support global clinical research programs by delivering high-quality data management activities across Phase I-IV clinical studies. This position plays a key role in clinical data quality, regulatory compliance, study execution, and cross-functional collaboration.


You will partner with clinical teams, statisticians, programmers, CRAs, vendors, and study management teams to ensure accurate and timely data collection, review, reconciliation, and database management activities. Responsibilities include supporting and leading data management activities, coordinating Electronic Data Capture (EDC) systems, developing study documentation, and contributing to database lock and study deliverables.


You will join a fast-paced, growth-oriented environment dedicated to a single sponsor and supporting important commercial and development programs worldwide. This role offers the opportunity to contribute directly to clinical research that advances new therapies while expanding your expertise across data management processes, clinical technologies, and cross-functional study operations.


Key Responsibilities


  • Lead a small clinical study or co-lead larger studies with moderate guidance.
  • Support multiple clinical studies while ensuring high standards of data quality and delivery.
  • Manage and monitor data management activities performed by CROs and external vendors.
  • Review study protocols and evaluate data capture requirements, including electronic Case Report Form (eCRF) design.
  • Collaborate with CRAs, programmers, study managers, and statisticians to develop annotated eCRFs and CRF completion guidelines.
  • Develop data edit check specifications and generate study data listings as required.
  • Coordinate the design, testing, and issue resolution of Electronic Data Capture systems in accordance with company standards.
  • Develop and maintain study Data Management Plans and supporting documentation
  • Perform query management, external data reconciliations, and Serious Adverse Event reconciliation activities.
  • Support database upgrades, migrations, user acceptance testing, database freeze activities, and database lock activities.
  • Maintain study workbooks and data management files while ensuring inspection readiness.
  • Contribute to the development and improvement of data management SOPs, work instructions, and process documentation.

Candidate Profile


You'll thrive in this role if you bring:


  • Strong attention to detail, analytical thinking, and organizational skills.
  • Experience working within clinical research and regulated pharmaceutical or biotechnology environments.
  • The ability to collaborate effectively across multidisciplinary teams as well as with external partners and vendors.
  • A patient-focused mindset with a commitment to data quality and regulatory compliance.
  • Comfort working with Electronic Data Capture systems, clinical databases, and multiple technology platforms.

Required Qualifications


  • Bachelor's Degree in a scientific or healthcare-related field.
  • At least five years' experience in Data Management within the pharmaceutical or biotechnology industry.
  • Understanding of Phase I-IV clinical studies and demonstrated ability to perform core Data Management activities and work with vendors.
  • Knowledge of ICH/FDA guidance, CDISC standards, GCDMP, 21 CFR Part 11, MedDRA, WHO Drug Dictionaries, and related industry standards.
  • Experience with Electronic Data Capture systems and clinical data management technologies. RAVE experience is strongly preferred.
  • Strong communication, organization, technical, and problem-solving skills.

Preferred Qualifications


  • Experience in Oncology or CNS therapeutic areas.
  • Experience supporting Phase III pivotal studies.

Benefits and Compensation


  • Medical Aid Contribution
  • Gap Cover
  • Life Assurance
  • Provident Fund (8%)
  • 13th Cheque

If this job does not sound like the next step in your career, but perhaps you know someone who would be a perfect fit, send them the link to apply.


We believe in flexibility, growth, and creating space for people to do their best work. Join us and be part of a team where your contributions help shape the future of clinical research.

Experienced CRA Germany - client dedicated

Syneos Health® is a leading fully-integrated life sciences services organization built to accelerate customer success. We partner with innovators at every point across the drug development and commercialization continuum, helping them navigate complexity, anticipate change and accelerate progress.

Our Clinical Solutions team members act with a drug development mindset, applying their years of experience and deep expertise to truly understand customer needs and represent those in the solutions we shape.

Whether you join us in a Functional Service Provider partnership or a Full-Service environment, you’ll collaborate with passionate problem solvers, innovating as a team to help our customers achieve their goals. We are agile and driven to deliver – for one another, our customers, and, most importantly, for those in need.

Discover what your 25,000 future colleagues already know:

Why Syneos Health

• We are passionate about developing our people, through career development and progression; supportive and engaged line management; technical and therapeutic area training; peer recognition and total rewards program.
• We are committed to building an inclusive culture – where you can authentically be yourself. Central to this is our purpose – Driven to Deliver – which captures the passion of our colleagues to show up each day and shape solutions that have the ability to dramatically impact someone’s life.
• We are continuously building the company we all want to work for and our customers want to work with. Why? Because we know that when we bring together smart colleagues from across the world, we can shape the future of healthcare, driving impact for customers and defining the pace of patient progress.

Job Responsibilities


  • Performs site qualification, site initiation, interim monitoring, site management activities and close-out visits (performed on-site or remotely) ensuring regulatory, ICH-GCP and/or Good Pharmacoepidemiology Practice (GPP) and protocol compliance. Uses judgment and experience to evaluate overall performance of site and site staff and to provide recommendations regarding site-specific actions; immediately communicates/escalates serious issues to the project team and develops action plans. Maintains a working knowledge of ICH/GCP Guidelines or other applicable guidance, relevant regulations, and company SOPs/processes.
  • Verifies the process of obtaining informed consent has been adequately performed and documented for each subject/patient, as required/appropriate. Demonstrates diligence in protecting the confidentiality of each subject/patient. Assesses factors that might affect subject/patient’s safety and clinical data integrity at an investigator/physician site such as protocol deviation/violations and pharmacovigilance issues.
  • Per the Clinical Monitoring/Site Management Plan (CMP/SMP): Assesses site processes. Conducts Source Document Review of appropriate site source documents and medical records. Verifies required clinical data entered in the case report form (CRF) is accurate and complete. Applies query resolution techniques remotely and on site, and provides guidance to site staff as necessary, driving query resolution to closure within agreed timelines. Utilizes available hardware and software to support the effective conduct of the clinical study data review and capture. Verifies site compliance with electronic data capture requirements.
  • May perform investigational product (IP) inventory, reconciliation and reviews storage and security. Verifies the IP has been dispensed and administered to subjects/patients according to the protocol. Verifies issues or risks associated with blinded or randomized information related to IP. Applies knowledge of GCP/local regulations and organizational procedures to ensure IP is appropriately (re)labelled, imported and released/returned.
  • Routinely reviews the Investigator Site File (ISF) for accuracy, timeliness and completeness. Reconciles contents of the ISF with the Trial Master File (TMF). Ensures the investigator/physician site is aware of the requirement of archiving essential documents in accordance with local guidelines and regulations.
  • Documents activities via confirmation letters, follow-up letters, trip reports, communication logs, and other required project documents as per SOPs and Clinical Monitoring Plan/Site Management Plan. Supports subject/patient recruitment, retention and awareness strategies. Enters data into tracking systems as required to track all observations, ongoing status and assigned action items to resolution.
  • For assigned activities, understands project scope, budgets, and timelines; manages site-level activities / communication to ensure project objectives, deliverables and timelines are met. Must be able to quickly adapt to changing priorities to achieve goals / targets.
  • May act as primary liaison with study site personnel, or in collaboration with Central Monitoring Associate. Ensures all assigned sites and project-specific site team members are trained and compliant with applicable requirements
  • Prepares for and attends Investigator Meetings and/or sponsor face to face meetings. Participates in global clinical monitoring/project staff meetings (inclusive of Sponsor representation, as applicable) and attends clinical training sessions according to the project specific requirements.
  • Provides guidance at the site and project level towards audit readiness standards and supports preparation for audit and required follow-up actions.
  • Maintains a working knowledge of ICH/GCP Guidelines or other applicable guidance, relevant regulations, and company SOPs/processes; completes assigned training as required.

Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree or RN in a related field or equivalent combination of education, training and experience
  • Knowledge of Good Clinical Practice/ICH Guidelines and other applicable regulatory requirements
  • Previous monitoring experience in Germany required, in the full DACH region preferred.
  • Must demonstrate good computer skills and be able to embrace new technologies
  • Excellent communication, presentation and interpersonal skills
  • Fluency in German and English
  • Ability to manage required travel for monitoring visits in Austria, Germany and Switzerland.

Get to know Syneos Health

Over the past 5 years, we have worked with 94% of all Novel FDA Approved Drugs, 95% of EMA Authorized Products and over 200 Studies across 73,000 Sites and 675,000+ Trial patients.

No matter what your role is, you’ll take the initiative and challenge the status quo with us in a highly competitive and ever-changing environment. Learn more about Syneos Health.

About the Role

We’re looking for a highly operational, agile Digital Marketing Producer to manage production for a dynamic, global marketing website and app experience on behalf of the client, a world-class technology organization. You’ll join a fast-paced team focused on scaling the client’s digital presence at an ambitious level.

This is a production role at its core. You’ll own deliverables, timelines, and coordination across website marketing projects, site updates, product updates, and app content. Partnering closely with Marketing, Creative, GTM, Legal, SEO, UI/UX, and Dev teams, you’ll serve as the central operational hub, making sure global product launches and major brand moments come to life on time and exactly as intended.

The ideal candidate is a decisive, hands-on producer with a bias to action who moves with urgency and purpose. You’re comfortable managing many high-velocity projects at once, thrive in ambiguous and fast-changing environments, and know how to keep every stakeholder aligned on launch readiness.

What Sets This Role Apart

The client operates at an exceptional pace, and this person needs to match that energy from day one. You’ll be expected to:

  • Move fast, with tight timelines and high stakes across simultaneous workstreams
  • Be proactive with a positive attitude
  • Handle complexity at scale, juggling many overlapping projects with grace and precision
  • Stay hands-on, from uploading creative assets to running QA checklists
  • Use AI tools as a real part of your daily workflow, not just a curiosity

What You’ll Do

  • Act as “air traffic control” for website marketing projects, product page updates, site updates, and app store content updates, setting priorities and keeping every project moving
  • Must have CMS experience.
  • Own deliverables and schedules end to end, keeping trackers updated as projects evolve
  • Coordinate the upload and maintenance of final creative and copy across the website and app, working closely with internal creative teams and agency partners
  • Manage the ticket pipeline with the dev vendor, making sure tickets and project trackers stay accurate and serve as the source of truth
  • Lead pre-launch QA, including link checks, deeplinks, and UTM tracking, so every launch is fully ready
  • Drive cross-functional alignment across meetings, chat spaces, and email threads; triage inbound requests and keep approvals moving
  • Use AI tools and automation to streamline repetitive tasks, speed up production cycles, and find smarter ways to work

What We’re Looking For

  • 5-7 years of experience in digital production, marketing production, or marketing operations
  • Proven track record as a producer in a fast-paced, ambiguous, agile environment, at scale
  • Ability to manage many complex projects at once without losing momentum, quality, or stakeholder trust
  • Strong project management skills: organized, detail-oriented, and great at staying on top of deliverables
  • Exceptional communication skills and the ability to be the operational hub for cross-functional teams so nothing falls through the cracks
  • AI fluency, with hands-on experience using tools like generative AI assistants and automation platforms to work more efficiently
  • A doer mindset; you build momentum rather than create bottlenecks
  • Experience working with big brands or top agencies. A mixture of big tech and startup would be ideal
  • Working familiarity with CMS platforms, ticketing workflows, and web tracking (UTMs, deeplinks)

Nice to Have

  • Marketing background with a solid understanding of web best practices and user journeys
  • Experience in large, matrixed enterprise or tech organizations with many stakeholders

Overview

Adastra is seeking a Lead SAS/Python Developer to support a large-scale modernization initiative focused on migrating legacy SAS-based workloads to Anaconda/Python. In this role, you will provide technical leadership for SAS decommissioning and migration activities, while remaining hands-on in application migration, automation development, governance activities, and modernization of analytical processes. You will work across technical and business teams to lead the migration or retirement of active SAS workloads, establish development standards, guide technical implementation, and ensure the scalability, reliability, and maintainability of analytical solutions.

Primary Location: Across Canada or USA (must be able to work Central (CST) hours)

Work Model: Fully Remote

Employment Type: Contractor or Full-Time

Vacancy Status: New

RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Provide technical leadership and hands-on development throughout SAS-to-Python migration and modernization initiatives
  • Analyze complex business and technical requirements to design scalable solutions and define technical approaches
  • Lead the interpretation and migration of SAS programs, datasets, and processes to Python-based environments
  • Develop, test, and maintain high-quality Python applications and scripts
  • Build and support Unix-based automation and data processing pipelines
  • Establish and promote development standards, coding best practices, and reusable patterns across the team
  • Conduct code and technical design reviews and provide guidance to developers
  • Optimize applications for performance, scalability, reliability, and maintainability
  • Identify technical risks, dependencies, and migration challenges and drive solutions through to resolution
  • Maintain technical documentation and source code repositories using Git
  • Collaborate with business stakeholders, developers, infrastructure teams, and other technical partners to deliver migration and modernization objectives
  • Act as a technical point of contact for development and migration activities, supporting technical decision-making across the initiative

QUALIFICATIONS, SKILLS & EXPERIENCE

  • Senior/Lead-level software development experience, including demonstrated experience providing technical leadership within complex development or modernization initiatives
  • Strong hands-on expertise in Python, including Anaconda, as well as SQL and SAS
  • Strong ability to understand, interpret, and modernize complex SAS programs and workflows
  • Experience with relational databases, including Netezza and Redshift
  • Strong Linux/Unix scripting experience
  • Experience with CRON scheduling and automation
  • Strong experience with unit testing, debugging, code optimization, and performance tuning
  • Experience conducting code reviews, establishing development standards, and guiding other developers on technical implementation
  • Ability to own technical solutions from requirements and design through development, testing, and implementation
  • Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to communicate technical concepts and recommendations to both technical and business stakeholders
  • Ability to collaborate effectively across technical and business teams
  • Commitment to code quality, accuracy, maintainability, and continuous improvement
  • Ability to work within CST hours is preferred

NICE TO HAVE

  • Familiarity with GitHub and GitHub Copilot
  • Working knowledge of SAS Enterprise Guide
  • Working knowledge of JupyterHub
  • Previous experience leading or supporting large-scale SAS-to-Python migration or SAS decommissioning initiatives
  • Experience mentoring or providing technical direction to development teams

Adastra is a global leader in AI and data-driven transformation, helping organizations lead with artificial intelligence—responsibly, strategically, and at scale. With over 25 years of experience, Adastra empowers enterprise clients to unlock business value through data innovation, operational excellence, and smart customer engagement.

Trusted by some of the world’s most prominent brands, Adastra delivers end-to-end solutions grounded in thoughtful strategy, robust governance, and deep technical expertise. From defining vision to ensuring execution, Adastra guides organizations through every stage of their AI, data and cloud journey—building future-ready capabilities and delivering measurable, lasting impact.

Adastra serves clients across key industries including financial services, automotive, manufacturing, technology, media and telecom (TMT), healthcare, retail, and professional services. The company employs more than 2,000 professionals across North America, Europe, and Asia.

  • Competitive compensation
  • Successful referral program
  • The opportunity to work with one of Canada’s 50 Best Managed Companies
  • Satisfaction of working for a reputable company
  • A flexible, dynamic, and diverse workplace

Bright Vision Technologies is a technology consulting and software development company delivering cloud, AI, data, and enterprise solutions across the United States.

Job Title: PeopleSoft Technical Consultant

Salary Range: $100,000–$150,000 Annually
Experience Required: 6+ years

Sponsorship: U.S. Citizens, Green Card Holders, EAD Holders, and H-1B transfer candidates are encouraged to apply. We are unable to sponsor new H-1B visa petitions for this position.

Job Summary
We are seeking an experienced PeopleSoft Technical Developer to design, develop, and support customizations, integrations, and enhancements for enterprise PeopleSoft applications including HCM, FSCM, and Campus Solutions. In this role you will own the technical implementation of business requirements, partner closely with functional consultants, and ensure that all custom developments meet enterprise standards for quality, security, and maintainability. The ideal candidate will combine deep hands-on experience with PeopleTools development, Application Engine, Component Interfaces, and Integration Broker with a strong understanding of PeopleSoft architecture, upgrades, and clean-customization principles.

Key Responsibilities
  • Design and develop PeopleSoft customizations using Application Designer, including pages, components, records, fields, and PeopleCode.
  • Build Application Engine programs for batch processing, data conversion, and ETL-style workloads.
  • Develop Component Interfaces, Integration Broker services, and File Layouts to integrate PeopleSoft with internal and external systems.
  • Build SQR and BI Publisher reports, including performance tuning and complex layout design.
  • Implement and maintain PeopleSoft Approval Workflow Engine (AWE) configurations and notifications.
  • Develop nVision reports for financial reporting requirements where applicable, applying disciplined engineering practices and partnering closely with stakeholders to ensure outcomes are durable, well-documented, and aligned with broader team and platform standards.
  • Conduct fit-gap analysis with functional consultants and translate requirements into clean technical designs.
  • Adhere to enterprise customization standards and minimize core modifications to ease future PeopleSoft upgrades.
  • Lead unit testing, support functional and integration testing, and resolve defects during UAT and hypercare.
  • Optimize SQL performance against PeopleSoft data models using explain plans, indexing, and statistics tuning.
  • Document technical designs, code, and operational procedures in line with enterprise PeopleSoft governance.
  • Provide hands-on post-go-live and hypercare support, working closely with operations teams to triage incidents quickly, identify root causes, and drive durable fixes that improve long-term system stability.
  • Mentor junior PeopleSoft developers and act as a technical reference.
Required Qualifications
  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical discipline.
  • Five or more years of PeopleSoft technical development experience.
  • Strong hands-on experience with PeopleTools, Application Designer, and PeopleCode.
  • Solid experience with Application Engine, Component Interfaces, and Integration Broker.
  • Hands-on experience with SQR and BI Publisher.
  • Strong SQL skills and experience with the PeopleSoft data model.
  • Familiarity with PeopleSoft HCM, FSCM, or Campus Solutions data structures.
  • Experience supporting PeopleSoft upgrades and patches.
  • Working knowledge of Approval Workflow Engine (AWE).
  • Excellent troubleshooting, communication, and documentation skills.
Preferred Qualifications
  • PeopleSoft certifications.
  • Experience with Oracle Cloud HCM/ERP integration scenarios.
  • Exposure to Fluid UI development.
  • Familiarity with Oracle DBA fundamentals.
  • Experience with Oracle Integration Cloud (OIC) for PeopleSoft integrations.
