Job Summary

The Senior Salesforce Business Analyst serves as a key liaison between university business partners and technical teams responsible for Salesforce and related enterprise solutions. This position develops a broad understanding of business objectives, processes, stakeholder needs, data requirements, and existing system capabilities and translates those needs into clearly defined business and functional requirements that enable effective technology solutions. The Senior Salesforce Business Analyst works with stakeholders to analyze complex business problems and opportunities, facilitate discovery and requirements sessions, document current- and future-state processes, identify gaps, evaluate solution alternatives, develop user stories and acceptance criteria, and support solution design and implementation. The position provides guidance regarding Salesforce capabilities and helps business partners distinguish business requirements from proposed technical solutions to ensure that solutions align with university priorities, enterprise architecture, data governance, security, usability, and long-term maintainability. This position participates in and may lead business analysis activities for projects and product enhancements throughout the solution lifecycle, including discovery, requirements definition, prioritization, solution validation, testing, implementation, and post-implementation evaluation.

The Senior Salesforce Business Analyst partners closely with product owners, Salesforce administrators, architects, developers, integration teams, data teams, project managers, and university stakeholders to ensure requirements are understood, traceable, testable, and successfully delivered. As a senior professional contributor, this position independently manages complex assignments, facilitates decision-making among diverse stakeholder groups, identifies risks and dependencies, recommends and makes moderate to significant improvements to business processes and Salesforce capabilities, and may coach or review the work of less experienced professionals.

What We're Looking For

Education and Experience Required:

  • Bachelor's degree in business, information technology, computer science, or related fields
  • Minimum of four (4) years of experience performing business analysis, systems analysis, business process analysis, product analysis, or comparable work involving the translation of business needs into technology solutions
  • Must be a US Citizen or have a Permanent Residency Card
  • In lieu of degree, consideration will be given to an equivalent combination of related education and work experience

Demonstrated experience:

  • eliciting, analyzing, documenting, validating, and managing business and functional requirements
  • facilitating requirements gathering and discovery sessions with stakeholders
  • translating complex business needs into user stories, functional requirements, and testable acceptance criteria
  • analyzing and documenting current- and future-state business processes
  • working with technical teams throughout the solution development lifecycle
  • coordinating or supporting user acceptance testing and solution validation
  • communicating complex business and technical concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences

Preferred

  • Three (3) or more years of experience working within a Salesforce ecosystem
  • Additional Salesforce certifications or demonstrated Salesforce platform expertise
  • Salesforce Business Analyst certification
  • Experience:
    • as a Salesforce Business Analyst, CRM Business Analyst, Product Analyst, or comparable role
    • supporting Salesforce implementations, enhancements, platform products, releases, or integrations
    • working with Agile or hybrid product/project delivery methodologies
    • with Jira, Azure DevOps, or comparable backlog and requirements-management tools
    • with business-process modeling and process-improvement methodologies
    • with enterprise data integrations and ERP, student information, identity, marketing, or other enterprise platforms
    • working in higher education or another complex, decentralized organization

Skills Needed

  • Advanced business analysis and requirements-management skills
  • Ability to:
    • distinguish a business requirement from a proposed technical solution and guide stakeholders toward clearly defining the underlying business need
    • translate business objectives and processes into clear, actionable, and testable requirements, user stories, and acceptance criteria
    • manage multiple priorities and assignments with limited supervision
    • identify assumptions, dependencies, constraints, risks, and gaps and communicate their potential impacts
    • work effectively as part of a high-performing cross-functional team
    • adapt to changing business priorities and technology capabilities while maintaining focus on customer and organizational outcomes
    • perform gap analysis and develop practical solution alternatives and recommendations
    • evaluate solution alternatives based on business value, feasibility, risk, usability, maintainability, dependencies, and organizational impact
    • create clear process documentation, diagrams, requirements, presentations, decision documentation, and other business-analysis artifacts
  • Strong:
    • business-process analysis skills, including the ability to document and evaluate current- and future-state processes
    • professional judgment, integrity, accountability, collaboration, and commitment to continuous improvement Strong verbal and written communication skills with the ability to communicate effectively with technical professionals, operational staff, managers, and senior stakeholders
    • stakeholder-management and influencing skills, including the ability to facilitate resolution when stakeholder priorities or requirements conflict
    • facilitation skills and demonstrated ability to lead requirements workshops, discovery sessions, process reviews, and stakeholder discussions
  • Working knowledge of Salesforce CRM concepts, functionality, data structures, security concepts, automation, reporting, and integration patterns sufficient to effectively partner with Salesforce technical professionals
  • Demonstrated:
    • analytical, critical-thinking, problem-solving, and decision-support capabilities
    • ability to independently analyze complex business problems involving multiple processes, systems, stakeholder groups, and organizational dependencies

Preferred

  • Knowledge of:
    • Salesforce platform capabilities and limitations across CRM-related products
    • Agile business analysis practices, backlog management, user-story development, and refinement
    • data governance, data quality, privacy, security, and stewardship principles
  • Experience with:
    • process-modeling techniques and tools
    • dataflow, data-mapping, or integration-requirement analysis
    • defining reporting, analytics, and key performance indicator requirements
    • performing change-impact analysis and supporting organizational change and user adoption
    • mentoring or reviewing the work of junior analysts

raw.description:
About Life360

Life360’s mission is to keep people close to the ones they love. Our category-leading mobile app, Tile tracking devices, and Pet GPS tracker empower members to protect the people, pets, and things they care about most with a range of services, including location sharing, safe driver reports, and crash detection with emergency dispatch. Life360 serves approximately 102.4 million monthly active users (MAU), as of June 30, 2026, across more than 180 countries.

Life360 delivers peace of mind and enhances everyday family life with seamless coordination for all the moments that matter, big and small. By continuing to innovate and deliver for our customers, we have become a household name and the must-have mobile-based membership for families (and those friends who are basically family).

Life360 has more than 500 (and growing!) remote-first employees. For more information, please visit .

Life360 is a Remote First company, which means a remote work environment will be the primary experience for all employees. All positions, unless otherwise specified, can be performed remotely (within the US and Canada) regardless of any specified location above.

We are AI Native

We are building an AI native company where AI is an integral part of how we build and operate. AI tool usage during interviews varies by role. You may be asked to demonstrate proficiency with AI tools, discuss how you leverage AI, or complete interview exercises without AI assistance. Your Recruiter will provide clear guidance as you move through the interview process.

Undisclosed use of AI not previously discussed with or approved by your Recruiter may impact your candidacy.

About The Team

As you'd expect from a company obsessed with keeping families connected, the eCommerce team moves fast and takes the member experience seriously – because a clunky flow is its own kind of broken promise. Sitting inside Journey Marketing, we're a mix of merchandisers, marketers, data folks, and designers who all care about the same thing: turning every member touchpoint — from first website or app visit — into long-term loyalty and lasting relationships. From the online store to in-app purchases to wherever commerce shows up next, this team builds the experience that turns interest into purchase. If you like owning outcomes, thinking in systems, and turning "maybe" into "yes" at scale, you'll fit right in.

About the Job

At Life360, our web experience is one of the most important drivers of device sell-through and subscription growth. Making smart decisions about that experience requires performance visibility – always knowing what's happening on the site, where customers are dropping off, and why.

The Site Optimization Manager drives continuous improvement of Life360's digital commerce experience through experimentation, behavioral analysis, and data-driven optimization. You'll manage the day-to-day execution of our web experimentation and personalization programs, translating customer insights and performance data into measurable improvements in conversion, engagement, and revenue.

This is a hands-on role for someone who combines analytical rigor with strong technical execution. You'll identify opportunities, develop hypotheses, build and launch experiments, and translate results into actionable recommendations. Working closely with Web Experience, Analytics, Product, Engineering, and Merchandising, you'll help accelerate our optimization roadmap and build a scalable culture of experimentation.

For candidates based in the US, the salary range for this position is $121,000 to $178,500 USD. For candidates based out of Canada, the salary range for this position is 141,000 to 165,000 CAD. We take into consideration an individual’s background, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience in determining final salary. Base pay may also vary based on geographic location, with US work locations falling into one of three geographic tiers.

Total compensation is inclusive of equity compensation in the form of Restricted Stock Units (RSUs), as well as a comprehensive benefits package, including medical, dental, vision, financial, and other benefits.

What You’ll Do

  • Monitor site performance continuously, surfacing regressions, anomalies, and emerging trends proactively — bringing a diagnosis with business context and recommended next action alongside every flag, not just the data.
  • Identify conversion optimization opportunities by synthesizing quantitative funnel data with qualitative signals — session recordings, heatmaps, and usability findings — to understand where and why customers experience friction and prioritize opportunities for improvement.
  • Partner with Analytics to define measurement requirements, ensure visibility into key site performance KPIs, and leverage dashboards tracking CVR, funnel step drop-off, AOV, and session quality across key web surfaces and conversion flows.
  • Own the day-to-day operation of Life360's web A/B and multivariate testing program, including test scoping, configuration, builds, QA, traffic allocation, and post-test documentation, ensuring experiments are instrumented correctly and results are interpreted with statistical rigor.
  • Maintain and groom the live experiment backlog in partnership with the Director, ensuring tests are scoped clearly, sequenced logically, and launched on time.
  • Analyze test results with rigor in partnership with Analytics, evaluating statistical significance, sizing revenue impact, and producing clear readouts that drive confident go/no-go decisions and inform future optimization opportunities.
  • Manage personalization campaign operations — maintaining segment-to-experience workflows, coordinating with UX/UI and Merchandising on creative, and tracking lift versus baseline for each active experience.
  • Partner with Digital Product, Engineering, Marketing, and Analytics on experimentation platform configuration, feature flag governance, event instrumentation QA, and tagging validation.
  • Support hands-on site optimization execution across experimentation, personalization, and content updates, leveraging CMS, commerce platforms, and no-code/low-code tools to implement and QA experiences where appropriate.
  • Translate performance insights into actionable recommendations, partnering with Analytics on reporting and contributing optimization findings, experiment outcomes, and prioritized opportunities to weekly and monthly business reviews.
  • Contribute to the financial modeling process by sizing expected lift for proposed tests and reconciling actuals to projections post-launch.
  • Document experimentation best practices, maintain the team's testing Confluence, and help build institutional knowledge around what works on Life360's web properties.

What We’re Looking For

  • 4–6 years of experience in eCommerce or digital analytics, with at least 2 years of hands-on ownership of an experimentation program in a fast-paced commercial environment. Ideally within a hardware + subscription business.
  • Proficiency with Statsig preferred or equivalent experimentation platform (Optimizely, VWO, Adobe Target, Dynamic Yield, etc) – you've built and QA'd tests yourself, not just read the reports.
  • Familiarity with headless commerce architectures, content management systems (CMS), and modern eCommerce platforms such as BigCommerce and Contentful. Comfortable navigating the technical dependencies of site changes, experimentation, and personalization across commerce and content platforms.
  • Strong analytical foundation – you're fluent in GA4, Amplitude, or a comparable analytics platform, can write SQL to pull your own data, and are comfortable building and maintaining dashboards in Looker, Tableau, or similar tools. You understand the statistics behind experimentation well enough to push back when a test is being called too early.
  • Experience with personalization tools and segment-based targeting; familiarity with how audience definitions, traffic splits, and experience variants are configured in practice.
  • Experience leveraging AI-powered tools to accelerate analysis, identify customer behavior patterns, generate and refine experimentation hypotheses, and improve operational efficiency. Curious about emerging AI capabilities and how they can be applied to digital experience optimization.
  • Detail-oriented operator with strong project management instincts — you can run multiple tests simultaneously, keep stakeholders informed, and maintain clean documentation without being asked.
  • Collaborative working style with the ability to partner effectively with Product, Engineering, UX/UI, Site Merchandising, and Analytics teams.
  • Clear communicator who can translate performance data into plain-language insights for non-technical stakeholders.
  • Curiosity-driven: you follow the data wherever it leads, ask good questions, and treat every test as an opportunity to learn something about the customer.
  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent.

Our Benefits

  • Medical, dental, vision, life and disability insurance plans (100% paid for US employees). We offer life and disability as well as supplemental plans for medical and dental for Canadian employees.
  • 401(k) plan with company matching program in the US and RRSP with DPSP plan for Canadian employees.
  • Paid parental leave.
  • Mental Wellness Program & Employee Assistance Program (EAP) for mental well-being.
  • Generous time off: flexible PTO, companywide holidays throughout the year plus summer and winter shutdowns.
  • Learning & Development programs.
  • Equipment, tools, and reimbursement support for a productive remote environment.
  • Free Life360 Platinum Membership and Tile trackers.

Life360 Values

Our company’s mission-driven culture is guided by our shared values to create a trusted work environment where you can bring your authentic self to work and make a positive difference

  • Be a Good Person - We have a team of high integrity people you can trust.
  • Be Direct With Respect - We communicate directly, even when it’s hard.

Our Commitment to Diversity

We believe that different ideas, perspectives and backgrounds create a stronger and more creative work environment that delivers better results. Together, we continue to build an inclusive culture that encourages, supports, and celebrates the diverse voices of our employees. It fuels our innovation and connects us closer to our customers and the communities we serve. At Doppel, we’re redefining how organizations protect their identities online — and technical excellence is at the heart of everything we do. Overview

DecisionPoint seeks a Senior Cloud / System Engineering Lead to provide engineering leadership for cloud operations, enterprise systems, infrastructure modernization, service restoration, and component lifecycle activities supporting the USMEPCOM ENLIST program.

The Cloud / System Engineering Lead will provide technical leadership for cloud environments, Virtual Private Clouds, Domain Name System services, load balancers, API connectivity, digital certificates, automation, and hybrid-cloud integration. This role will support the design, implementation, maintenance, troubleshooting, refresh, and restoration of cloud and enterprise infrastructure components.

The successful candidate will work with infrastructure, network, application, cybersecurity, service-management, Government, and vendor teams to deliver secure, resilient, scalable, and supportable cloud services.

This position is remote, with a preference for candidates located in the Chicago area. After-hours availability may be required during outages, maintenance windows, deployments, migrations, and infrastructure-refresh activities.

Note: By applying to this position, you acknowledge and consent to having your resume included in an active competitive government contract bid.

Duties & Responsibilities

The Cloud / System Engineering Lead will:

  • Lead engineering support for cloud operations, enterprise systems, hybrid-cloud services, and associated infrastructure.
  • Architect, design, implement, maintain, and optimize secure cloud solutions aligned with USMEPCOM operational and mission requirements.
  • Configure, manage, monitor, and troubleshoot Virtual Private Clouds, subnets, routing, security groups, network access controls, and cloud connectivity.
  • Engineer and maintain cloud-based Domain Name System services and integrations with enterprise DNS environments.
  • Configure, monitor, and troubleshoot elastic load balancers and associated health checks, listener rules, certificates, and backend services.
  • Support API connectivity, gateways, integrations, endpoints, authentication, monitoring, and troubleshooting.
  • Implement, renew, monitor, and troubleshoot digital certificates used by cloud, application, network, and enterprise services.
  • Support secure connectivity among cloud, on-premises, DISA-hosted, continuity, and remote environments.
  • Develop and implement high-availability, fault-tolerant, scalable, and resilient cloud architectures.
  • Monitor cloud availability, performance, capacity, utilization, service health, cost, and operational risk.
  • Identify and resolve cloud, network, API, DNS, load-balancing, certificate, compute, storage, and connectivity issues.
  • Provide senior technical support during cloud and enterprise-system outages.
  • Participate in Outage Response Team activities and coordinate technical diagnosis, mitigation, workarounds, restoration, and service validation.
  • Coordinate with network, systems, application, database, storage, cybersecurity, vendor, and Government teams during service restoration.
  • Provide root-cause-analysis input and recommend corrective and preventive actions following incidents.
  • Support cloud and systems installations, upgrades, migrations, component refreshes, lifecycle replacements, and modernization activities.
  • Develop implementation plans, migration procedures, maintenance plans, test steps, validation criteria, rollback procedures, and outage contingencies.
  • Lead technical preparation and execution for approved infrastructure changes and deployment activities.
  • Support server, storage, virtualization, network appliance, software, and cloud-service lifecycle management.
  • Ensure cloud and system components are accurately recorded in applicable asset, configuration, and lifecycle repositories.
  • Support equipment and software refresh, disposition, inventory-validation, and documentation activities.
  • Develop automation for cloud infrastructure provisioning, configuration management, deployment, monitoring, and operational maintenance.
  • Use Infrastructure as Code tools such as Terraform, Ansible, AWS CloudFormation, or equivalent technologies.
  • Support integration of cloud capabilities with software-defined data-center, VMware, continuity-of-operations, and on-premises environments.
  • Support workload mobility, enterprise service orchestration, automated recovery, and hybrid-cloud operations.
  • Design and implement backup, restoration, disaster-recovery, high-availability, and service-continuity capabilities.
  • Evaluate technical requirements, establish engineering priorities, develop schedules, estimate costs, and document recommended solutions.
  • Prepare high-level concepts of operations, architecture documents, engineering designs, configuration standards, and service-design packages.
  • Assess infrastructure changes for security, availability, performance, supportability, interoperability, and mission impact.
  • Support implementation of applicable DISA STIGs, DoD security controls, IAVAs, CND Directives, and RMF requirements.
  • Coordinate technical escalation and resolution with AWS, DISA, software vendors, service providers, and other third parties.
  • Maintain cloud architecture diagrams, system configurations, interface documentation, certificate inventories, API records, operational procedures, field guides, and standard operating procedures.
  • Provide technical leadership, mentoring, and guidance to cloud engineers, systems engineers, administrators, and support personnel.
  • Recommend improvements that increase automation, resilience, scalability, security, performance, maintainability, and cost efficiency.

Qualifications

Required Qualifications

  • Active Secret clearance or higher.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, or a related field.
  • Minimum of 8 years of relevant cloud engineering, systems engineering, systems architecture, infrastructure engineering, or enterprise IT experience.
  • Current AWS Certified CloudOps Engineer certification.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience leading cloud or systems-engineering activities in a federal or Department of Defense environment.
  • Advanced experience designing, implementing, administering, and troubleshooting Amazon Web Services environments.
  • Experience with AWS GovCloud or other Government-authorized cloud environments.
  • Experience with Amazon VPC, Route 53, Elastic Load Balancing, API Gateway, AWS Certificate Manager, compute, storage, monitoring, and security services.
  • Experience designing secure hybrid connectivity among cloud, on-premises, DISA, continuity, and remote environments.
  • Experience developing highly available, fault-tolerant, scalable, and resilient cloud architectures.
  • Experience supporting cloud and enterprise-system outages, service restoration, incident response, and root-cause analysis.
  • Experience planning and executing cloud migrations, infrastructure refreshes, component upgrades, and system-modernization activities.
  • Experience with Terraform, Ansible, AWS CloudFormation, or comparable Infrastructure as Code and configuration-management technologies.
  • Experience developing automation scripts and operational tooling using Python, PowerShell, Bash, or equivalent technologies.
  • Experience with VMware vSphere, vCenter, vSAN, NSX, Site Recovery Manager, VMware Cloud Foundation, or comparable virtualization and software-defined data-center technologies.
  • Experience with backup, restoration, disaster recovery, high availability, fault tolerance, and continuity-of-operations solutions.
  • Experience engineering DNS, load balancing, API connectivity, certificates, identity integration, and network-security controls.
  • Knowledge of DISA STIGs, DoD RMF, NIST security controls, IAVA requirements, CND Directives, and ATO support.
  • Experience with cloud monitoring, logging, performance management, observability, cost optimization, and capacity planning.
  • Experience developing architecture diagrams, engineering designs, concepts of operations, service-design packages, implementation plans, and standard operating procedures.
  • Additional certifications such as AWS Certified Solutions Architect, AWS Certified Advanced Networking, AWS Certified Security, AWS Certified DevOps Engineer, Microsoft Azure Administrator, VMware certification, or equivalent credentials.
  • ITIL Foundation or higher certification.
  • Strong technical leadership, architecture, troubleshooting, automation, documentation, vendor-management, and stakeholder-communication skills.
  • Ability to coordinate multiple engineering, modernization, outage, migration, and lifecycle activities simultaneously.

The Operations & Offices Manager is responsible for ensuring that BlackStone eIT's people, assets, compliance, and facilities operate reliably and consistently across all company locations (spanning the UAE, Saudi Arabia, Jordan, Egypt, and Morocco, alongside a distributed consultant workforce).

Reporting directly to the Chief Process Officer, the role requires a high degree of autonomy, cross-border coordination capability, independent day-to-day problem-solving, structured upward management, and leadership of a geographically dispersed team of varying skill levels.

Key Responsibilities

1. People Operations — Onboarding & Offboarding

  • End-to-End Onboarding: Manage onboarding for new joiners across all geographies to ensure Day 1 readiness in coordination with HR, IT, and Finance.
  • Asset Management: Procure, prepare, and hand over equipment to new joiners while maintaining accurate asset records.
  • Offboarding & Insurance: Oversee full offboarding (equipment recovery, insurance cancellations, documentation) and handle employee medical insurance enrollment on joining and cancellation on exit.

2. Visa, Immigration & Compliance

  • Visas & Permits: Manage employee visa issuance, renewals, and cancellations across the UAE, KSA, Jordan, and Egypt, coordinating with PROs and government authorities.
  • Tracking & Registrations: Maintain a proactive tracking system for visa, permit, and commercial registration expiry dates, and oversee company commercial licenses across jurisdictions.
  • Regulatory Compliance: Ensure full compliance with regional labor laws in the UAE, KSA, Jordan, Egypt, and the US, maintaining audit readiness at all times.

3. Payroll & Finance Operations Support

  • Payroll Inputs: Review and approve all Operations-originated payroll inputs (expense additions, deductions, reimbursements) submitted by country coordinators before the HR payroll cycle.
  • Accuracy & Timeliness: Ensure country-level payroll and expense submissions are accurate, complete, and delivered on time monthly.
  • Variance Resolution: Coordinate with HR Payroll to resolve variances or exceptions prior to Finance submission.

4. Office & Facilities Management

  • Team Supervision: Supervise country Operations coordinators and support staff across regional offices to maintain consistent operational standards.
  • Facilities & Vendors: Manage office leases, facilities, utilities, maintenance, and vendor contracts across all locations.
  • Logistics & Budgets: Oversee travel, accommodation, and transportation logistics, manage medical insurance renewals and provider relationships, and monitor administrative/facilities budgets for cost savings.

5. Process Improvement & Reporting

  • Standardization: Document, standardize, and continuously improve operational processes across all geographies.
  • Optimization: Identify operational gaps, manual workarounds, and automation opportunities, presenting recommendations with clear rationale to the CPO.
  • Audits: Support company-wide reporting, compliance checks, and operational audits.

Requirements

Qualifications & Experience

  • Education: Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Operations Management, or a related field.
  • Experience: 7–10 years of experience in multi-country operations, office management, or administrative leadership roles.
  • Distributed Leadership: Proven track record managing a distributed team across multiple geographies and time zones.
  • Immigration Expertise: Hands-on experience with visa, immigration, and government liaison processes in KSA, UAE, and/or Jordan.
  • Program Management: Experience managing medical insurance programs and vendor contracts.
  • Process Building: Demonstrated ability to build and enforce operational procedures in environments with inconsistent or absent processes.
  • Compliance Knowledge: Strong working knowledge of regional labor and compliance frameworks across KSA, UAE, Jordan, and Egypt.
  • Technical Proficiency: Proficiency in MS Office and experience working with ERP or operational management systems.
  • Schedule Flexibility: Flexible to work across multiple time zones and working week structures (Saturday–Wednesday for KSA; Monday–Friday for Egypt and Jordan).

Skills & Competencies

  • Operational Discipline: Ability to design, document, and enforce processes and hold teams accountable.
  • Cross-Border Coordination: Comfortable managing country-level operations remotely without physical oversight.
  • Diverse Team Leadership: Experienced in managing mixed-capability teams (from qualified coordinators to support staff), adapting communication styles and performance management accordingly.
  • Executive Communication: Structured and concise in managing upward; knows what/when to escalate and maintains composure under pressure.
  • Service Orientation: Approaches colleagues as internal customers to provide efficient, professional, and friction-free support.
  • Problem-Solving: Resolves operational blockers independently and escalates only what genuinely requires senior intervention.
  • Attention to Detail: Rigorous in record-keeping, tracking deadlines, and maintaining compliance documentation.

Preferred (Advantageous) Qualifications

  • Prior experience in an IT staffing, systems integration, managed services, or professional services environment.
  • Experience coordinating payroll inputs across multi-currency, multi-country payroll cycles.
  • Experience managing equipment procurement and asset tracking for a dispersed, consultant-heavy workforce.
  • Very good English language proficiency (for KSA and UAE coordination).

About Megaport

We’re not your typical tech company – and we don’t want to be. Megaport is the global leader in Network as a Service (NaaS), and has transformed the way businesses connect to the cloud, data centers, and each other. We’re publicly listed on the Australian Stock Exchange and partnered with the biggest names in tech like Amazon, Microsoft, Google, Oracle, IBM, and more. Headquartered in Brisbane with a crew of over 600 people spread across Asia-Pacific, Europe, and the Americas, our employees enjoy an environment that is collaborative, supportive, and (actually) fun.

Our Team Culture

We’re a team of problem solvers, pixel pushers, code slingers, and cloud fanatics. Culture is more than a poster on the wall here – collaboration beats hierarchy, curiosity fuels our growth, and everyone’s voice matters. We take our work seriously, but not ourselves. We work across time zones to execute on our global vision, trust each other to get things done, and never compromise our values for commercial gain. Most importantly, we place our customers at the center of everything we do.
We’re committed to increasing representation in the tech industry and welcome applicants from all backgrounds. Don’t meet every requirement? That’s okay. If you’re excited about this role, we encourage you to apply.

The Role

The UI/UX Lead – GTM Tools & Systems is a business-facing technical design leader who translates commercial strategy, user needs, system architecture, and operational standards into a coherent experience across the revenue technology ecosystem.

Working in partnership with RevOps, RevTech, Sales Leadership, Engineering, Marketing, and Enablement, this role bridges commercial strategy and technical execution. The role establishes reusable design standards, guides interface development, and continuously improves how commercial users access information, execute processes, and interact with connected applications. This lead owns the design standards, user experience strategy, and continuous improvement of commercial system interfaces and workflows across core and expansion sales motions, brand business units, and regions.

The ideal candidate creates flow-state user journeys that reduce operational friction, improve adoption and data quality, accelerate technology delivery, and increase the time commercial teams can devote to customer-facing activities.

What You'll Be Doing

    Commercial UX Strategy & User Research

  • Develop and maintain ongoing understanding of the needs of Sales, Channel Teams, SDRs, Sales Management, Customer Success, Alliances and supporting commercial functions across brands.
  • Map critical workflows, identify friction and failure points, validate proposed improvements through user research, and establish a prioritized experience roadmap aligned with commercial objectives.

    • Salesforce Experience Design & Optimization

  • Lead the experience design of GTM tools and systems, including Salesforce Lightning pages, record layouts, navigation, dashboards, guided workflows, integrations, and related documentation.
  • Organize information about user roles, commercial motions, and decision requirements that improves efficiency and effectiveness throughout the Sales Journey.
  • Reduce unnecessary navigation, duplicate entry, ambiguity, and user error while maintaining alignment with underlying business processes and system architecture.

    • Connected Systems & Information Architecture

  • Design cohesive experiences across Salesforce, Gong, ZoomInfo, Quoting Tools, customer portals, partner platforms, and related applications.
  • Define how users navigate between systems, locate critical information, and complete end-to-end workflows.
  • Partner with technical Enablement owners to distinguish interface improvements from integration, data, security, or architectural issues requiring separate remediation.

    • Commercial Design System & Reusable Standards

  • Establish and maintain a documented design system comprising reusable components, interaction patterns, page templates, dashboard conventions, accessibility standards, and design specs.
  • Align with platform-native standards and establish clear guidance for when experiences should be standardized globally or differentiated intentionally by brand, product, region, or role.

    • Prototyping, Automation & Delivery Enablement

  • Partner with RevTech developers and architects to validate feasibility, prioritize improvements, and integrate design reviews into development, testing, release, and continuous-improvement practices.
  • Activate opportunities for guided sales motions, simplified workflows, and automation-first experiences in core and expansion business across brands.

    • Cross-Functional Leadership & Governance

  • Serve as the experience-design authority connecting RevOps, RevTech, commercial leadership, Engineering, Marketing, and Enablement.
  • Facilitate requirements discovery, resolve conflicting user needs, document design decisions, and ensure interface changes align with approved processes, data governance, security, accessibility, and platform standards.

    • User Enablement, Documentation & Change Adoption

  • Maintain accurate user guidance, workflow documentation, release explanations, and role-based instructions in partnership with Enablement and system owners.
  • Provide targeted coaching and consultation to users and internal teams for understanding and adoption of fast-paced changes across an evolving, multi-brand commercial environment.

    • Experience Measurement & Continuous Improvement

  • Define and monitor experience measures, including task completion time, task success, navigation efficiency, user error rates, adoption, and user feedback.
  • Establish baseline performance, validate improvements after release, and use evidence to prioritize the design backlog and demonstrate measurable contributions to commercial productivity and system reliability.

What We're Looking For

  • 4+ years professional experience in UX/UI design, enterprise application experience, product design, or commercial systems design.

  • Demonstrated experience improving complex enterprise workflows in Salesforce Lightning and integrated sales technology environments.

  • Strong understanding of information architecture, workflow design, prototyping, usability testing, accessibility standards (WCAG), and design-system development.

  • Ability to balance global standardization with regional, functional, product, and role-specific requirements across brands and expansion sales motions.

  • Experience establishing design documentation, governance standards, user guidance, and repeatable delivery practices.

  • Salesforce Lightning Design System experience and familiarity with Salesforce configuration and component-based development.

  • Experience with CRM integrations, CPQ or quoting workflows, sales engagement tools, and multi-application commercial environments.

  • Experience working within Agile delivery, CI/CD, product management, or enterprise change-management environments.

  • Familiarity with design collaboration and prototyping tools, behavioral analytics, and AI-assisted design or workflow optimization.

What We offer

  • Flexible working environments
  • Birthday Leave
  • Generous study and training allowance + 5 days paid study leave
  • Creative, fun, and contemporary workspaces
  • A motivated team of industry experts and new talent
  • Celebrated success with ‘Legend’ and ‘Kudos’ Awards
  • Health and wellness program
  • Opportunities for career growth and potential for global intra-company transfers for interested candidates.

NOTE: All Megaport business correspondence is conducted via our business email accounts (@megaport.com). If you have any concerns, please reach out to Megaport's careers team directly and we will verify the legitimacy of any communication. All applications will be treated in confidence.

Senior IT Cyber Defense Analyst (Shift Lead)

AI-Enabled Security Operations | 24/7 SOC

Location: Remote – Pune/Baroda, India

Department: IT Cybersecurity – Security Operations Center (SOC)

Reports To: SOC Manager

Work Schedule: 24/7 rotational shifts

About the Role

We are seeking an experienced Senior IT Cyber Defense Analyst (Shift Lead) to lead day-to-day SOC operations, oversee security investigations, coordinate incident response, and mentor SOC analysts. The ideal candidate will bring strong SIEM/EDR expertise, advanced threat investigation skills, and hands-on experience using AI/LLM tools and automation to improve SOC efficiency and detection capabilities.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead SOC shift operations, prioritize alerts, manage escalations, and ensure timely handovers and SLA adherence.
  • Investigate complex incidents involving phishing, malware, ransomware, compromised accounts, endpoint threats, and suspicious network activity.
  • Conduct threat hunting, correlate security telemetry, and map attacker behavior to the MITRE ATT&CK framework.
  • Develop, optimize, and troubleshoot SIEM queries, analytics rules, and detection use cases using Microsoft Sentinel and KQL.
  • Use approved AI/LLM tools for alert triage, investigation assistance, threat intelligence enrichment, KQL development, incident reporting, and workflow automation; independently validate AI-generated outputs.
  • Automate repetitive SOC tasks using Python, PowerShell, APIs, or SOAR capabilities.
  • Mentor analysts, improve investigation quality, reduce false positives, and maintain accurate incident documentation and audit-ready evidence.
  • Coordinate with Incident Response, IT, Endpoint, Network, and Cloud teams to support containment, remediation, and recovery.

Required Skills and Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Cybersecurity, Information Technology, Computer Science, or equivalent practical experience.
  • 5+ years of experience in SOC, cyber defense, or incident response, including shift leadership, incident coordination, or analyst mentoring.
  • Strong hands-on experience with SIEM, EDR/XDR, incident investigation, and threat detection.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Sentinel and KQL; experience with Microsoft Defender, CrowdStrike, or similar security platforms.
  • Strong understanding of networking, Windows/Linux, identity security, email threats, and MITRE ATT&CK.
  • Mandatory practical AI/LLM proficiency, including prompt engineering, AI-assisted investigations, validation of AI-generated queries/scripts, and awareness of hallucinations, prompt injection, and data privacy risks.
  • Scripting or automation experience using Python, PowerShell, APIs, or SOAR tools.
  • Strong analytical, communication, decision-making, and team leadership skills; willingness to work in a 24/7 rotational shift environment.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Certifications such as Microsoft SC-200, CompTIA CySA+, GCIH, or relevant SIEM/EDR vendor certifications.
  • Experience in proactive threat hunting, detection engineering, cloud security, and SOC process improvement.

What Success Looks Like

  • Effective shift leadership and timely, high-quality incident handling.
  • Improved detection coverage, investigation efficiency, and reduced false positives.
  • Practical adoption of AI and automation to reduce repetitive work while maintaining security, accuracy, and human oversight.
  • Strong analyst development, documentation, and operational consistency.

About Us

At ENFRA, we blend a rich history with a forward-looking vision. With over 100 years of experience, we are a pillar of stability in the energy infrastructure industry and a leader in innovative energy solutions. Our commitment to leveraging emerging technologies ensures that we remain at the forefront of the Energy-as-a-Service sector.

We embrace innovation and encourage creative problem solving to tackle the energy infrastructure and energy challenges of tomorrow.

Inclusion is at the heart of our culture. We strive to create a workplace where every voice is heard and valued, fostering a collaborative environment where diverse perspectives drive our success.

Join us to be part of a legacy of excellence and a future of groundbreaking advancements. At ENFRA, stability, innovation, and growth are more than just values—they are the pillars of our continued success.

Overview

The HRIS Manager leads the strategy, administration, governance, and optimization of the organization's HR technology ecosystem. This role oversees HR systems, data governance, reporting, integrations, and technology initiatives that support business operations and workforce decision-making. The HRIS Manager develops and leads a high-performing team while ensuring HR technology solutions are secure, scalable, compliant, and aligned with organizational objectives. This is a hands-on leadership role that serves as the operational owner and primary technical escalation point for UKG Pro and assigned HR technologies.

Responsibilities

  • HRIS Leadership & Strategy:
  • Lead, develop, and mentor the HRIS team, establishing priorities, service standards, and performance expectations.
  • Define and execute the HR technology roadmap to support business objectives, operational excellence, and continuous improvement.
  • Partner with HR and business leaders to identify opportunities to enhance processes, technology capabilities, and user experience.
  • Balance strategic initiatives with daily operational support, urgent business needs, compliance requirements, and available team capacity.
  • HR Technology Administration & Delivery:
  • Oversee the administration, configuration, maintenance, and optimization of HR technology platforms, including system enhancements, upgrades, and implementations.
  • Serve as the operational owner and primary technical escalation point for UKG Pro and other assigned HR technology platforms.
  • Oversee access administration, production support, critical system processes, and timely resolution of payroll-impacting or business-critical technology issues.
  • Manage the HR technology project portfolio, ensuring initiatives are effectively prioritized, executed, and adopted.
  • Direct vendor relationships and service delivery to ensure technology solutions meet business requirements and performance expectations.
  • Data Governance, Security & Compliance:
  • Establish and maintain HR data governance standards, security controls, privacy protocols, and access management practices.
  • Ensure role-based security, least-privilege access, segregation of duties, appropriate approvals, and periodic access reviews across HR systems.
  • Maintain system documentation, testing evidence, security records, audit support materials, issue logs, and corrective-action records necessary to demonstrate effective controls and audit readiness.
  • Ensure compliance with applicable laws, regulations, internal policies, and audit requirements across all HR systems.
  • Identify, assess, and mitigate system, data, compliance, and operational risks.
  • Systems Integration, Reporting & Analytics:
  • Oversee HR system integrations, interfaces, and data exchanges to ensure accurate, secure, and reliable information flow.
  • Monitor critical integrations, scheduled processes, automated jobs, and data-transfer failures, coordinating timely corrective action when issues affect payroll, onboarding, benefits, compliance, or other critical processes.
  • Maintain appropriate integration inventories, data-flow documentation, testing controls, and production-deployment records.
  • Lead the delivery of HR reporting, dashboards, analytics, and workforce insights that support business decision-making.
  • Ensure the accuracy, integrity, and consistency of HR data through monitoring, audits, reconciliations, and process controls.
  • Stakeholder Partnership & Change Management:
  • Collaborate with HR, Payroll, IT, Finance, Compliance, and business leaders to align technology solutions with organizational needs.
  • Lead testing, training, communication, and change management activities related to HR technology initiatives.
  • Translate business requirements into scalable system solutions and process improvements that enhance organizational effectiveness.
  • Supervisory Responsibilities:
  • Directly supervises HRIS personnel and is responsible for hiring, coaching, performance management, and employee development.
  • Oversees workload planning, resource allocation, succession planning, and team performance.
  • Promotes a collaborative, customer-focused culture that drives service excellence and continuous improvement.

Qualifications

Required Education, Experience, and Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in human resources, information systems, business administration, data analytics or a related field, or an equivalent combination of education and relevant experience.
  • 5+ years of progressive HRIS, HR technology or closely related experience.
  • 2+ years of experience leading employees, projects or major HR technology workstreams.
  • Advanced experience administering UKG Pro, including configuration, security, workflows, testing, reporting and integrations.
  • Experience supporting or administering an applicant tracking, recruiting or talent platform, preferably iCIMS.
  • Demonstrated experience managing HR technology implementations, upgrades, enhancements or optimization projects.
  • Experience with APIs, SFTP integrations, interface monitoring or system-to-system data flows.
  • Working knowledge of HR data governance, role-based security, privacy and data-quality controls.
  • Demonstrated ability to develop business requirements, test solutions and manage production implementations.
  • Strong project-management, prioritization and organizational skills.
  • Strong vendor-management and stakeholder-management capabilities.
  • Ability to analyze complex system and process issues, identify root causes and implement sustainable solutions.
  • Ability to communicate technical concepts clearly to nontechnical stakeholders.
  • Demonstrated ability to manage confidential and sensitive employee information.

Preferred Education, Experience, and Qualifications

  • SHRM-CP or SHRM-SCP highly desirable.

Travel Requirements

Physical Activities

raw.description:
Clinical Program Manager

Pathways 2 Solutions (Pathways) distinguishes itself through our serious thirst for impact and our dedication to making Veterans' lives better. We are expert leaders, communicators, technologists, clinicians, and program managers united in the pursuit of effective, practical solutions for our clients.
Our mission is to help other mission-driven organizations across government, nonprofit, and business sectors. Our approach combines clinical and healthcare expertise, proven implementation practices, digital health knowledge, and disciplined program management. That's where you come in.

Position Overview

Pathways is hiring a Clinical Program Manager to organize and manage complex, interrelated program and contract-support activities for the Department of Veterans Affairs. This position coordinates project tasks, clinical and operational workgroups, documentation and template updates, coding guidance, system compatibility, stakeholder engagement, and compliance activities supporting virtual health services.
The Program Manager provides senior-level project management and technical guidance and works directly with clients, VA leadership, clinical teams, business owners, technical personnel, and contractor staff to define goals, formulate task plans, review deliverables, identify opportunities, and improve program efficiency. VA experience is preferred; direct virtual health, Remote Patient Monitoring, or Home Telehealth experience is strongly preferred.

Job Purpose

The Clinical Program Manager is accountable for organizing and managing assigned contract operational-support functions involving multiple complex and interrelated tasks.
The successful candidate will guide clinical, technical, operational, and documentation initiatives; facilitate alignment across VA groups; manage workgroups; and translate regulatory, clinical, coding, and system changes into current guidance, manuals, note templates, protocols, and implementation actions. The role documents and communicates program results, risks, decisions, and recommendations throughout.

Duties & Responsibilities

  • Organize and manage contract operational-support activities involving multiple complex and interrelated project tasks and cross-functional teams.
  • Serve as a contractor interface with clients and VA leadership; collaborate to define goals, formulate and review task plans and deliverables, identify opportunities, resolve barriers, and drive program efficiency.
  • Facilitate stakeholder engagement across VA program offices, clinical groups, business owners, technology teams, coding or compliance experts, and field personnel; ensure clear communication, alignment, decision documentation, and feedback integration.
  • Manage or support workgroups focused on manual reviews, policy and guidance updates, clinical note-template changes, system compatibility, clinical operations, and related virtual health improvement priorities.
  • Update, maintain, and quality-check documentation, manuals, standard operating procedures, workflows, clinical guidance, and note templates to meet current standards and support compatibility with electronic health record systems.
  • Coordinate updates to coding guidance in response to regulatory, policy, clinical, operational, and technology changes; engage appropriate clinical, coding, compliance, and system stakeholders to validate revisions.
  • Analyze complex clinical, operational, and technical problems and develop practical, well-supported solutions and recommendations for client consideration.
  • Research and translate customer and stakeholder requirements into project plans, documentation updates, system-change requirements, implementation activities, and short- and long-range recommendations.
  • Prepare and present status, findings, options, risks, recommendations, and results to clients, VA leadership, workgroups, executives, and other decision-makers.
  • Establish and apply quality-control practices for task plans, manuals, guidance, note templates, reports, and other deliverables; track corrective actions and continuous-improvement opportunities.
  • Ensure ongoing compliance with VA data-security, privacy, access-control, records-management, and Section 508 accessibility requirements applicable to program activities and deliverables.

Leadership Expectations

This role may require leadership and strategic oversight of complex projects and cross-functional teams. The Program Manager maintains senior-level client relationships and holds contributors accountable for successful delivery. The role must exercise sound clinical, technical, operational, and contractual judgment while creating clarity, facilitating alignment, and escalating issues appropriately.

Required Qualifications

  • Clinical degree in a relevant field or a master's-level degree in health science, public health, nursing, health informatics, healthcare administration, clinical informatics, or a closely related discipline. Candidates with a relevant bachelor's degree may qualify when supported by the required level of experience.
  • At least two years of progressively responsible program or project management experience with a relevant master's or clinical degree, or at least ten years with a relevant bachelor's degree.
  • Strong understanding of healthcare systems, clinical programs, digital health solutions, remote patient monitoring, Home Telehealth, or related care-delivery and technology environments.
  • Demonstrated success organizing and managing complex, interrelated projects or program tasks involving schedules, costs, deliverables, risks, dependencies, resources, and multiple stakeholder groups.
  • Experience collaborating with senior clients or healthcare leaders to define goals, formulate task plans, review deliverables, resolve issues, and communicate recommendations.
  • Experience facilitating stakeholder engagement and workgroups, integrating feedback, documenting decisions, and coordinating follow-through across clinical, operational, technical, and administrative teams.
  • Experience developing, updating, reviewing, or managing healthcare documentation, manuals, procedures, guidance, workflows, templates, or other controlled program materials.
  • Ability to analyze complex clinical, operational, technical, regulatory, or coding-related issues and translate findings into practical plans, documentation, and recommendations.
  • Excellent written and oral communication, facilitation, executive briefing, stakeholder-management, organizational, and problem-solving skills.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft 365 and collaboration tools such as Microsoft Teams and SharePoint; ability to learn and effectively use VA-required clinical, documentation, project, security, and reporting platforms.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Department of Veterans Affairs experience, particularly with Remote Patient Monitoring-Home Telehealth programs, operations, workflows, stakeholders, or technology environments.
  • Current or prior Registered Nurse experience combined with Home Telehealth, remote patient monitoring, care coordination, or related virtual-care experience.
  • Relevant clinical coding knowledge and experience interpreting or updating coding guidance in response to regulatory, policy, clinical, or operational changes.
  • Experience updating clinical note templates, documentation tools, manuals, or workflows for compatibility with electronic health record systems.
  • Experience with clinical workflow improvement, technology implementation, stakeholder engagement, change management, quality improvement, or adoption and sustainment initiatives.
  • Project Management Institute credential, such as the Project Management Professional (PMP) or Program Management Professional (PgMP), or a comparable credential. Certification is preferred but not required.

Location and Remote Work

Pathways 2 Solutions is a fully remote government contracting organization. Employees may work remotely from approved states where the company is authorized to employ personnel and can meet payroll, tax, regulatory, security, and contractual requirements.
The position may require periodic travel to VA facilities, government offices, implementation sites, or team meetings. Travel is expected to be up to 15%, depending on client requirements. Pathways reserves the right to modify approved work locations based on business needs and applicable legal, tax, regulatory, and contractual requirements.

Work Environment and Physical Requirements

This position involves prolonged periods sitting at a desk and working on a computer. The employee must be able to communicate effectively in virtual meetings and occasionally lift or move materials weighing up to 15 pounds. Reasonable accommodations are available for qualified individuals with disabilities.

Compensation and Benefits

The anticipated salary range is $110,000.00 - $135,000.00. The upper portion of the range is reserved for candidates with exceptional directly relevant experience, including RN credentials, virtual health expertise, and relevant clinical coding knowledge. Actual compensation will be based on education, relevant experience, clinical and technical expertise, credentials, work location, internal equity, and applicable contract and funding parameters.
Pathways offers a collaborative, family-oriented workplace culture, opportunities for professional growth, and a comprehensive benefits package that includes health, dental, and vision coverage; a 401(k) plan; paid time off; and other benefits available under applicable company plans and policies.

Employment Requirements and Equal Opportunity

Applicants must be authorized to work for any employer in the United States. Pathways is currently unable to sponsor or assume sponsorship of an employment visa.

raw.excerpt: OverviewDecisionPoint seeks an Endpoint Engineer to design, maintain, secure, automate, and modernize enterprise endpoint capabilities supporting the USMEPCOM ENLIST program.
raw.description:
Overview

DecisionPoint seeks an Endpoint Engineer to design, maintain, secure, automate, and modernize enterprise endpoint capabilities supporting the USMEPCOM ENLIST program. This senior engineering position owns endpoint images, application packaging, device provisioning, software deployment, endpoint patching, configuration baselines, and Virtual Desktop Infrastructure engineering.

The Endpoint Engineer develops standardized, repeatable, and secure endpoint solutions for geographically dispersed users and locations. The engineer supports physical and virtual endpoints throughout their lifecycle, including design, testing, deployment, configuration, patching, troubleshooting, refresh, recovery, and retirement.

This position works closely with the Task 6 cybersecurity team while maintaining a clear division of responsibility. Task 6 identifies, prioritizes, and validates security findings. The Endpoint Engineer evaluates operational impacts and implements the approved endpoint configuration, software, image, patch, or remediation changes through established change-control procedures. The engineer then provides deployment and completion evidence for cybersecurity validation.

The Endpoint Engineer collaborates with the Service Desk, field support, Active Directory, virtualization, cloud, network, application, cybersecurity, and Government teams. This position is remote, with Chicago-area candidates preferred. Occasional after-hours maintenance, critical incident support, on-site work, or travel may be required.

Note: By applying to this position, you acknowledge and consent to having your resume included in an active competitive government contract bid.

Duties & Responsibilities

The Endpoint Engineer will:

  • Serve as the senior engineer for enterprise endpoint imaging, packaging, deployment, patching, configuration, and VDI capabilities.
  • Design, build, test, maintain, and document standardized endpoint images.
  • Maintain image components, drivers, firmware dependencies, operating-system settings, security baselines, required software, and deployment configurations.
  • Establish image versioning, testing, approval, rollback, release, and retirement procedures.
  • Validate endpoint images against functional, security, performance, compatibility, and operational requirements.
  • Develop and maintain automated deployment task sequences, provisioning workflows, configuration profiles, and enrollment processes.
  • Engineer and support endpoint deployment using approved Microsoft and Government management platforms.
  • Support modern endpoint-management and co-management capabilities involving Microsoft Intune, Microsoft Configuration Manager, Windows Autopilot, or comparable technologies.
  • Develop, test, maintain, and deploy application packages using approved formats and packaging standards.
  • Package commercial, Government, and internally developed software for controlled endpoint deployment.
  • Develop installation, detection, dependency, requirement, upgrade, repair, and removal logic for software packages.
  • Test application packages for silent installation, proper detection, compatibility, security, user experience, and clean removal.
  • Troubleshoot failed installations, package conflicts, missing dependencies, detection problems, and deployment errors.
  • Develop approved scripts and automation for packaging, provisioning, configuration, deployment, validation, and remediation.
  • Maintain endpoint-management automation in approved version-control and documentation repositories.
  • Design and administer endpoint patching processes for operating systems, approved applications, drivers, firmware, and management components.
  • Establish deployment rings, pilot groups, production waves, maintenance windows, deadlines, exception handling, and rollback procedures.
  • Test operating-system updates, security patches, vendor patches, and application updates before production deployment.
  • Monitor deployment progress, failure rates, compliance status, endpoint health, and outstanding exceptions.
  • Investigate failed patches and coordinate corrective actions, redeployment, or approved exceptions.
  • Engineer and support Virtual Desktop Infrastructure capabilities.
  • Develop and maintain VDI base images, desktop pools, application delivery, user-profile configurations, policies, and endpoint-access requirements.
  • Monitor and troubleshoot VDI performance, availability, login, profile, application, display, peripheral, and connectivity issues.
  • Support VDI modernization, capacity planning, testing, deployment, and optimization.
  • Coordinate VDI platform dependencies with virtualization, storage, network, identity, application, and cybersecurity teams.
  • Support enterprise endpoint deployment and refresh projects across USMEPCOM Headquarters, MEPS, Remote Processing Substations, COOP sites, and remote users.
  • Develop technical implementation plans for device refreshes, operating-system upgrades, application migrations, and endpoint-management transitions.
  • Support endpoint provisioning, enrollment, configuration, testing, deployment, replacement, recovery, and retirement.
  • Provide Tier 3 and Tier 4 engineering support for complex endpoint, application-packaging, deployment, patching, and VDI incidents.
  • Analyze endpoint logs, deployment status, policy results, management-platform data, and other technical evidence.
  • Develop corrective actions for recurring endpoint incidents and known errors.
  • Support major incidents and outages involving endpoint management, software deployments, VDI, or widespread device failures.
  • Implement approved workarounds and service-restoration actions during endpoint-related incidents.
  • Coordinate with the Service Desk and field-support teams to improve endpoint troubleshooting, escalation, and knowledge content.
  • Create technical guidance for common endpoint, deployment, packaging, and VDI problems.
  • Review Task 6 cybersecurity findings assigned to endpoint operations.
  • Assess the operational impact, dependencies, testing requirements, deployment approach, and rollback needs for assigned security changes.
  • Implement approved endpoint security changes through established change-management and release procedures.
  • Execute approved remediation involving endpoint images, software versions, patches, configurations, policies, or management settings.
  • Maintain evidence showing the affected population, deployment method, implementation status, failures, exceptions, and completion results.
  • Provide remediation evidence to Task 6 for validation and closure.
  • Coordinate unresolved or technically infeasible remediations with cybersecurity, system owners, vendors, and Government stakeholders.
  • Apply approved DISA Security Technical Implementation Guides and endpoint-security baselines.
  • Support endpoint compliance reporting, vulnerability remediation, configuration validation, and audit-evidence collection.
  • Maintain endpoint inventories, deployment records, configuration baselines, package records, patch status, VDI documentation, and technical diagrams.
  • Develop and maintain standard operating procedures, field guides, packaging standards, test plans, implementation plans, rollback plans, and recovery procedures.
  • Follow approved incident, problem, change, release, configuration, asset, security, and quality-management processes.
  • Provide endpoint health, deployment, patching, compliance, risk, issue, and modernization information for operational and program reporting.

Qualifications

Required Qualifications

Candidates must meet all of the following requirements:

  • Active Secret clearance or higher.
  • Bachelor’s degree in information technology, information systems, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience where permitted by the applicable labor category.
  • Minimum of eight years of relevant experience in endpoint engineering, systems engineering, device management, desktop engineering, VDI engineering, or a related technical discipline.
  • Experience designing and maintaining enterprise endpoint images.
  • Experience developing, testing, and deploying application packages.
  • Experience supporting enterprise endpoint provisioning, deployment, patching, configuration, and lifecycle management.
  • Experience engineering or supporting Virtual Desktop Infrastructure.
  • Experience implementing approved endpoint-security or vulnerability-remediation changes.
  • Experience troubleshooting complex endpoint, deployment, packaging, patching, or VDI issues.
  • Knowledge of controlled testing, pilot deployment, phased implementation, validation, rollback, and change-management practices.
  • Ability to develop technical procedures, image documentation, package records, test plans, deployment plans, rollback procedures, and completion evidence.
  • Microsoft 365 Certified: Endpoint Administrator Associate certification when relevant to the assigned Microsoft 365 or Intune environment.
  • Ability to support after-hours maintenance, deployment windows, critical incidents, and endpoint recovery when required.
  • Strong written, verbal, analytical, and technical problem-solving skills.

Preferred Qualifications

The following qualifications are preferred but are not required:

  • Experience with Microsoft Intune or Microsoft Endpoint Manager.
  • Experience with Microsoft Configuration Manager or System Center Configuration Manager.
  • Experience with Windows Autopilot and modern device provisioning.
  • Experience with Microsoft Defender for Endpoint.
  • Experience with Microsoft Entra ID and hybrid endpoint management.
  • Experience with PowerShell, Microsoft Graph, or other endpoint-automation technologies.
  • Experience packaging applications using MSI, MSIX, Win32, App-V, or comparable formats.
  • Experience with VMware Horizon, Azure Virtual Desktop, Windows 365, Citrix, or another enterprise VDI platform.
  • Experience supporting federal or Department of Defense endpoint environments.
  • Experience applying DISA Security Technical Implementation Guides to Windows endpoints.
  • Experience supporting Risk Management Framework controls, vulnerability remediation, or authorization evidence.
  • Experience with endpoint analytics, digital employee experience, compliance, or configuration-management tools.
  • Experience supporting large-scale operating-system migrations, device refreshes, or endpoint-management modernization.
  • CompTIA Security+ or another relevant security certification.
  • ITIL v4 Foundation certification.
  • Relevant Microsoft, VMware, Citrix, cloud, automation, or endpoint-management certification.

Skills and Competencies

  • Enterprise endpoint engineering and lifecycle management.
  • Image engineering and automated deployment.
  • Application packaging and software distribution.
  • Operating-system and application patch management.
  • Endpoint configuration and security-baseline implementation.
  • VDI design, deployment, and troubleshooting.
  • PowerShell and endpoint-management automation.
  • Complex troubleshooting and root-cause analysis.
  • Controlled testing, phased deployment, and rollback planning.
  • Cybersecurity remediation execution and evidence development.
  • Technical documentation and configuration management.
  • Cross-functional engineering coordination.
  • Strong attention to detail and change discipline.

Our Equal Employment Opportunity Policy

  • EEO and Affirmative Action Policy: DecisionPoint Corporation is an Equal Employment Opportunity and Affirmative Action employer. It is the policy of DecisionPoint Corporation to provide equal employment opportunity in accordance with all applicable Equal Employment Opportunity/Affirmative Action laws, directives and regulations to all employees and qualified applicants without regard to race, ethnicity, color, religion, national origin, sex, age, disability status, pregnancy, sexual orientation, gender identity, genetic information, protected veteran status, or any other protected status under Federal, State or Local laws.
  • Pay Transparency Policy: In accordance with Presidential Executive Order 13665, DecisionPoint Corporation will not discharge or in any other manner discriminate against employees or applicants because they have inquired about, discussed, or disclosed their own pay or the pay of another employee or applicant. However, employees who have access to the compensation information of other employees or applicants as a part of their essential job functions cannot disclose the pay of other employees or applicants to individuals who do not otherwise have access to compensation information, unless the disclosure is (a) in response to a formal complaint or charge, (b) in furtherance of an investigation, proceeding, hearing, or action, including an investigation conducted by the employer, or (c) consistent with the contractor's legal duty to furnish information.
  • Authorization to Share Resume and Personal Information: By expressing your interest and submitting your resume for this position, you authorize DecisionPoint Corporation to share your resume, as well as personal information included on the resume, with its subsidiaries, affiliates and teaming partners for the purpose of considering you for this position and other available positions requiring comparable skills, education and experience. Should DecisionPoint Corporation. or its affiliates and teaming partners wish to initiate pre-employment discussions, you will be asked to complete an employment application and related employment documents.
