raw.title: Sr. Staff Cloud Security Engineer
raw.excerpt: At ASAPP, our mission is simple: deliver the best AI-powered customer experience—faster than anyone else.
raw.description:
At ASAPP, our mission is simple: deliver the best AI-powered customer experience—faster than anyone else. To achieve that, we’re guided by principles that shape how we think, build, and execute. We value customer obsession, purposeful speed, ownership, and a relentless focus on outcomes. We work in tight, skilled teams, prioritize clarity over complexity, and continuously evolve through curiosity, data, and craftsmanship. We’re seeking technologists and problem solvers who thrive in fast-paced environments, love collaborating with great talent, and approach every day like it’s Day 1.

We're a globally diverse team with hubs in New York City, Mountain View, Latin America, and India. If you're driven by continuous learning, rapid pivots, and the challenges of building in a high-growth startup, we’d love to talk. This is more than a job—it’s a journey.

We are looking for a full-time Sr. Staff Cloud Security Engineer to design, test, and strengthen the security of our complex, distributed, cloud-native microservices platform, which runs primarily on AWS. This is a high-impact, hands-on role. You’ll pair deep technical expertise with excellent communication to work alongside senior leaders, security engineers, and the broader engineering organization.

You’ll drive cloud and application security architecture, build out and mature detection engineering capabilities, lead security incident response, and safeguard our AI-driven solutions across the entire product lifecycle. As a key technical leader on the security team, you’ll hold broad architectural responsibility for application, cloud infrastructure, and AI security, threat modeling, and defensive engineering. You’ll also be a trusted technical voice with our customers, explaining our under-the-hood security measures with clarity and credibility. We prefer candidates with an engineering background: people who build solutions, not just assess them.

What you'll do

  • Own cloud, application, and zero trust security architecture, including blueprints, guardrails, and secure design patterns for cloud-native microservices on AWS.
  • Secure our AI and machine learning systems, including LLM-powered features, by threat modeling AI-specific risks and implementing practical mitigations.
  • Build and scale detection engineering and monitoring pipelines across our cloud infrastructure and Kubernetes environments.
  • Lead incident response: develop automated playbooks, run root-cause investigations on complex cloud security events, and test the team through regular tabletop exercises.
  • Secure the SDLC, including CI/CD automation, container security, vulnerability management, design reviews, and internal testing of new services and enhancements.
  • Perform threat modeling and architecture reviews on complex distributed systems and data flows.
  • Support the customer security team by explaining our security controls directly to customers during technical deep-dives.

What you'll need

  • Cloud security, detection, and incident response. 8+ years of experience in cloud security, application security, and security architecture in modern distributed environments. You’ve built detection engineering and SIEM/SOAR pipelines, analyzed logs at scale using AI, and led real incident response and threat hunting.
  • Hands-on Kubernetes security. You’ve secured, monitored, and investigated incidents in production Kubernetes and containerized environments.
  • Hands-on security testing of cloud-native stacks. You’ve secured and tested modern application architectures (microservices, APIs, containers) in the cloud, with deep AWS experience.
  • AI security. You’re familiar with the latest AI threats and mitigation techniques, such as prompt injection, data leakage, model and supply chain risks, and abuse of AI agents and integrations, and you know how to apply defenses in real production systems.
  • Deep technical skills. You can move from architecture diagrams to code, config, and logs. You can build as well as advise.
  • Excellent communication, including with customers. You can explain complex security concepts and our under-the-hood controls to customer security teams, executives, and engineers alike.
  • Startup pace. Proven success in a high-growth startup, with adaptability, autonomy, and rapid execution.

What we'd like to see

  • Software or infrastructure engineering background, with experience building production systems
  • Experience integrating security (GHAS, SAST/DAST, etc.) into CI/CD tools such as Codefresh, ArgoCD, or GitLab CI
  • Strong Infrastructure-as-Code experience (Terraform)
  • End-to-end vulnerability management across applications and cloud infrastructure
  • Encryption and secrets management (HashiCorp Vault, AWS KMS)
  • Experience designing and documenting security solution architectures
  • Familiarity with frameworks such as the OWASP Top 10 for LLM Applications, MITRE ATLAS, or NIST AI RMF
  • B.S. in Computer Science or a related field, or equivalent experience

Benefits

  • Competitive compensation
  • Stock options
  • Healthcare for the family group
  • Mac equipment
  • USD 150 per month in flexible benefits
  • 3 weeks of vacation
  • English lessons
ASAPP is committed to creating a diverse environment and is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, disability, age, or veteran status. If you have a disability and need assistance with our employment application process, please email us at to obtain assistance.

raw.excerpt: Lumen is the trusted network for the AI‑powered world, connecting people, data, and applications through our expansive fiber network and connected ecosystem.
raw.description:
Lumen is the trusted network for the AI‑powered world, connecting people, data, and applications through our expansive fiber network and connected ecosystem. We enable secure, high‑performance connectivity across cloud, edge, and AI workloads for enterprises, governments, and communities.

At Lumen, you’ll work on infrastructure customers rely on today and build for what’s next, where performance, security, and resilience matter.

This is a high accountability environment where bold ideas drive real innovation for our customers, partners, and industry. The work is challenging, expectations are clear, and trust is built into how we operate. If you’re ready to take ownership, deliver meaningful impact, and help shape the future of AI‑ready connectivity, join us today.

The Role

Driving Technology Adoption, Consumption, and Growth

Lumen is evolving what and how we sell—bringing deeper technology fluency, consultative discovery, and business-outcome conversations into every customer engagement. Our Acceleration and Growth team offers distinct opportunities to help customers adopt, use, and expand technology that advances their priorities. This is an opportunity to be part of meaningful change by shaping how we engage, advise, and support customers as their environments become more complex. If you are energized by uncovering new possibilities, building executive alignment, and turning technology investments into measurable outcomes, this role offers the chance to help lead that change.

As an Account Director Senior Large Enterprise Strategis, you will own growth across large, important, and potentially global enterprise accounts by translating customer business priorities into measurable outcomes enabled by Lumen’s network, cloud, security, managed services, and orchestration portfolio.

As the Account Director Senior, you operate independently from acquisition through modernization, activation, adoption, consumption, and expansion. You set account strategy, shape and negotiate commercial terms, mobilize cross-functional resources, and advise executive stakeholders. Your broad command of customer economics, markets, technology, and complex buying environments makes you a trusted expert to customers and colleagues.

The Main Responsibilities

  • Own and execute a self-directed strategy for a portfolio of large, important, or global accounts, grounded in each customer’s business model, financial priorities, operating risks, technology estate, market context, and competitive position.
  • Anticipate needs before they become formal requirements; develop points of view and use cases that connect modernization to growth, efficiency, resilience, risk reduction, and innovation.
  • Build qualified pipeline through executive relationships, account intelligence, focused prospecting, partners, marketing, and business development.
  • Prioritize investments and resources based on customer potential, solution fit, buying signals, competitive dynamics, and revenue opportunity.
  • Lead discovery across executive, business, technical, operational, and financial stakeholders to define the problem, value at stake, decision path, and urgency to act.
  • Integrate relevant capabilities across Lumen and its partners into a coherent outcome; direct architects and specialists through clear commercial and customer objectives while they own technical design and validation.
  • Build quantified business cases covering expected value, investment, implementation requirements, risk, and cost of inaction.
  • Develop customers’ and colleagues’ understanding of business, market, and solution tradeoffs; influence executive sponsors, economic buyers, technical decision makers, and internal champions.
  • Own new-logo acquisition and expansion against assigned sales, revenue, and consumption goals.
  • Lead complex, high-value sales cycles through qualification, validation, pricing, negotiation, procurement, legal review, and close.
  • Exercise substantial commercial discretion—and, within company governance, full authority to shape and negotiate product, service, pricing, and contract terms.
  • Establish mutual action plans, decision criteria, stakeholder commitments, milestones, and activation dates; surface risks and dependencies early.
  • Plan and manage the account resource model, mobilizing sales, technical, delivery, customer success, channel, and partner teams without relying on formal authority.
  • Retain commercial ownership through implementation and activation; hold downstream partners accountable for customer readiness, delivery commitments, adoption, and value realization.
  • Use consumption data and customer signals to remove adoption barriers, address underutilization, anticipate revenue risk, and identify expansion across workloads, locations, and business units.
  • Convert demonstrated value into modernization, additional use cases, broader executive relationships, recurring revenue, and sustained growth.
  • Serve as a recognized expert across business, financial, market, customer, and portfolio domains; coach peers and contribute account insight that improves sales approaches and solution fit.
  • Activate channel and technology partners through joint targeting, account planning, and selling, with clear ownership and measurable outcomes.
  • Use AI, agents, and automated workflows to improve research, prioritization, outreach, follow-through, and opportunity management; validate outputs and apply sound judgment.
  • Maintain rigorous qualification, stakeholder maps, next steps, forecasts, and CRM records.

What We Look For in a Candidate

raw.description:
About the Role

The Technical Account Manager (TAM) is a deeply technical post-sales role focused on driving successful adoption of Azul Prime within a portfolio of strategic customers. Unlike a traditional TAM role, this position is hands-on and technical first. You will spend the majority of your time engaged with customer engineering teams on JVM performance tuning, troubleshooting, reliability engineering, and architectural guidance. Strong relationship skills matter, but it is technical credibility with developers, SREs, and architects that makes this role successful.

You will be trusted by Azul’s most important accounts to ensure that their mission-critical Java applications run on Prime with the best possible performance, stability, and cost efficiency. And you will serve as the bridge between customers and Azul’s engineering organization, feeding real-world insights back into the product.

What Makes This Role Different

  • Technical depth first. Expect to spend significant time reading thread dumps, GC logs, and flight recordings — not building slide decks.
  • Direct partnership with Azul engineering. You will work side-by-side with our runtime, GC, JIT compiler, and tooling teams on complex customer issues.
  • Ownership of technical outcomes. You own production adoption of Azul Prime within your accounts — from candidate application selection through successful rollout and ongoing optimization.

Key Responsibilities

    Strategic Account Ownership

  • Own a portfolio of named strategic customers, with flexibility to engage additional high-value Azul Prime customers as opportunities arise.
  • Build and maintain deep, long-term relationships with technical stakeholders — SREs, Java developers, platform engineers, and architects.
  • Partner closely with Sales, Customer Success, and Support on joint account planning, renewals, and expansion opportunities.

    • Technical Leadership

  • Serve as the primary technical advisor for Azul Prime across your accounts.
  • Lead troubleshooting, root cause analysis, and performance tuning engagements for JVM-based applications running at enterprise scale.
  • Provide architectural guidance on reliability, scalability, latency, throughput, and cloud cost optimization.
  • Work with customers to identify and qualify candidate applications for Azul Prime, then partner with them through successful production deployment.

    • Product & Engineering Partnership

  • Collaborate with Azul’s runtime, compiler, GC, and tooling engineering teams to resolve complex technical issues.
  • Channel structured, actionable customer feedback into Azul’s product and engineering organizations to help shape the roadmap.
  • Act as a senior point of technical escalation for high-severity issues within your accounts.

    • Enablement & Knowledge Sharing

  • Design and deliver customer-facing workshops, training sessions, and technical business reviews.
  • Create and maintain high-quality technical documentation, runbooks, and reusable customer-facing assets for Azul Prime.
  • Share knowledge internally, mentoring peers across the TAM, Sales Engineering, and Support organizations.
  • Keep internal systems current with account activity, engagement notes, and customer outcomes.

Required Qualifications

  • 12+ years in senior technical roles such as software engineering, SRE, performance engineering, or cloud/platform engineering.
  • 8+ years in customer-facing technical roles (TAM, solutions architect, consulting engineer, or SRE with direct customer engagement).
  • Strong working knowledge of Java programming and JVM internals — garbage collection, JIT compilation, class loading, threading, and memory model.
  • Demonstrated experience tuning and troubleshooting enterprise-scale Java applications in production.
  • Demonstrated ability to perform root cause analysis and apply structured problem-solving techniques.
  • Strong Linux fundamentals, including shell scripting and performance troubleshooting on Linux systems.
  • Hands-on experience with distributed systems, public cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, and/or Azure), and containerization (Kubernetes, Docker).
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to translate complex technical concepts for audiences ranging from individual engineers to senior executives.
  • Based in North America and able to travel occasionally to customer sites (typically 10–20%).

    • Preferred Qualifications

  • Deep specialization in JVM performance tuning, GC behavior analysis, and low-latency Java applications.
  • Experience with observability and monitoring stacks (Prometheus, Grafana, Datadog, New Relic, Dynatrace, JFR, or similar APM tools).
  • Familiarity with microservices architectures and modern cloud-native Java deployment patterns.
  • Cloud platform certification (AWS, Azure, GCP) or SRE-related certifications.
  • Contributions to open-source Java projects or active participation in the broader Java technical community.
  • Experience using Jira and Confluence to raise bugs and maintain documentation.
  • Prior experience with Azul Prime, OpenJDK, HotSpot, or other commercial Java runtimes.

Why Azul

At Azul, you will work alongside a team of Java experts who genuinely love the platform, on problems that matter to some of the most demanding engineering organizations in the world. Our technology powers mission-critical Java workloads at massive scale, and our customers rely on us precisely because we go deeper on Java than anyone else. If you want your technical expertise to have outsized impact — and you want to be surrounded by people who share that passion — we would love to talk!

What we Offer

·Comprehensive compensation and healthcare packages
·Referral Program
·Work-life balance, remote-first, paid time off, company shutdown, holidays
·Work with top experts worldwide whom contribute to the Java ecosystem

Our Culture & Values

·Maniacal Customer Focus
·Innovation & Excellence
·Initiative & Courage
·Impact & Influence
·Integrity & Transparency
·Diversity, Inclusion & Teamwork

At Expel, signing a new customer is just the beginning. The real magic happens when we turn that excitement into a seamless onboarding experience, working integrations, confident security teams, and a customer who's ready to get the most out of our platform.

That's where you come in.

As an Implementation Engineer, you'll own the first 30–60 days of the customer journey, taking customers from their initial sales handoff through technical implementation, enablement, and their first real value with Expel.

This isn't just about configuring tools or checking boxes. You'll be the person bringing everything together, helping customers navigate technical challenges, keeping implementations on track, and making sure they're set up for success long after onboarding is complete.

You'll work closely with customers, our Security Operations Center (SOC), Customer Success, and internal technical teams to deliver an onboarding experience that's thoughtful, efficient, and built around each customer's environment.

What Expel can do for you:

  • Give you ownership of the customer onboarding experience, from initial handoff through successful implementation and transition to Customer Success.
  • Provide opportunities to work with a variety of enterprise security environments, technologies, and customer challenges.
  • Connect you with experienced security practitioners across our SOC, engineering, and customer-facing teams.
  • Give you a voice in improving how we onboard customers, streamline processes, and deliver value faster.
  • Help you continue developing your technical expertise across cybersecurity, cloud environments, and Expel's Workbench platform.
  • Offer a remote work environment where you can collaborate across teams while taking ownership of your work.

What you can do for Expel:

  • Own the customer onboarding journey. Manage a portfolio of 15–20+ implementations simultaneously, guiding customers from post-sale handoff through technical setup, enablement, and initial value.
  • Bring customers live with confidence. Lead technical onboarding, including security integrations, configurations, Workbench training, custom setup, and incident simulations.
  • Help customers get the most out of Expel. Partner with our SOC to validate customer configurations and ensure they're positioned to detect and respond to real threats.
  • Keep implementations moving. Establish clear timelines, communicate expectations, manage milestones, and hold customers accountable while maintaining strong relationships.
  • Get ahead of potential issues. Identify technical blockers, customer readiness gaps, and slipping timelines early, escalating when necessary to prevent onboarding delays and future retention risks.
  • Make customer transitions seamless. Partner closely with Customer Success to ensure every handoff includes the technical context, customer expectations, and documentation needed for long-term success.
  • Help us continuously improve. Identify recurring onboarding challenges, provide feedback to Product and internal teams, and recommend improvements that reduce friction and accelerate time-to-value.
  • Support the broader team. Maintain accurate implementation documentation and provide technical guidance to associate-level teammates when needed.

What You Should Bring With You

  • 2+ years of experience implementing SaaS solutions, security services, or IT services within enterprise environments.
  • Experience in a customer-facing technical role, such as Implementation Engineering, Solutions Engineering, Technical Support, or Professional Services.
  • Working knowledge of cybersecurity technologies, including EDR, SIEM, NDR, and CASB, and how these tools support enterprise security operations.
  • A solid understanding of networking fundamentals, including the OSI model, DNS, firewalls, and proxies, particularly as they relate to security integrations and deployments.
  • Familiarity with cloud environments such as AWS, Azure, or GCP and their native security services.
  • Understanding of enterprise security best practices and common compliance frameworks such as SOC 2, ISO 27001, and HIPAA.
  • The technical troubleshooting skills to trace data flows, identify integration issues, and work through challenges between a customer's environment and Expel's platform.
  • Strong communication skills and the ability to translate technical concepts for security practitioners, business stakeholders, and customers.
  • Experience managing multiple customer implementations or technical projects simultaneously, keeping priorities organized and timelines on track.
  • The confidence to set expectations, navigate difficult conversations, and hold customers accountable while maintaining positive relationships.
  • Good judgment around when to troubleshoot independently, when to escalate, and how to adapt when a customer's environment doesn't fit the standard playbook.
  • A bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.

Additional Notes

The base salary range for this role is between $93,900 USD and $136,200 USD, with a target range of $104,000 to $126,500, plus bonus eligibility and equity.

We believe in paying transparently and equitably. Your salary will ultimately be based on factors such as your experience, skills, team equity, and market data. You’ll also be eligible for unlimited PTO (which we model and encourage), work location flexibility, up to 24 weeks of parental leave, and really excellent health benefits.

We’re only hiring those authorized to work in the United States. We do not currently sponsor immigration visas.

We're an Equal Opportunity Employer: You'll receive consideration for employment without regard to race, sex, color, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, protected veteran status, or on the basis of disability.

We’ll ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment. Please let us know if you need accommodation of any kind.

Company Overview

At Motorola Solutions, we believe that everything starts with our people. We’re a global close-knit community, united by the relentless pursuit to help keep people safer everywhere. We build and connect technologies to help protect people, property and places. Our solutions foster the collaboration that’s critical for safer communities, safer schools, safer hospitals, safer businesses, and ultimately, safer nations. Connect with a career that matters, and help us build a safer future.


Department Overview

The Product Orderability team sits at the intersection of Go-To-Market Strategy, Product Management, and Sales. We drive end-to-end orderability workflows across Motorola Solutions product lines and ensure CPQ configuration stability.
Our mission is to enable a seamless, sales-first user experience by simplifying configuration rules, maintaining platform stability and accelerating New Product Introduction (NPI) cycle times to ensure global sales teams can quote and order solutions effortlessly.


Job Description

We are seeking a proactive and tech-savvy Business Analyst (Oracle CPQ) to bridge the gap between our business stakeholders and technical execution teams. In this role, you will play a key part in gathering, analyzing, and transforming complex product requirements into robust configuration solutions within Oracle CPQ.


Additionally, we are looking for a forward-thinking candidate with hands-on experience utilizing modern AI tools (e.g., Google Gemini, ChatGPT) to streamline requirement drafting, automated test case generation, workflow optimization, and data analysis.


Key Responsibilities

  • Requirement Gathering & Management: Partner with cross-functional stakeholders (Product Owners, Sales, Engineering, Supply Chain, and Factory teams) to define product scope and translate business requirements into detailed technical specifications for Oracle CPQ.
  • AI-Driven Productivity: Leverage generative AI tools (such as Google Gemini) to accelerate business documentation, draft process models, analyze data sets, and create comprehensive test scenarios efficiently.
  • System Quality & Orderability: Ensure product configurations in Oracle CPQ are defect-free, orderable, and adhere to established standards for Orderability UX.
  • BOM & Structure Simplification: Reduce ordering complexity by simplifying Bills of Materials (BOMs), rule logic, and offering structures in close collaboration with Product Management and Engineering.
  • Portfolio Optimization: Drive SKU reduction, product cancellation analysis, and offer/catalog simplification activities.
  • Development & Testing Alignment: Partner directly with developers to clarify business requirements, answer functional queries, and perform validation/testing post-development.
  • Factory & Supply Chain Coordination: Collaborate with factory and supply chain teams to verify configuration rules, ensuring Sales Orders process smoothly without fulfillment errors.
  • Quality Assurance: Design test plans, scenarios, and scripts to thoroughly and efficiently verify items, Bills of Materials (BOMs), and configuration rule changes.
  • Agile Execution: Operate effectively within an Agile team environment to gather and analyze requirements while delivering high-quality ERP/CRM implementations.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Programming & Querying Knowledge: Technical understanding or hands-on experience with SQL, PL/SQL, or scripting languages (e.g., Google Apps Script, BML, or Python) is preferred.
  • Oracle Ecosystem Experience: Prior experience with Oracle Enterprise Applications (such as Oracle EBS, Oracle PLM, or Oracle CPQ Admin features) is preferred.
  • Domain Experience: Background or knowledge in the Telecommunications domain is preferred.
  • Adaptability & Mentorship: Ability to learn new technologies quickly, become an operational subject matter expert, solve complex business problems, and teach or mentor others.
  • Education: Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field (preferred).
  • Experience: Minimum 1-3 years of strong experience in a Business Analyst role gathering requirements, defining scope, and creating functional specifications for Oracle CPQ.
  • AI Tool Proficiency:Hands-on experience using modern AI tools (e.g., Google Gemini) for writing requirements, streamlining business process modeling, or generating test scripts.
  • BOM Knowledge: Strong understanding of Bills of Materials (Oracle ERP) and rule-based configuration models.
  • Process Modeling: Proven experience creating business process models and using them to clearly describe functional business requirements.
  • Analytical & Interpersonal Skills: Excellent requirement gathering, analytical problem-solving, written, verbal, and interpersonal skills.
  • Methodology: Familiarity with Agile vs. Waterfall software development methodologies.

raw.description:
Sana’s vision is to make healthcare easy.

Healthcare is simply too hard in the US. At Sana, we're working to change that by making healthcare easier to access, navigate, and afford. We want our members to know exactly where to turn when they need care, with as few barriers as possible.

We all know navigating healthcare in the U.S. is confusing, costly, and frustrating — and our members are used to feeling that pain. That’s why we’re building something different: affordable health plans designed around Sana Care, our integrated care model connecting members with unlimited primary care and expert care navigation at no additional cost to them.

Whether it’s a quick prescription refill or guidance through a complex medical journey, Sana Care makes it feel effortless to get the right care at the right time. And for employers and brokers, we’ve built intuitive tools to make managing health benefits just as seamless.

If you love solving hard problems that make people’s lives easier, come build with us.

About the role

We're looking for a Contract Care Navigator to join our Sana Care team for a six-month assignment that has the potential to turn into something longer term. In this role, you'll help members navigate the healthcare system, connect with appropriate providers, and access the care they need.

You'll work closely with our experienced Care Navigation team, clinical providers and medical assistants, and other internal teams to coordinate referrals, answer member questions, and help resolve barriers to care. This is a hands-on, member-facing role that's ideal for someone who is organized, compassionate, detail-oriented, and excited to make healthcare easier to navigate.

What you will do:

    • Support Sana members in navigating the healthcare system and accessing appropriate, high-quality, cost-effective care.

    • Help members find providers, understand referral options, and coordinate access to healthcare services.

    • Communicate with members, healthcare providers, and external partners to gather information, resolve routine issues, and facilitate care.

    • Collaborate with Care Navigators, Sana Care providers, Medical Assistants, and Customer Support to ensure a seamless member experience.

    • Maintain accurate, timely documentation of member interactions and care navigation activities.

    • Follow established workflows, manage tasks through completion, and escalate complex clinical, benefits, or operational questions to appropriate team members.

    • Identify opportunities to improve workflows and share feedback with the team.

    • Help members feel heard, supported, and confident as they navigate their healthcare journey.

About you:

    • 2+ years of experience in a fast-paced environment, with at least 1 year directly in care navigation, referrals, provider scheduling, or healthcare benefits.

    • Strong written and verbal communication skills, with a warm, empathetic, and professional approach.

    • Excellent organizational skills and attention to detail, with the ability to manage multiple tasks and follow through reliably.

    • Comfortable learning new technology, navigating multiple systems, and working in a fast-paced, remote environment.

    • Resourceful and proactive, with strong problem-solving skills and the judgment to know when to ask for help or escalate an issue.

    • A collaborative team player who welcomes feedback, communicates openly, and enjoys helping others succeed.

    • Adaptable and eager to learn, with a willingness to take on new tasks as team needs evolve.

    • Passionate about making healthcare more accessible, affordable, and easier to navigate for everyone.

About Sana

Founded in 2017, Sana is a health plan solution built for small and midsize businesses — designed around our integrated primary care service, Sana Care. It’s the foundation of everything we build: ensuring members can easily access high-quality, affordable care while employers and brokers have the tools they need to manage company benefits with confidence.

We’ve been remote-first since day one, with a fully distributed team across the U.S. We value curiosity, ownership, and speed — and we build in the open, together. If you’re energized by solving complex, meaningful problems and want to help reshape how healthcare works from the inside out, we’d love to meet you.

raw.title: Senior Product Manager, Customer Operations
raw.excerpt: About the companyAt Nuitée, we are building the API backbone for the global travel industry.
raw.description:
About the company

At Nuitée, we are building the API backbone for the global travel industry. Founded in 2017, Nuitée is on a mission to transform a fragmented travel ecosystem with simple, scalable, and API-first infrastructure—think “Stripe for Travel.”

By enabling seamless connectivity between hotels, OTAs, fintechs, super-apps, and businesses, some of which are entering the travel market for the first time, Nuitée empowers companies to deliver reliable travel products effortlessly. Our robust platform simplifies complex supplier networks, offering direct access to hotel inventory with better pricing, coverage, and technology.

With teams across the globe, including hubs in London, New York, San Francisco, Palma de Mallorca and Casablanca, Nuitée has grown into a global infrastructure provider trusted by industry leaders like Hopper, Priceline, Google, and Uber.

Now backed by leading VCs and world-class investors including leaders from , Stripe, and Shopify, Nuitée is positioned to redefine the B2B travel market, streamline operations for hotels, and enable new applications through cutting-edge APIs.

Nuitée is at the forefront of a revolution—delivering AI-powered, smarter, and more personalized travel experiences for a new era.

Senior Product Manager, Customer Operations

Remote in EU, or hybrid in Barcelona, Palma, Dublin, or London.

This is a product role where a good idea in the morning can be in the product by the evening.

You’ll own Customer Operations: the internal systems and tooling that let Nuitee's CS team resolve issues and keep bookings fulfilled, across configuration, incident handling, and fulfillment tracking.

You’ll run it as a full business and product domain. You’re accountable for the outcomes, economics, priorities, and product decisions. You’ll help define what success looks like, then decide with your team what to prioritise, what to test, what to build, and where to make trade-offs.

The problem underneath is operational, not customer-facing. How do you raise fulfillment rate and cut incident volume without proportionally growing headcount or cost, in a domain with a direct, visible P&L?

What makes it interesting for you

  • You can move extremely fast. There’s very little red tape, teams make their own product decisions, and the culture is much closer to ask for forgiveness than wait for permission. If something makes sense, you can test it quickly instead of spending weeks getting alignment.
  • You own the path to the outcome. You’ll agree what success looks like, then decide with your team how to get there.
  • You own a real P&L. Fulfillment rate, incident volume, and cost-to-serve are concrete numbers you’re directly accountable for moving.
  • You’ll help build Nuitee’s product organisation. We got to roughly €1B in booking value without a proper product org. Now we’re building one, and you’ll help shape it as we push toward €10B.

Nuitée has grown 10x since 2022, was profitable before raising a $48M Series A led by Accel, and works with companies such as Revolut, Grab, Hopper, Priceline, and Sabre. This role comes with meaningful equity, so when we hit our next growth milestones, you get real upside in the company you’re helping build.

The kind of problems you’ll work on

  • How do we raise fulfillment rate and cut incident/ticket volume without growing CS headcount or cost in proportion?
  • What internal tooling would let CS resolve problems faster, with less manual work and fewer handoffs?
  • Where should we invest in CS systems to get the clearest return, in P&L terms, for the company?

This role fits if you

  • Have owned a product or business area end to end for several years and can show the outcomes you drove.
  • Understand operations, support, or internal-tooling economics, especially cost-to-serve, fulfillment, or efficiency trade-offs.
  • Can go deep into systems and operational mechanics and turn that into product decisions.
  • Are comfortable working closely with engineering on technically complex products.
  • Have worked in a high-pressure environment where you were expected to drive the outcome yourself.
  • Are willing to go deep into operations and cost/efficiency thinking rather than staying at surface-level product management.

Operations or internal-tooling depth matters more to us than travel experience.

Nuitée moves quickly, has little process, and gives people a lot of room to make decisions. You’ll do well here if ambiguity does not slow you down, you like going deep into difficult problems, and you want to be accountable for what your product actually delivers.

If this sounds like your kind of product role, we’d love to hear from you. You can apply with your LinkedIn profile or CV. The process is straightforward and typically takes 2–3 weeks.

Why Nuitee?

At Nuitée, we’re not just reimagining travel—we’re building the infrastructure to power it.

  • Massive Market Opportunity: We are tackling the $9.9tn travel industry, starting with the $75 billion B2B hotel market, a fragmented space filled with outdated systems, gatekeepers, and inefficiencies. Nuitée’s API-first platform is solving this, enabling businesses to access hotel inventory seamlessly and at scale.
  • World-Class Backing: Backed by Accel and visionary leaders across tech and travel—including Booking.com, Stripe, and Shopify—we’re equipped to scale our ambition globally.
  • Bootstrapped Resilience, Startup Agility: Having grown profitably for years without external funding, we combine operational discipline with the speed and innovation of a scaling startup.
  • Global Impact: Our infrastructure supports partners like Google, Grab, worldwide fintechs, superapps, travel companies and others
  • AI-Driven Innovation: Nuitée is uniquely positioned to power the future of travel in the AI era—enabling seamless, intelligent, and hyper-personalized travel interactions.

By joining Nuitée, you’ll be part of a team that’s building a category-defining platform. You’ll work on a global scale, innovate alongside industry leaders, and help drive the next phase of travel technology. If you’re excited to push boundaries, redefine a multi-trillion-dollar industry, and grow with us—Nuitée is the place for you.

By submitting your application, you consent to Nuitée processing your personal data for the purposes of assessing your suitability for employment. Your information will be stored securely and will only be retained for as long as necessary for the recruitment process, or up to 6 months afterward, in accordance with our data protection policy and applicable laws. You have the right to request access, correction, or deletion of your personal data at any time by contacting us at . For more details, please see our Privacy Policy: Nuitée Privacy Notice 2026.

Job Title: SAP GRC Specialist
Location: 100% Remote (Continental United States)
Position Type: In-house Bright Vision Technologies SOW engagement (no third-party client or vendor)
Salary: $150K - $185K
Experience: 5+ years

Employment Terms & Visa Policy
This is a 100% remote, full-time, direct W2 position with Bright Vision Technologies.
This role is part of Bright Vision Technologies’ in-house Statement of Work (SOW) engagement. The client, end customer, and employer for this position is Bright Vision Technologies — there is no third-party client, vendor, or implementation partner involved.

We do not engage in C2C, 1099, or third-party arrangements for this role.
Candidates must be willing to work directly as a full-time W2 employee of Bright Vision Technologies and contribute to our in-house SOW deliverables.

No new H1B sponsorship is available for this role.
However, candidates who are currently on a valid H1B visa and require a transfer are welcome to apply. We will support H1B transfers for qualified candidates.

For every role, a technical coding assessment is mandatory. Please apply only if you are confident in your technical abilities and hands-on experience.

Job Summary
We are seeking an experienced SAP GRC Specialist to design, implement, and operate security and access-control frameworks for complex SAP landscapes, including S/4HANA, ECC, BW/4HANA, Fiori, BTP, and SuccessFactors. In this role you will be responsible for SAP role design, user provisioning, segregation-of-duties analysis, audit support, and the technical operation of SAP GRC suites. The ideal candidate will combine deep expertise in SAP authorization concepts with strong hands-on experience operating SAP GRC Access Control and Process Control, and will partner closely with audit, compliance, and business teams to deliver a secure, auditable SAP environment.

Key Responsibilities
  • Design and maintain SAP authorization concepts and role structures aligned with business processes and least-privilege principles.
  • Build and maintain master, derived, composite, and business roles for S/4HANA, ECC, and Fiori applications.
  • Configure and operate SAP GRC Access Control (ARA, ARM, BRM, EAM), including ruleset management, mitigating controls, and emergency access management.
  • Perform segregation-of-duties analysis and remediation in collaboration with business process owners and internal audit.
  • Configure user provisioning workflows in SAP GRC ARM, including request types, approval paths, and integration with IDM/IAM platforms.
  • Operate SAP GRC Process Control for continuous controls monitoring and policy management.
  • Implement security for Fiori applications, including catalogs, groups, and front-end authorizations.
  • Configure and operate security for SAP BTP and cloud applications using XSUAA, IAS, and IPS.
  • Support SAP audits (SOX, GxP, PCI) and respond to audit findings with documented remediation plans.
  • Implement transport security, table logging, and audit logging in line with internal security policies.
  • Monitor and remediate SAP Security Notes in coordination with Basis and DBA teams.
  • Maintain comprehensive, current technical documentation — including architecture diagrams, design decisions, configuration references, runbooks, and operational procedures — so that the system remains supportable, auditable, and easy to onboard new engineers onto over time.
  • Mentor junior team members and support knowledge transfer across the security team.
Required Qualifications
  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical discipline.
  • Five or more years of SAP Security / GRC experience in enterprise landscapes.
  • Strong hands-on experience with SAP authorization concepts and role design.
  • Deep experience operating SAP GRC Access Control (ARA, ARM, BRM, EAM).
  • Experience supporting SAP audits and remediation activities.
  • Hands-on experience securing Fiori, BTP, and cloud SAP applications.
  • Familiarity with SAP IDM or third-party IGA tooling.
  • Working knowledge of SAP Process Control.
  • Strong understanding of regulatory frameworks such as SOX, GxP, and PCI.
  • Excellent communication and documentation skills.
Preferred Qualifications
  • SAP-certified Security or GRC credentials.
  • Experience with SAP Cloud Identity services (IAS, IPS) and SCIM-based integrations.
  • Familiarity with HANA security and analytic privileges.
  • Experience with continuous controls monitoring frameworks.
  • Exposure to SAP RISE / Grow security operating models.
How to Apply
Would you like to know more about this opportunity?
For immediate consideration, please send your resume to or contact us at (908) 505-3544. Learn more about Bright Vision Technologies at www.bvteck.com.

About WellQor:
WellQor is a patient centered, full-service psychological practice accessible online. We put our long-term personal relationships with clients at the heart of everything we do, so each person feels the esteem and confidence that comes from feeling consistently loved, supported, and valued. We’re not a tech giant, directory service, or gig-work platform. We're a collaborative mental health practice that marries the best of traditional and innovative approaches to pursue the best possible outcomes for our clinicians and our clients.
Unlike other online providers, our clinical therapists are one member of a team, collaborating with peers and a Clinical Director who is responsible for developing and guiding their team. Our clinicians enjoy the full support of a treatment team and the security of W-2 employment, while our patients benefit from the full attention of a robust clinical organization.
Our practice is rapidly growing, and we owe our success to a team-oriented culture that puts people first. As a new provider, expect to feel loved, appreciated, and supported in a way that’s truly unique to WellQor.
How You’ll Make an Impact:
At WellQor, you’ll help your clients overcome mental health challenges, forge better relationships, and be the best versions of themselves. You’ll make a real, tangible difference and feel good about the way you bring joy to the lives of others.
And you won’t have to do it alone. We follow a care-team treatment model, which means clinicians are assigned to teams which they can connect with and consult for advice, institutional knowledge, and continued feedback to help advance you in your career.
In this role you’ll get to:
  • Develop meaningful relationships with patients via tele-therapy.
  • Define your own availability, make your own schedules, and work according to your lifestyle. Some WellQor therapists work part time, and others carry full caseloads. Whatever your lifestyle demands, we’re here to meet you where you’re at.
  • Consult with your clinical director and your regional team on a regular basis for support and feedback.
  • Connect with therapists across the country using our Clinician Connect platform.
  • Allow WellQor to handle credentialing, billing, client intake, marketing, customer service, and other administrative services on your behalf.
  • Participate in company events and receive opportunities for CEU sponsorship.
What we’re looking for:
  • Friendly, professional, and compassionate people.
  • LPCC, LMFT, LMHC, LICSW, LCSW, LCP or equivalent licensed to practice independently.
  • Experience using electronic health record (EHR) systems to document sessions.
  • Comfort using technology in everyday work.
  • A willingness to learn.
What we offer:
  • Medical, dental, and 401k benefits.
  • Competitive compensation paid by the billable hour.
  • PTO and paid holidays.
  • Connection to responsive, professional, and empathetic coworkers and leadership.
  • Schedule flexibility.
  • Full administrative support.
  • An EHR system customized to be easy to use.
Compensation details:
WellQor Therapists are paid by the billable hour and have the flexibility to take on the caseload that they’re interested in carrying at any given time. Hourly compensation is competitive and varies based on license level, relevant experience, and caseload requirements.
Join the WellQor team and connect with your best self today!

ABOUT ADOBE

Adobe Population Health (APH) is a women-owned health solutions company founded in 2018 with a mission of positively impacting the lives we touch. Headquartered in Phoenix, AZ, with satellite locations across multiple states, APH fosters a culture rooted in inclusivity, human kindness, and high-quality care.

Recognized by Inc. 5000 as one of America’s Fastest-Growing Private Companies and honored for a fifth consecutive year as a“Best Place to Work” by the Phoenix Business Journal, APH continues to expand its reach and impact.

APH partners with health plans, providers, hospitals, and families to deliver tailored programs including case management, in-home and in-clinic wellness assessments, preventative care, transitional care, and social services. As one of the nation’s few fully integrated healthcare organizations, APH delivers comprehensive, coordinated medical and social support through a wide range of specialized service lines.

With continued growth on the horizon, APH is seeking mission-driven individuals who are passionate about improving health outcomes and supporting those in need.

POSITION PURPOSE

The Manager of Coding and Risk Adjustment is responsible for leading coding operations, risk adjustment initiatives, quality assurance activities, and provider documentation improvement efforts.

This position oversees coding staff, coding quality programs, provider education initiatives, and risk adjustment performance across multiple markets and lines of business. The Manager serves as the subject matter expert for ICD-10 coding, CMS-HCC risk adjustment, Medicare Advantage, HEDIS, STARS, and coding compliance while ensuring departmental goals, coding accuracy standards, and operational performance metrics are achieved.

The Manager of Coding & Risk Adjustment collaborates closely with executive leadership, clinical providers, quality teams, and operational leaders to improve documentation integrity, maximize accurate reimbursement, support value-based care initiatives, and ensure regulatory compliance.

This position is fully remote.

DUTIES & RESPONSIBILITIES

Leadership & Team Management

  • Lead, mentor, and develop a team of Medical Risk Coders and Chart Preparation staff.
  • Conduct performance evaluations, coaching sessions, and ongoing staff development activities.
  • Assist with recruitment, onboarding, training, and retention of coding team members.
  • Establish productivity, quality, and performance expectations for coding staff.
  • Foster a culture of accountability, collaboration, and continuous improvement.

Coding & Risk Adjustment Operations

  • Oversee daily coding operations to ensure accuracy, productivity, and compliance.
  • Review medical records and documentation to identify appropriate ICD-10-CM diagnosis codes and CMS-HCC opportunities.
  • Ensure accurate risk adjustment coding practices that support Medicare Advantage, Medicaid, and value-based care programs.
  • Monitor annual HCC recapture initiatives and identify opportunities to improve RAF scores and risk adjustment outcomes.
  • Remain current on diagnosis coding guidelines, CMS regulations, and risk adjustment reimbursement methodologies.

Quality Assurance & Compliance

  • Maintain departmental coding accuracy standards of 95% or greater.
  • Conduct routine coding audits and quality reviews to ensure coding integrity and compliance.
  • Develop corrective action plans and provide feedback based on audit findings.
  • Monitor compliance with CMS, Medicare, Medicaid, HIPAA, and organizational policies.
  • Support readiness for internal, external, health plan, and regulatory audits.

Provider Documentation Improvement

  • Provide education and training to providers regarding coding accuracy, risk adjustment, HCC documentation, HEDIS and STARS coding guidelines.
  • Review provider documentation and identify opportunities for improvement.
  • Develop training materials and coding reference tools to improve documentation quality.
  • Partner with clinical leadership to enhance provider documentation practices and coding performance.
  • Provide real-time coding and documentation support to providers and clinical teams.

Reporting & Analytics

  • Develop and monitor departmental reports related to:
    • Coding accuracy
    • Audit performance
    • HCC recapture rates
    • Provider performance
    • Productivity metrics
    • Quality outcomes
    • Analyze coding trends and identify opportunities for operational improvement.
  • Assist leadership in developing performance goals and strategic initiatives.
  • Implement data-driven recommendations to improve coding outcomes and financial performance.

Operational Excellence

  • Develop and implement workflow improvements that increase efficiency and quality.
  • Support implementation of new coding processes, technologies, and system enhancements.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional departments to improve coding operations and performance.
  • Drive scalable infrastructure and process improvements to support organizational growth.

Other Responsibilities

  • Maintain confidentiality of Protected Health Information (PHI).
  • Conduct all activities professionally and in accordance with company policies.
  • Participate in quality improvement initiatives.
  • Perform additional duties as assigned.

KEY PERFORMANCE INDICATORS (KPIs)

  • Coding Accuracy ≥ 95%
  • Audit Accuracy ≥ 95%
  • HCC Recapture Rate Achievement
  • Coding Productivity Goals
  • Provider Training Completion Rates
  • Documentation Improvement Outcomes
  • Regulatory Compliance Standards
  • Team Productivity and Engagement
  • Coding Turnaround Time
  • Quality Audit Findings and Remediation Success

SKILLS & QUALIFICATIONS

  • Five (5) years of ICD-10 coding experience.
  • Three (3) years of Medicare Advantage and Risk Adjustment coding experience.
  • Two (2) years of leadership, mentoring, supervisory, or management experience.
  • Experience conducting coding audits and quality assurance reviews.
  • Experience providing provider education and documentation improvement support.
  • Strong knowledge of:
    • ICD-10-CM Coding
    • CMS-HCC Risk Adjustment Methodology
    • Medicare Advantage
    • Medicaid Risk Adjustment
    • HEDIS
    • STARS
    • RAF Scoring
    • Provider Documentation Improvement (PDI)
    • CMS Documentation Guidelines
  • Knowledge of EMR platforms and healthcare technology systems.
  • Knowledge of claims, encounters, billing processes, and healthcare reimbursement models.
  • Strong analytical, organizational, and problem-solving skills.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities and meet deadlines in a fast-paced environment.

EDUCATION, LICENSES, & CERTIFICATIONS

  • High School Diploma or GED required.
  • Bachelor's degree in healthcare administration, health information management, business administration, nursing, or a related field preferred.
  • Active Certified Risk Adjustment Coder (CRC) credential required.
  • CPC, CCS, RHIT, RHIA, or additional coding certification preferred.
  • Experience with Salesforce or other CRM platforms preferred.

BENEFITS & TOTAL REWARDS

  • Paid Orientation and Training
  • Insurance – Medical, Dental, Vision, and Life
  • 401k Plan – 3% match
  • Employee Assistance Program
  • Tuition Reimbursement
  • Continued Education Support
  • Mileage Reimbursement (if applicable)
  • Referral Bonuses
  • Paid Holidays (9 days)
  • Paid Time Off (20 days)
  • Paid Volunteer Hours

CHARACTER & COMPETENCIES

  • Courage– To have the courage to do the right thing at the right time.
  • Ownership – To take ownership of every issue you touch.
  • Respect– To respect yourself, co-workers, and for those whom you care.
  • Excellence – To be excellent in all that you do.
  • Diversity - Demonstrates knowledge of EEO policy; Shows respect and sensitivity for cultural differences; Educates others on the value of diversity; Promotes a harassment-free environment; Builds a diverse workforce.
  • Ethics - Treats people with respect; Keeps commitments; Inspires the trust of others; Works with integrity and ethics; Upholds organizational values.
  • Adaptability - Adapts to changes in the work environment; Manages competing demands; Changes approach or method to best fit the situation; Able to deal with frequent change, delays, or unexpected events.
  • Customer Service - Manages difficult or emotional customer situations; Responds promptly to customer needs; Solicits customer feedback to improve service; Responds to requests for service and assistance; Meets commitments.
  • Interpersonal Skills - Focuses on solving conflict, not blaming; Maintains confidentiality; Listens to others without interrupting; Keeps emotions under control; Remains open to others' ideas and tries new things.
  • Judgement - Displays willingness to make decisions; Exhibits sound and accurate judgment; Supports and explains reasoning for decisions; Includes appropriate people in decision-making process; Makes timely decisions.
  • Problem-Solving - Identifies and resolves problems in a timely manner; Gathers and analyzes information skillfully; Develops alternative solutions; Works well in group problem-solving situations; Uses reason even when dealing with emotional topics.
  • Professionalism - Approaches others in a tactful manner; Reacts well under pressure; Treats others with respect and consideration regardless of their status or position; Accepts responsibility for own actions; Follows through on commitments.
  • Teamwork - Balances team and individual responsibilities; Exhibits objectivity and openness to others' views; Gives and welcomes feedback; Contributes to building a positive team spirit; Puts success of team above own interests; Able to build morale and group commitments to goals and objectives; Supports everyone's efforts to succeed.

PHYSICAL DEMANDS & WORK ENVIRONMENT

EQUAL EMPLOYMENT OPPORTUNITY

raw.description:
About VALIS

We’re a fast-moving, rapidly growing B2B SaaS company focused on bringing modern technology to the metal recycling industry — an essential but underserved market segment. Our technology helps recyclers close more deals, operate more efficiently, and finally ditch the pen-and-paper workflows.

We’re an early-stage company, backed by leading climate-tech VCs, looking to bring on new team members that can help us build VALIS and transform the industry. We lead with authenticity, boldness, passion, and empathy focused on creating a more sustainable future. A career at VALIS is one where you’ll be empowered to expand your technical and leadership abilities while having a positive impact on the world.

The role

As a Software Engineer at VALIS, you'll build and scale our newest product line, taking it from a blank page to the plant floor. You'll spend time with operators and plant managers, design the schema and application, and deliver a product that scrap processors rely on to run their plant. Working directly with our CTO, product team, and end users, you'll make the architecture and design decisions, prioritize what gets built when, and see your work used every shift, every day. We're hiring across mid-senior levels, from a few years experience to senior engineers.

What you'll do

  • Own the product end-to-end: data model, API, UI, UX, deployment, and iteration.
  • Design a multi-tenant domain model (materials, loads, runs, equipment, quality) that holds up as each customer's process differs.
  • Build fast, robust, validated data-entry workflows for the plant floor.
  • Deliver insights dashboards managers act on each shift.
  • Meet with operators and facility managers weekly, get on-site, and turn what you see into product decisions.
  • Integrate new data sources with existing VALIS data and customer systems such as ERP exports, scales, and plant controls.
  • Build and deploy agentic features to surface trends from production and quality data, flag anomalies, and notify the right people.

How we work

  • Remote, US-based. Work from anywhere in the US, overlapping with East Coast business hours (roughly 9am to 5pm ET).
  • Small team, low overhead. You'll work directly with our CTO, along with a product and business team with deep industry experience.
  • Our stack: React and TypeScript on the frontend; C# and ASP.NET Core with PostgreSQL on the backend; AWS, Docker, and Pulumi for infrastructure.
  • We use Claude Code heavily and expect you to be highly effective with it. You should own and understand the code you ship; AI speeds up the work but does not replace the thinking.
  • Travel a few times a year for customer site visits and company get-togethers (on-site at our HQ in Worcester, MA or off-site elsewhere).

Requirements

Who you are

We hire for fundamentals & mindset. You:

  • Have 3+ years of professional software engineering experience (for senior candidates, 5+ and have led technical projects).
  • Think data model first: you can turn a messy real-world process into a clean, normalized schema... and defend the tradeoff decisions.
  • Use types, clear boundaries, and domain language to make wrong states hard to represent.
  • Are comfortable owning ambiguous problems end to end, finding solutions without waiting for instruction.
  • Are solid across databases, backend APIs, and frontend fundamentals.
  • Are mathematically minded, with strong quantitative and statistical fundamentals, so the numbers we show customers are ones they can trust.
  • Move fast, cut scope wisely, and don't shy away from talking to customers.
  • Write and communicate clearly with both technical and non-technical team members (we're a remote team).

It won't be a good fit if you want a big team to lean on, a slow/low-risk release process, or narrow-scoped work.

If this role really excites you, but you don't check all the boxes, apply anyway!

Bonus points

  • Familiarity with our stack (React, TypeScript, C#/.NET, PostgreSQL, AWS).
  • You've worked in metals or materials recycling (or another heavy industry) and understand the people who run those operations.
  • You've built ERP, MES, inventory, logistics, or other operations software where data-entry correctness matters.
  • You've built multi-tenant B2B SaaS where each customer's workflow is a little different.
  • Experience with plant or device data: scales, PLCs, SCADA, MQTT, or ERP integrations.

Benefits

  • Base salary: $125,000 to $155,000, depending on experience level
  • Meaningful equity through our employee stock option plan
  • 401(k) with employer matc
  • Medical, dental, and vision insuranc
  • Unlimited vacation, plus: sick time, guaranteed personal time, and public holiday

You must be authorized to work in the US full-time. We can't sponsor visas at this time.

Our hiring process

Application form

Please note that we will be screening all application question responses for authenticity; any pure AI-generated answers will result in automatic disqualification. Our team members will be personally reviewing each application, and we want to hear your voice & personal experience!

Say hi to our office dog in your application (include her name). It's on the About Us page of our website.

Steps

  1. Intro call (15-30 min)
  2. Technical deep dive (30-60 min) on something you built from scratch
  3. Live design exercise (60-90 min): e.g., model a real recycling-floor workflow with us
  4. Team and founder conversations
  5. References, background check, and offer

We aim to move from first call to offer in about 2-3 weeks.

GDIT is seeking a Cybersecurity Engineer to join the Cybersecurity and Continuous Diagnostics and Mitigation (CDM) team. Integrate Axonius with a varied set of data sources such as Active Directory, Endpoint Management Tools, cloud platforms, vulnerability scanners, CMDBs, identity providers, and network security tools. Create, test, and optimize custom queries, dashboards, and automated enforcement actions. Establish data ingestion standards and quality checks to ensure accurate asset correlation and normalization. Assist in defining and implementing role-based access controls and data governance policies for the platform. Participate in the full systems engineering lifecycle, including requirements gathering, architecture documentation, design reviews, implementation, and operational transition. Produce engineering artifacts such as system design documents, integration diagrams, runbooks, and configuration baselines. Ensure solutions align with enterprise architecture, security policies, and operational standards. Work as a contributing member of an Participate in planning, backlog refinement, daily stand-ups, sprint demos, and retrospectives. Iterate on platform features based on stakeholder feedback and evolving enterprise needs. Maintain transparency on progress, risks, and dependencies through Agile tooling.

  • Experience designing or administering Axonius, ServiceNow CMDB, SCCM, Intune, Tenable Nessus and SecurityCenter, TenableOne, or ForeScout CounterAct.
  • Experience with enterprise IT domains such as Windows or Linux systems, networking fundamentals, cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, identity and access management, endpoint management tools, and vulnerability management platforms
  • Experience deploying Axonius in a large, regulated enterprise environment
  • Knowledge of data ingestion, APIs, connectors (adapters), and asset normalization
  • Associate’s degree and 5+ years of experience supporting IT projects and activities, Bachelor’s degree and 3+ years of experience supporting IT projects and activities, or Master’s degree and 1+ years of experience supporting IT projects and activities

  • Possession of excellent written and verbal communication skills, to prepare documentation, diagrams, and stakeholder updates
  • Possession of excellent analytical and problem-solving skills, for data accuracy and system reliability
  • Active public trust clearance.

To encourage work/life balance, GDIT offers employees full flex work weeks where possible and a variety of paid time off plans, including vacation, sick and personal time, holidays, paid parental, military, bereavement and jury duty leave. GDIT typically provides new employees with 15 days of paid leave per calendar year to be used for vacations, personal business, and illness and an additional 10 paid holidays per year. We regularly review our Total Rewards package to ensure our offerings are competitive and reflect what our employees have told us they value most.

As part of the hiring process, we will ask you to complete an identity verification process that leverages advanced biometrics and artificial intelligence to ensure authenticity and protect against identity fraud. You are expected to be on camera during virtual interviews. We reserve the right to take your picture to verify your identity and prevent fraud. Job Title - Advanced Specialist, Events

DESCRIPTION

Deliver exceptional customer, partner and industry event experiences that support Pearson's commercial, marketing and brand objectives. Comparable market titles for this opportunity may include Senior Event Manager, Event Marketing Manager, Sponsorship Manager, Conference Manager, Events Programme Manager, Strategic Events Manager, Experiential Marketing Manager, B2B Events Manager, Customer Events Manager, Association Partnerships Manager, Event Operations Manager or Senior Events Specialist.

ABOUT THE ROLE

The Advanced Specialist, Events independently owns critical components of customer-facing events, conferences, sponsorships and association programmes that support Pearson's go-to-market priorities.

Recognised as a subject matter expert, you will translate business objectives into high-quality event experiences, coordinating internal teams, external partners, vendors and sponsors to ensure successful delivery. You will manage complex workstreams with a high degree of autonomy, making informed decisions, solving execution challenges and maintaining alignment across multiple stakeholders.

In addition to event delivery, you will help improve the tools, processes and standards used across the events function while providing practical guidance and support to junior colleagues.

This role is ideal for an experienced events professional who enjoys balancing strategy, organisation, stakeholder engagement and flawless execution while contributing to the continuous improvement of a global events programme.

WHAT YOU WILL DO

Lead Event Planning & Delivery

  • Own assigned event workstreams from planning through post-event follow-up.
  • Manage timelines, budgets, vendors, venues, registration activities, attendee communications, materials and production requirements.
  • Translate marketing, commercial, audience and brand objectives into clear event plans, milestones and measures of success.
  • Coordinate activities across internal teams and external partners to maintain readiness and delivery excellence.
  • Support successful event execution while ensuring a high-quality attendee experience.

Manage Sponsorship & Association Programmes

  • Manage sponsorship and association deliverables from planning through activation.
  • Coordinate benefit fulfilment, partner communications and promotional commitments.
  • Support speaking opportunities, executive engagements and customer-facing activities.
  • Ensure sponsor and association requirements are delivered accurately and professionally.

Stakeholder & Vendor Management

  • Partner closely with Marketing, Sales, Product, Communications, Procurement and Finance teams.
  • Coordinate vendors, agencies, sponsors and external partners throughout the event lifecycle.
  • Ensure external suppliers deliver against agreed scope, quality, timeline and contractual expectations.
  • Build strong working relationships that support successful programme delivery.

Risk Management & Operational Excellence

  • Identify risks, dependencies and execution challenges early.
  • Recommend solutions and make informed tactical decisions within agreed parameters.
  • Escalate significant strategic, financial, contractual or reputational risks appropriately.
  • Maintain accurate project plans, budgets, decision logs, sponsor trackers and event documentation.
  • Ensure event programmes are delivered consistently and professionally.

Measurement & Continuous Improvement

  • Capture event outcomes, engagement metrics, feedback and lessons learned.
  • Analyse performance data and recommend improvements to future programmes.
  • Support enhancements to attendee experience, event quality and operational efficiency.
  • Pilot new tools, technologies and ways of working that improve scalability, measurement and consistency.
  • Contribute to the ongoing evolution of Pearson's events capability and best practices.

Knowledge Sharing & SME Support

  • Provide practical guidance, coaching and support to junior colleagues.
  • Share templates, tools and best practices across teams.
  • Help improve consistency and capability throughout the events function.
  • Serve as a trusted subject matter expert in event planning and delivery.

WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR

Essential Experience

  • Demonstrated experience independently managing complex business events, conferences, sponsorship programmes, customer events or association partnerships.
  • Strong project management capability, including work planning, budget management, dependency tracking and stakeholder coordination.
  • Experience managing multiple priorities simultaneously while maintaining quality and attention to detail.
  • Proven success working with vendors, agencies, sponsors and external partners.
  • Experience delivering successful event programmes from planning through post-event reporting.

Knowledge & Skills

  • Strong organisational and project management skills.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication capabilities.
  • Ability to influence stakeholders and drive alignment without direct authority.
  • Sound judgement, adaptability and problem-solving capability.
  • Working knowledge of event technology, attendee communications, registration systems and event reporting.
  • Understanding of how events support customer engagement, brand awareness, sales enablement and thought leadership objectives.
  • Ability to analyse data and convert insights into practical recommendations.
  • Commitment to inclusive, accessible and professionally executed event experiences.

Desirable

  • Experience using Cvent or comparable event management platforms.
  • Experience supporting conferences, sponsorships, exhibitions and association programmes.
  • Exposure to Higher Education, Education Technology, SaaS or B2B environments.
  • Familiarity with CRM systems, lead capture processes and event measurement frameworks.

WHY THIS ROLE MATTERS

Events play an important role in how Pearson engages customers, partners and industry stakeholders.

This role helps ensure our events deliver meaningful experiences, support business objectives and represent Pearson's brand to a consistently high standard. Through excellent planning, stakeholder coordination and operational execution, the successful candidate will contribute directly to the effectiveness and impact of Pearson's events strategy.

BEHAVIOURAL EXPECTATIONS

Customer Centricity

Anticipate the needs of attendees, customers, sponsors and partners and create experiences that deliver meaningful value.

Raise the Performance Bar

Identify and implement improvements that strengthen event quality, engagement, efficiency and business impact.

Exceptional Collaboration for Value

Build trusted relationships, share expertise openly and align teams around common objectives.

Our Leaders Inspire

Lead through expertise, professionalism and example while remaining calm, positive and solutions-focused under pressure.

WHY JOIN PEARSON?

At Pearson, we're committed to helping learners realise the life they imagine through learning.

As an Advanced Specialist, Events, you'll play an important role in delivering impactful experiences that connect customers, partners and industry stakeholders with Pearson's mission and solutions. You'll work across a diverse portfolio of programmes while continuing to build your expertise within a collaborative, global organisation.

Compensation at Pearson is influenced by a wide array of factors including but not limited to skill set, level of experience, and specific location. As required by the California, Colorado, Hawaii, Illinois, Maryland, Minnesota, New Jersey, New York State, New York City, Vermont, Washington State, and Washington DC laws, the pay range for this position is as follows:

The minimum full-time salary range is between $60,000 - $90,000.

This position is eligible to participate in an annual incentive program, and information on benefits offered is here.

Applications will be accepted through November 2nd 2026. This window may be extended depending on business needs.
