raw.title: Director of Revenue Accounting & Assurance
raw.excerpt: ABOUT STORD Stord is The Consumer Experience Company, powering seamless checkout through delivery for today's leading brands.
raw.description:
ABOUT STORD


Stord is The Consumer Experience Company, powering seamless checkout through delivery for today's leading brands. Stord is rapidly growing and strategically scaling teams across the entire company, and seeking energetic experts to help us achieve our mission.


By combining comprehensive commerce-enablement technology with high-volume fulfillment services, Stord provides brands a platform to compete with retail giants. Stord manages over $10 billion of commerce annually through its fulfillment, warehousing, transportation, and operator-built software suite including OMS, Pre- and Post-Purchase, and WMS platforms. Stord is leveling the playing field for all brands to deliver the best consumer experience at scale.


With Stord, brands can increase cart conversion, improve unit economics, and drive sustained customer loyalty. Stord’s end-to-end commerce solutions combine best-in-class omnichannel fulfillment and shipping with leading technology to ensure fast shipping, reliable delivery promises, easy access to more channels, and improved margins on every order.


Hundreds of leading DTC and B2B companies like True Classic, Native, Seed Health, goodr, Sundays for Dogs, and more trust Stord to deliver industry-leading consumer experiences on every order. Stord is headquartered in Atlanta with facilities across the United States, Canada, and Europe. Stord is backed by top-tier investors including Kleiner Perkins, Franklin Templeton, Founders Fund, Strike Capital, Baillie Gifford, and Salesforce Ventures.

Stord is hiring a Director of Revenue Accounting & Assurance to own how we recognize, record and defend revenue across a business that blends warehousing, fulfillment, parcel and software. There is no dedicated revenue accounting team today, so you will own the function from day one: set the technical accounting position under ASC 606, and build the assurance program that gives our CFO, auditors and board confidence in every revenue number we report.

What You'll Do


Revenue accounting

  • Own the monthly and quarterly revenue close, including accruals for usage-based fulfillment, storage, transportation and parcel charges, and unbilled revenue.
  • Own ASC 606 analysis for new and amended customer contracts (MSAs, SOWs, pricing schedules): performance obligations, principal vs. agent, variable consideration, contract modifications and software vs. services allocation.
  • Own the revenue recognition policy, technical memos and the revenue recognition playbook, and keep them current as the product mix changes.
  • Own the reserves for customer credits (such as service and SLA credits), including the estimation methodology, monthly true-ups and support for auditors.
  • Own revenue analytics: revenue by customer, service line and contract, flux and trend analysis, and the metrics that explain revenue movement to Finance leadership.
  • Partner with Billing and Systems to make sure contract terms, rate cards and billing data flow accurately into the general ledger.

Assurance and Controls

  • Design, run and continuously improve the revenue control environment: SOX-readiness controls, reconciliations, billing-to-GL tie-outs and revenue completeness checks.
  • Build an assurance program that tests revenue before it reaches the auditors, using data and analytics to catch billing leakage, duplicate charges and rate-card variances.
  • Be the primary revenue contact for external auditors: PBC lists, walkthroughs, technical accounting positions and remediation of findings.
  • Prepare for audit, diligence and potential IPO readiness requirements, including disclosures and footnote support.

Leadership

  • Lead and scale the revenue accounting function: hands-on today, with any team build-out to be determined as business needs evolve.
  • Drive automation of revenue workflows, reconciliations and flux analysis with the finance systems stack.
  • Brief the CFO and Controller on revenue trends, risks and judgments.

What You'll Bring

  • Bachelor's degree in accounting or finance; active CPA required.
  • 10+ years of progressive accounting experience, including experience owning revenue accounting end to end, and leading or building a team where needed, with Big 4 or public company experience.
  • Experience with M&A integrations, including bringing acquired revenue streams, contracts and systems into the close and supporting purchase accounting.
  • Deep, hands-on command of ASC 606 for complex, multi-element contracts and usage-based or variable pricing.
  • Proven experience designing and operating revenue controls in a SOX or SOX-ready environment, and managing external audits.
  • Strong comfort with data: you can trace a number from the contract to the invoice to the ledger, and you use SQL or BI tools (or direct a team that does) to test it.
  • Experience with an ERP and billing stack (for example NetSuite and a usage-based billing system) and close management tools.
  • A track record of working hands-on in a lean function and, if a team is needed, building it and developing people, and communicating technical accounting clearly to non-accountants.
  • Sound judgment, high integrity and the confidence to say "not yet" when the support isn't there.

Nice to Have

  • Experience in 3PL, logistics, supply chain or marketplace businesses with high-volume, rate-card-driven billing.
  • Experience with a combination of services and SaaS revenue streams.
  • Prior involvement in an IPO, SPAC, or carve-out readiness effort.
  • Familiarity with automation and AI tools for close, flux analysis and reconciliation work.

Make banking a Fifth Third better®
We connect great people to great opportunities. Are you ready to take the next step? Discover a career in banking at Fifth Third Bank.

GENERAL FUNCTION

This role is responsible for driving Treasury Management revenue with a specialized focus on receivables solutions by partnering with Relationship Managers, Treasury Management Officers, and Product teams to design and deliver strategies that optimize how clients receive, reconcile, and apply incoming funds. Serving as a consultative expert, the position requires deep knowledge of accounts receivable workflows, ERP integrations, and payment data orchestration, leveraging APIs and automation to improve cash application and working capital efficiency.


The role combines technical acumen with strong client engagement, guiding organizations through receivables digitization and payments modernization while supporting complex, enterprise-level opportunities and influencing product innovation through market and client insights.

ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Demonstrate deep proficiency in Receivables solutions, including but not limited to lockbox, electronic payments, eLockbox, cash application automation, ACH, Wire and account validation.
  • Serve as a subject matter expert in AR workflows, including invoice presentment, payment receipt, reconciliation, and posting within ERP systems.
  • Develop and execute a plan to achieve revenue goals, with emphasis on complex, enterprise-level receivables opportunities.
  • Act as liaison between Sales, Product, Operations, and IT to deliver integrated solutions across bank platforms and client ERP/TMS environments.
  • Lead solution design discussions involving APIs, file transmission (e.g., EDI, BAI, XML), and data mapping/validation.
  • Provide consultative guidance on receivables digitization strategies, including migration from paper-based to electronic channels.
  • Analyze and articulate the impact of solutions on working capital, liquidity visibility, and operational efficiency.
  • Identify opportunities to enhance product capabilities based on client needs, ERP trends, and fintech innovation.
  • Provide frequent updates with Product Management Teams on new solution requests, feedback, and client needs
  • Represent Fifth Third in client presentations, industry forums, and strategic discussions related to payments modernization and receivables transformation.
  • Maintain pipeline visibility and drive opportunities through closure, particularly those involving multi-system integrations and complex implementations.

MINIMUM KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS AND ABILITIES

  • Undergraduate degree or equivalent experience required.
  • 5+ years of Treasury Management, Payments, Fintech, or ERP-related experience.
  • Demonstrated expertise in Receivables and Accounts Receivable (AR) processes within mid-market or large corporate environments.
  • Strong technical background integrating banking solutions with ERP systems (e.g., SAP, Oracle, NetSuite, Microsoft Dynamics).
  • Experience with APIs, host-to-host connectivity, file-based integrations (EDI, XML, CSV), and data transformation/mapping.
  • Deep understanding of cash application, remittance data challenges, and reconciliation workflows.
  • Ability to engage in technical and operational conversations with client stakeholders, including Treasury, IT, and Finance teams.
  • Experience working with or alongside fintech platforms (e.g., AR automation, payment aggregators, reconciliation tools) strongly preferred.
  • Proven consultative selling skills with ability to translate client workflows into actionable solution design.
  • Strong communication and presentation skills, including the ability to explain complex integrations in business terms.

🌟 Exciting Remote Opportunity! We're Hiring a Physician Recruiter! 🌟

Are you a resilient, highly communicative Physician Recruiter whose mission is to turn conversations into successful medical placements? We are seeking a full-time Physician Recruiter based in LATAM / PH / South Africa / Egypt / Ukraine to engage top doctors and build strong hospital submissions for a fast-growing locum tenens and healthcare staffing agency!

🚨 IMPORTANT - Watch this quick Loom video on how to get hired: 🔗

🗣️ C1 ENGLISH LEVEL IS REQUIRED. The selected candidate will be speaking strictly in English during their whole shift. 🎙️ PLEASE SUBMIT YOUR RESUME AND AUDIO RECORDING IN ENGLISH.

📋 Job Details at a Glance

  • Job Title: Physician Recruiter

  • Job ID: AZACEL5

  • Industry: Medical

  • Location: LATAM / PH / South Africa / Egypt / Ukraine

  • Job Status: Full Time (100% dedicated commitment required)

  • Work Schedule: Monday to Friday, 9:00am to 5:00pm (Eastern Time)

  • Salary: $2500 + Commission 💰

  • Target Start Date: ASAP 🚀

⚠️ PLEASE NOTE: We have a strict zero-tolerance policy for dual employment or misrepresenting experience. You must be 100% dedicated exclusively to this role.

🏢 About the Client The client is a fast-growing locum tenens and healthcare staffing agency that places physicians and advanced practice providers with hospitals across the U.S. The team pairs AI-powered tools with a personal, high-touch approach to fill urgent hospital needs quickly and keep doctors coming back.

💼 About the Role This is a physician recruiting role built around modern tools, not cold-call quotas. Our systems find and reach the right doctors, and your job is to turn those conversations into placements: engaging doctors by text, interviewing them, building strong submissions, and working with our credentialing, travel, and account teams to get them started. You will manage a high-volume candidate hunter schedule, acting as a phone-first recruiter who builds relationships through volume and consistency.

🎯 Key Responsibilities

  • 📞 High-Volume Outreach & Screening: Execute a phone-first daily strategy (50+ morning calls, 50+ afternoon calls), run personalized text campaigns, and conduct 15–30 minute qualification calls to confirm credentials, availability, and geographic preferences.

  • 📝 Candidate Submissions & CRM Management: Prepare clear, compelling candidate profiles for open hospital jobs. Log all activities, update statuses, and document detailed notes on preferences and objections in HubSpot.

  • 🤝 Cross-Team Collaboration & Pipeline Management: Work seamlessly with credentialing, travel, and account management teams to ensure every doctor starts on time. Stay in touch with candidates before, during, and after assignments to drive repeat work.

✅ Qualifications & Skills

⭐ Core Requirements:

  • Recruitment / Sales Experience: 1–3 years in high-volume recruiting, staffing, or inside sales—preferably in healthcare, travel nursing, or professional services.

  • Phone Confidence & Resilience: Comfortable making 100+ calls daily, managing your own time to hit daily targets, and resetting quickly after rejection.

  • Conversational Agility: Excellent spoken English with the ability to shift tone seamlessly, ask the right qualifying questions, and expertly handle objections to keep doors open.

🌟 Preferred Pluses:

  • Healthcare Expertise: Eagerness and coachability to learn healthcare-specific knowledge, including specialties, credentialing, state licensure, and locum tenens market dynamics.

  • Candidate-Centric Mindset: A genuine passion for helping people find opportunities and building rapid rapport over the phone.

🚀 Submit your application today and take the first step toward your next great opportunity!

🌎 LATAM Candidates: Don't forget to join our exclusive Facebook community for more updates and remote opportunities specifically for LATAM candidates: 🔗

raw.description:
The IT Data Science Principal provides leadership for enterprise data warehouse and artificial intelligence capabilities, ensuring the organization delivers trusted insights and scalable Data and AI solutions aligned with business strategy. This role leads people, platforms, and delivery practices across analytics engineering, BI, data science/ML, and GenAI enablement.

The Data Warehouse Engineer partners closely with Data & Analytics leadership, Information Security, Risk/Compliance, and business leaders to define priorities, manage teams and vendors, and embed governance for data, models, and AI use cases. This role drives measurable outcomes through roadmap execution, operating rhythms, and continuous improvement across Data Warehouse, analytics and AI delivery.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

  • Partner in developing enterprise analytics and AI roadmap, aligning use cases and investments to business strategy, value, and feasibility.
  • Establish outcome-based prioritization, intake, and funding recommendations for analytics, ML, and GenAI initiatives.
  • Define success metrics and benefits tracking for analytics/AI products and services (adoption, quality, cycle time, and business impact).
  • Lead, coach, and partner with multi-disciplinary teams (analytics engineers, BI developers/analysts, data scientists/ML engineers), including vendor/partner resources.
  • Set clear expectations for delivery quality, documentation, testing, and responsible AI practices; build development plans and career pathways.
  • Build a high-performing organization focused on customer value, operational excellence, and continuous learning across analytics and AI.
  • Partner with business and functional leaders to identify, shape, and deliver analytics and AI use cases; translate needs into a clear product backlog and release plan.
  • Serve as a trusted advisor on KPI design, experimentation, model performance, and adoption considerations (process, change management, training).
  • Communicate priorities, timelines, risk, and decisions clearly; establish operating rhythms and executive-ready status reporting.
  • Define and enforce standards for data products, semantic models, KPI definitions, model documentation, and lifecycle management.
  • Ensure analytics and AI solutions comply with enterprise security, privacy, data retention, and regulatory requirements; partner with InfoSec and Risk on controls.
  • Establish responsible AI practices (use-case review, human-in-the-loop where needed, monitoring for drift/bias, and incident response) and drive audit-ready evidence.
  • Identify and lead opportunities to modernize the analytics and AI platform (cloud data stack, self-service BI, feature/model stores, and GenAI tooling).
  • Implement scalable delivery and operations (CI/CD, automated testing, observability, cost management) to improve reliability, speed, and reuse across analytics and AI products.
  • Bring a strong understanding of the manufacturing domain, preferably windows manufacturing, to align data models and analytics solutions with plant, product, and order-management processes.
  • Apply advanced dimensional modeling (Kimball, Inmon, Data Vault) to design star schemas, snowflake models, fact/dimension tables, and enterprise data models.
  • Lead end-to-end ETL/ELT pipeline development, including ingestion, transformation, reconciliation, and loading pipelines using tools such as SSIS, ODI, and Matillion.
  • Drive data governance, data quality, and Master Data Management (MDM), including trust rules, match/merge logic, lineage analysis, DQ dashboards, reconciliation processes, and MDM rule sets.
  • Apply strong SQL engineering skills, writing complex SQL, PL/SQL, stored procedures, materialized views, and CTEs, with a focus on performance tuning.
  • Maintain data lineage, metadata management, and documentation, including data dictionaries, mapping documents, lineage tracking, and metadata-driven data warehouse frameworks.
  • Provide leadership on data warehouse projects and cross-functional collaboration, leading data engineering teams, managing stakeholders, gathering requirements, and delivering enterprise data warehouse solutions across multiple business units.
  • Bring cloud data warehousing exposure (Snowflake), including hands-on experience modernizing legacy warehouses, implementing Medallion architecture, and managing cloud-native data platforms.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Data Analytics, Business, or a related field.
  • 8 plus years of experience across enterprise analytics, business intelligence, and/or data science/ML delivery in a medium-to-large enterprise environment.
  • Proven experience leading teams and portfolios delivering analytics products and AI solutions, including vendor management, roadmap execution, and stakeholder governance.
  • Hands-on experience with Snowflake as an enterprise platform, including Cortex Analyst / Snowflake Intelligence for semantic-layer-driven natural language analytics, warehouse cost/performance tuning, and role-based access governance.
  • Experience designing and operating a medallion architecture (Bronze/Silver/Gold), with clear separation between raw replication, single-source-of-truth business definitions, and consumer-specific customizations.
  • Experience consolidating data from multiple heterogeneous ERP and legacy source systems (e.g., JDE, EBS, SAP based systems, and similar) into a governed enterprise platform, including reconciliation across inconsistent business definitions and buying-group/customer hierarchies.
  • Strong people leadership, coaching, and stakeholder management skills.
  • Ability to translate business strategy into analytics and reporting solutions.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced, matrixed environment.
  • Experience delivering AI/ML or GenAI solutions in production environments, including MLOps practices and cross-functional delivery.
  • Exposure to responsible AI/model risk management, enterprise data governance, and Agile/DevOps delivery methodologies.
  • Demonstrates practical AI literacy and the ability to thoughtfully use AI‑enabled tools to enhance productivity, decision‑making, and quality of work.

The US base salary range for this full-time position is $120,000-$140,000 + bonus + medical, dental, vision benefits starting day 1 + 401k and PTO. Our salary ranges are determined by role, level, and location. Individual pay is determined by work location and additional factors, including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training. Overview

Knowledge Services is seeking an Application Security Program Manager (remote) for a contract through the end of June 2027 (likely for extension) with the State of Maine Office of Technology.

  • Applicants are able to work remotely provided they reside in the EST or CST time zones
  • Please note that we cannot accept any candidates requiring C2C or those requiring sponsorship for a work visa.

Responsibilities

Application Security Program Manager Responsibilities:

•The Application Security Program Manager supports the Information Security Office in transitioning the State’s secure software development lifecycle (SSDLC) from a near-complete modernization project to a sustained operating program.

• The position coordinates the people, decisions, workflows, and measures needed to make application security practices workable across State technology teams.

• As initial transition tasks are completed, the manager shifts effort to adoption, performance, risk reduction, and continuous improvement across the broader application security portfolio.

• This is a cross-functional program management role.

• The manager works with Vulnerability Management, Security Architecture, Governance Risk and Compliance (GRC), Application Development, GitHub Governance, infrastructure and platform teams, agency product owners, and vendors.

• The manager drives follow-through, program adoption, and accountability across stakeholders and elevates decisions to the appropriate owner; specialist teams retain their established technical, product, and risk approval authority.

• This role requires the ability to oversee application security efforts across multiple teams and drive program improvements to strengthen the State of Maine’s security posture.

• We seek a self-motivated individual who thrives in fast-paced environments, seamlessly drives initiatives with multiple stakeholders, and has demonstrable experience in application security leadership.

WHAT WILL YOU DO?• Coordinate transition from project deliverables to owned processes, including named owners, documented handoffs, decision paths, service expectations, and a practical operating cadence.

• Maintain the program roadmap, priorities, dependencies, risks, and improvement backlog.• Work with accountable teams to validate and improve the application risk profile, security requirements, design review, scanning, finding triage, remediation, exception, and release workflows.

• Ensure guidance reflects real tools and different applications and vendor models.• Plan rollout waves with development and platform partners; support security champions, training, office hours, and clear developer-facing guidance.

• Gather feedback and remove barriers that prevent teams from applying the workflow consistently.• Help product and development teams turn findings into risk-ranked plans with owners, target dates, and closure evidence.

• Track coverage gaps, aging findings, blockers, and escalations while the responsible teams perform remediation and verification.• Facilitate working groups and leadership reviews, maintain an accurate responsibility model, and route design questions to Security Architecture and policy, exception, and risk decisions through GRC and authorized Information Security Office leadership.• Define useful measures with data owners; coordinate trustworthy reporting on application coverage, adoption, remediation, exceptions, and control performance. Use trends and team feedback to propose changes, report progress, and adjust priorities.• Coordinate related initiatives in repository governance, security tooling, platform integration, third-party application security, and developer enablement.

• Surface capacity, funding, and service dependencies; prepare concise options and recommendations for leadership.

WHAT MAKES THIS JOB UNIQUE?• Make a Difference: The scope of this position impacts the trajectory of application security in the State of Maine, ensuring the integrity and confidentiality of critical systems.• Show Your Strength: A chance to apply your expertise in application security and demonstrate your capabilities.• Experience in State Government: Opportunity to work within a large IT enterprise supporting critical State applications.• Selfless Service: Play a pivotal role in safeguarding the State’s critical systems, contributing to the public good by protecting citizens' data and ensuring the secure operation of essential government services.

raw.description:
Rithum™ is the world’s most trusted commerce network, accelerating how brands, suppliers, and retailers work together to deliver seamless e-commerce experiences. We provide an unmatched platform for brands and retailers, enabling them to accelerate growth, optimize operations across channels, scale product offerings and enhance margins.

Today, more than 40,000 companies trust Rithum to grow their business across hundreds of channels, representing over $50 billion in annual GMV. Using our commerce, marketing, and delivery solutions, our customers create optimized consumer shopping journeys from beginning to end.

Overview

As the Senior Growth Marketing Manager, you are responsible for spearheading Rithum’s digital advertising efforts and driving efficient client acquisition across online channels, with a strong emphasis on B2B Google search engine marketing (PPC). You own performance marketing strategy and execution end to end, partner with creative, product, and analytics teams, and are accountable for ROI, client acquisition, and revenue growth targets.

At Rithum, all team members are expected to leverage AI to work smarter, accelerate decision-making, automate repeatable work, and improve outcomes. You are encouraged to continuously identify opportunities to apply AI, data, and scalable processes to enhance productivity, drive innovation, and deliver greater value for our clients, partners, and teams while maintaining appropriate judgment, quality, security, and compliance.

Responsibilities

Paid Media Strategy & Execution

  • Spearhead digital advertising strategy, developing and executing performance marketing plans that drive efficient client acquisition, revenue growth, and ROI targets, with an emphasis on B2B Google search engine marketing (PPC).
  • Manage digital advertising campaigns end to end, including planning, implementation, execution, optimization, and performance analysis.
  • Execute and manage digital paid media plans for PPC and display on a real-time bidding platform.
  • Monitor and optimize advertising budgets to ensure efficient allocation of resources and maximize ROI.
  • Deep understanding of content strategy for paid media and be able to work cross-group collaboratively with the content team and/or agency to outline and deliver needs.

Search Platform Management

  • Manage, review, and perform daily account responsibilities for Google Ads and other search platforms.
  • Maintain and monitor keyword bids, daily and monthly budget caps, impression share, quality score, audience lists, and other key account metrics.
  • Manage the creation of large keyword lists and tie them consistently back to the overall SEM strategy.

Testing, Analytics & Optimization

  • Monitor KPIs including click-through rate, conversion rate across each funnel stage, cost per acquisition, return on ad spend, and lifetime value, and take proactive action to improve campaign performance.
  • Conduct A/B and multivariate testing on ad variations, messaging, and targeting parameters to maximize campaign effectiveness.
  • Use data-driven insights to identify optimization opportunities across audience targeting, ad creative, bidding strategies, and landing pages.
  • Conduct deep-dive analysis to answer specific business questions, uncover insights, and recommend improvements to digital marketing strategies and tactics.

Reporting, Collaboration & Innovation

  • Build digital marketing analytics dashboards and prepare weekly, monthly, and quarterly performance reports and presentations that communicate results, insights, and recommendations to key stakeholders.
  • Collaborate with creative, product, and analytics teams to align and integrate marketing efforts, and manage relationships with external agencies, vendors, and partners to support campaign execution.
  • Embed AI into campaign planning, audience analysis, creative testing, and reporting, and share effective prompts and workflows across teams.
  • Stay informed about industry trends, best practices, and emerging technologies in growth marketing, and incorporate innovative strategies into campaigns.

Qualifications

Minimum Qualifications

  • 8+ years of experience in B2B Google search, digital advertising, growth marketing, or a related field, driving measurable results against ROI targets.
  • Proficiency in digital advertising platforms, including Google Ads, Facebook Ads, LinkedIn Ads, Twitter Ads, and other relevant channels.
  • Hands-on experience with performance marketing tools such as Google Analytics, Google Tag Manager, and Facebook Business Manager.
  • Proficiency using analytics tools such as Excel, Salesforce, Looker Studio, Tableau, or Domo to drive business insights.
  • Experience measuring and monitoring performance of brand search keyword campaigns versus non-brand search campaigns.
  • Experience using AI tools (e.g., ChatGPT, Microsoft Copilot, Claude) to improve productivity through research, communication, analysis, documentation, automation, workflow optimization, and decision-making.

Preferred Qualifications

  • 10+ years of experience in digital advertising, growth marketing, or a related field.
  • Bachelor's degree in the applicable discipline or related field preferred.
  • Experience in a high-growth SaaS or technology environment, with deep knowledge of B2B client behaviors and growth marketing trends.
  • Experience creating targeted lists in Salesforce and leveraging 6sense.
  • Analytical mindset with the ability to interpret data, generate insights, and make data-driven decisions.
  • Project management skills, including prioritizing and managing multiple projects simultaneously in a fast-paced environment.
  • Strong communication skills and the ability to collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams and stakeholders.
  • Creative, problem-solving mindset with a track record of meeting or exceeding performance targets and KPIs.

Travel Required

Up to 10%

Other Duties

Please note that this job description is not designed to cover or contain a comprehensive listing of activities, duties or responsibilities required of the employee for this job. Duties, responsibilities, and activities may change at any time with or without notice.

What it’s like to work at Rithum

When you join Rithum, you can expect to work with smart risk-takers, courageous collaborators, and curious minds.

As part of the Rithum team, you are valued, supported, and included. Guided by a transparent culture and accessible, approachable leadership, we offer career opportunities aligned to your ambitions and talents. To ensure work and life balance works for you, we also offer an array of resources to support you and your families, including comprehensive benefits and wellness plans.

At Rithum you will:

  • Achieve work-life balance through remote-first working conditions, generous time off, and wellness days.

We believe in transparency and fairness in our compensation practices.

For this position, the expected base pay range is: $130,000-$190,000 per year.

This range represents the base pay for the role across all U.S. locations and is determined based on market data, internal equity, and experience. Final compensation may vary depending on geographic location, skills, and relevant experience.In addition to base pay, we offer a discretionary bonus for non-sales roles, a comprehensive benefits package, and, where applicable, sales incentives.

For this position, the expected discretionary bonus is 12% of the annual base salary.

Benefits

raw.excerpt: Grow our AI image service. The roleWe are Drop Zero Digital, a lifecycle marketing agency.
raw.description:
Grow our AI image service.

The role

We are Drop Zero Digital, a lifecycle marketing agency. We are hiring one person who is good at deciding. Our AI image service is our fastest-growing service, and whichever area you own, you will be helping it grow.

You will own one named area. Which one is decided during the trial rather than now, based on what you turn out to be strong at. It will be one of these two:

  1. The hiring machine. How we find, screen and hire people. Running the funnel end to end, sourcing, chasing, scheduling, keeping our tracker honest, and telling us when the process itself is broken.
  2. Client delivery operations. How work gets planned, briefed, chased and shipped for our clients. Holding timelines, briefing the team properly, and making sure nothing quietly stalls.

Both are the same job underneath: you notice what has slipped, you decide what to do, and you close it without being asked.

This is not an assistant job and it is not a coordinator job. You will make real calls every day, and you will be judged on the quality of those calls rather than on how much you got through.

We are building a team of people who decide well without being managed. If you want to be told what to do each morning, this job is not for you.

What we are looking for

  1. You make decisions and you own them, including the ones that go wrong.
  2. You can tell which calls are yours and which are not, and you get that split right in both directions.
  3. You take feedback as information and change, without folding on something you have good reason to believe.
  4. You get better fast. We would rather have someone at seventy percent climbing than someone flat at eighty five.
  5. You spot when something is failing and say so, including when it is our process and not your work.
  6. You write clearly and honestly, especially about problems.

On experience

We do not ask for a number of years and we do not screen on your CV, because we decide on what you do in the trial.

Whatever employment you do list, we verify: employer, dates, title and paid status, evidenced by contract and payslips, in one exchange. You need to have held a full-time job at some point in the last 12 months. Beyond that there is no minimum, and a short history costs you nothing here. Misrepresenting the history you do have is disqualifying. Tell us the true version and you will not be penalised for it.

How the process works, and we tell you all of it now

  1. Application with a short Loom video.
  2. A short written step: your internet speed, your computer, and a few questions in your own words.
  3. Aptitude tests, with a published floor.
  4. A recorded video interview. One take, no re-records. We verify the work history you've told us about.
  5. A short call with the founder.
  6. A paid trial of six to eight weeks doing the real job.

The trial is where the decision actually gets made, including which of the two areas you end up owning. From the first week you will be making calls on live work, and we will tell you straight how each one landed. It is paid from day one: half rate for the first two weeks while you find your feet, full rate from week three onward, and a completion payment when you finish the trial, whether or not we hire you. If we stop early, you are paid for the days you worked.

Requirements

    1. Full time once hired, and this is your only job. During the paid trial you work 4 hours a day with us, 2 of them at a fixed time inside our working day, and you can keep your current job. If you pass, you give notice and join us full time within 30 days.
    2. Reliable internet, at least 30 Mbps down and 5 Mbps up, tested live with us.
    3. Strong written English.
    4. Based in Bulgaria.
    5. You track your working time with our time tracking tool from day one.

Benefits

1500 USD per month on hire, set by responsibility and demonstrated capability, not by how long you have worked.

Pass your 90-day review and your pay goes up by 50 percent. The 90 days count from the day you start full time.

On top of that:

  1. A one-month annual bonus.
  2. 15 days of paid leave a year, rising with tenure, plus your own country's public holidays.
  3. Paid sick leave.
  4. A health allowance.
  5. A coworking allowance.

Responsibility and pay move quickly here for people who earn them. Authority over decisions that reach a client moves slowly and deliberately, and it is earned on a track record rather than on a good first month. We would rather tell you that now than have you discover it in month two.

About OneArc

We believe in saving lives through simulation. We build high-fidelity, repeatable, and accessible virtual training environments that prepare NATO-allied militaries and defense organizations for real-world scenarios. We make mission-critical military simulations, not commercial video games, and our work directly impacts global readiness.

We are looking for a Senior Software Engineer to help build the distributed services that drive our real-time simulation systems. You will lead technical design efforts, ensure scalable cloud resource usage, and shape the architecture that powers our core training platforms.

raw.description:
As an Outreach Specialist on the ACCESS Team, you will play a vital, frontline role in driving patient participation, enrollment, and activation for the Aledade Access Program. Supporting the CMS Innovation Center’s ACCESS (Advancing Chronic Care with Effective, Scalable Solutions) model, Aledade is building an agentic AI patient engagement platform designed to detect, manage, and empower patients with cardio-kidney-metabolic (CKM) disease, in close partnership with primary care practices.

Operating in a dynamic, remote environment, you will serve as the crucial human connection when automated workflows require hands-on support. In this role, you will handle daily multimodal patient outreach, guide device onboarding, and manage operational queues to ensure seamless, patient-centered care. By bridging gaps when automated systems require intervention, assisting patients with technical and clinical tasks, and coordinating rapid triage, you will help uphold exceptional service standards within a high-accountability, innovative care model.

Primary Duties

    Patient Outreach & Engagement

  • Conduct outbound and inbound outreach calls when automated workflows fail or require manual intervention.

  • Assist patients with onboarding, clinical metric collection (e.g., height, weight, BP), and blood pressure monitor troubleshooting.

  • Deliver engagement nudges to prompt completion of outstanding care management tasks and support ongoing care continuity.

  • Manage high-volume inbound queue requests, SMS fallout, patient inquiries, and onboarding/enrollment support.

  • Process webform exceptions and execute timely clinical triage handoffs to RNs and Pharmacists as needed.

  • Meet core operational benchmarks for call volume, contact rates, conversion, and device onboarding while maintaining accurate documentation and HIPAA compliance.

  • Provide timely, clear, and professional communication regarding follow-ups, care plans, and practice policies.

    • Operational Support

  • Accurately document all patient interactions and maintain up-to-date records in care systems (EHRs/CRMs).

  • Track and report patient engagement metrics, participating in workflow testing to refine operations and identify improvements.

  • Respond promptly to time-sensitive updates, adjusting priorities to address critical outreach needs immediately.

  • Maintain high energy, professional empathy, and resilience during high-volume shifts and frequent patient rejections.

  • Collaborate cross-functionally to advance patient engagement strategies and organizational goals.

Minimum Qualifications

  • High school diploma or equivalent

  • Minimum of 2 years of experience in healthcare outreach, care coordination, or telephonic patient engagement.

  • Proven track record in high-volume environment with the ability to meet performance metrics (i.e. Activation, conversion, etc.).

  • Regular and predictable attendance

  • Excellent interpersonal, verbal, and written communication skills.

  • Strong organizational and documentation abilities.

  • Detail-oriented with the ability to manage multiple priorities efficiently.

  • Ability to work shifts between 8:00 AM – 8:00 PM EST, including evenings and Saturdays as needed.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in a remote call center environment.

  • Familiarity with value-based care models and Medicare Advantage.

  • Experience with care management software and Electronic Health Record (EHR) systems.

Physical Requirements

  • Prolonged periods of sitting at a desk and working on a computer.

Who We Are:

Aledade PBC, a public benefit corporation, exists to empower the most transformational part of our health care landscape - independent primary care. We were founded in 2014, and since then, we've become the largest network of independent primary care in the country - helping practices, health centers and clinics deliver better care to their patients and thrive in value-based care. Additionally, by creating value-based contracts across a wide variety of health plans, we aim to flip the script on the traditional fee-for-service model. Our work strengthens continuity of care, aligns incentives and ensures primary care physicians are paid for what they do best - keeping patients healthy. If you want to help create a health care system that is good for patients, good for practices and good for society - and if you're eager to join a collaborative, inclusive and remote-first culture - you've come to the right place.

What Does This Mean for You?

At Aledade PBC, you will be part of a creative culture that is driven by a passion for tackling complex issues with respect, open-mindedness and a desire to learn. You will collaborate with team members who bring a wide range of experiences, interests, backgrounds, beliefs and achievements to their work - and who are all united by a shared passion for public health and a commitment to the Aledade mission.
In addition to time off to support work-life balance and enjoyment, we offer the following comprehensive benefits package designed for the overall well-being of our team members:
Flexible work schedules and the ability to work remotely are available for many roles
Health, dental and vision insurance paid up to 80% for employees, dependents and domestic partners
Robust time-off plan (21 days of PTO in your first year)
Two paid volunteer days and 11 paid holidays
12 weeks paid parental leave for all new parents
Six weeks paid sabbatical after six years of service
Educational Assistant Program and Clinical Employee Reimbursement Program
401(k) with up to 4% match
Stock options
And much more!
At Aledade PBC, we don’t just accept differences, we celebrate them! We strive to attract, develop and retain highly qualified individuals representing the diverse communities where we live and work. Aledade is committed to creating a diverse environment and is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. Employment policies and decisions at Aledade are based on merit, qualifications, performance and business needs. All qualified candidates will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, race, color, national origin, gender (including pregnancy, childbirth or medical conditions related to pregnancy or childbirth), gender identity or expression, religion, physical or mental disability, medical condition, legally protected genetic information, marital status, veteran status, or sexual orientation.

raw.description:
Our Purpose

At SentinelOne, we are driven by a clear purpose: to give the advantage to those who secure our future. As AI reshapes how organizations build, operate, and innovate, the responsibility to protect them becomes more critical than ever. When you join SentinelOne, your work helps protect global enterprises, critical infrastructure, and the technologies shaping tomorrow. If you are motivated by meaningful challenges and want your impact to be real, measurable, and global, you will find purpose here.

About Us

SentinelOne is a company at the intersection of AI and security, pioneering a new operating model for cybersecurity. Our AI-native platform unifies protection across endpoint, cloud, identity, data, and AI systems to deliver autonomous detection and response with clarity and speed. By combining real-time analytics, intelligent automation, and a unified data foundation, we reduce noise, simplify complexity, and empower security teams to focus on what truly matters.

Our teams are builders, problem-solvers, and innovators committed to shaping the future of security. If you are excited to solve hard problems alongside talented, mission-driven people, we invite you to help us build a safer future for humanity.

What Are We Looking For?

We’re looking for people who are relentlessly curious and committed to continuous learning. AI is reshaping every function across our business, and we enable every team member, regardless of role or level, to build fluency in AI tools and concepts. Those who thrive here actively seek out new solutions, experiment thoughtfully, and apply what they learn to drive better, faster, smarter outcomes.

As an Account Manager, Client Development & Renewals, you will be tasked with owning a book of existing customer accounts and driving both renewal retention and expansion revenue within them. This is not a transactional renewals seat; it is a growth-first role where renewal is the floor, not the goal, and you will protect the base by keeping renewals healthy and on time and grow it by uncovering and closing whitespace, running consultative upsell and cross-sell conversations, and turning satisfied customers into expanding ones. You will sit within the Client Development / Renewals organization and partner closely with Account Executives, Customer Success Managers, and Sales Engineering, in a role built for a rep who is driven to outgrow a base they know well, own their numbers, and earn a path to strategic accounts or AE-track roles through expansion results.

What Will You Do?

Primary responsibilities include:

  • Own a portfolio of existing accounts, carrying a dual quota of renewal retention and expansion bookings (upsell/cross-sell); identify whitespace across the SentinelOne product portfolio and run consultative expansion conversations, leading with customer use cases and outcomes, not just quotes; spot expansion triggers early, including new use cases, org growth, underutilized licenses ready to convert, and competitive displacement openings; build repeatable account plans with your CSM and SE partners that map multi-year growth, not just the next renewal.
  • Manage renewals end to end, from early quoting and multi-threading through negotiation and on-time close; keep renewal timelines definitive and forecasts predictable across your book, so the primary focus remains on whitespace and expansion with your accounts; handle commercial negotiation on your accounts, including multi-year commitments, with support on the most complex deals.
  • Identify churn and downgrade risk early by watching deployment health, usage, support signals, and sentiment across your accounts; run save motions on at-risk accounts, pulling in CSM, Support, and leadership when needed; flag overdeployment/downgrade exposure and get ahead of it before it hits the renewal.
  • Own an accurate, transparent forecast across both renewal and expansion pipeline for your book; keep Salesforce and CPQ/quoting tools current, with accurate stages and a renewal/expansion pipeline you can defend; structure and close deals cleanly, using approved pricing and quote automation.
  • Partner with CSMs on account coverage so there is no gap or overlap, and with AEs and SEs on expansion opportunities; partner with our Channel/MSSP partners on renewal continuity and baseline growth for partner-managed accounts; bring the customer's voice back to Product and the broader team, including what is working, what is stuck, and where the next opportunity is.

What Skills and Knowledge Will You Bring?

Ideal candidates will have:

  • 3 to 5 years in renewals, account management, or a customer-facing sales role, with upsell/cross-sell closing experience on your record, ideally in SaaS or cybersecurity.
  • A track record of hitting or beating quota, including driving net revenue retention above 100 percent on your own book (expansion outpacing churn), not just renewal completion.
  • Proven experience running consultative upsell/cross-sell motions and identifying and closing whitespace within an existing customer base.
  • Comfort managing multi-stakeholder conversations and negotiations, with direct experience negotiating with senior/economic buyers.
  • A risk-aware instinct: you notice the early signals of churn or downgrade and act before renewal time.
  • Strong forecasting discipline and CRM hygiene; hands-on with Salesforce and CPQ/quote tools.
  • Strong communication and organization, curiosity about customer use-cases and the product, and a habit of opening expansion conversations without being prompted.
  • Exposure to Channel/MSSP or 2-tier GTM models is a plus, not a requirement.

Why SentinelOne?

AI is redefining how the world operates and rewriting the rules of security in real time, and SentinelOne was built for this moment. From day one, we architected an AI-native platform designed to operate at machine speed, not as an add-on to legacy systems but as the foundation itself. If you want to build where innovation and impact move together, this is that place.

We invest in our Sentinels with comprehensive, competitive benefits designed to support you and your family:

Equity & Rewards

  • Restricted Stock Units (RSUs)
  • Employee Stock Purchase Plan (ESPP)

Time Off & Wellbeing

  • Flexible time off
  • Paid company holidays and paid sick time
  • Gender-neutral parental leave
  • Grandparent leave

Insurance & Financial Security

Votre futur environnement de travail :

Rejoignez CIMPA et participez à une formidable Aventure Humaine et Technologique, au cœur de la Transformation Digitale !

Vous collaborez en interne avec des équipes pluridisciplinaires (consultants, management, direction industrielle) pour accompagner nos clients grands comptes industriels.

Et si vous rejoigniez nos équipes en tant qu’Architecte solution PLM Windchill ?

  • Votre objectif sera de proposer les solutions fonctionnelles les plus adaptées afin de répondre aux besoins métier
  • Pour cela, vous collaborez avec l’équipe cadrage fonctionnel afin de comprendre les besoins métier et d’y associer une étude de faisabilité. Ainsi vous réalisez une analyse de gaps puis vous établissez une liste des solutions envisageables
  • Vous réalisez une analyse d’impact de chaque solution et comparez les solutions pour trouver celle qui sera présentée aux différents acteurs (sponsor, métiers, cadrage fonctionnel et technique, urbaniste)
  • Vous devrez aussi échanger avec les développeurs en cas de besoin d’éclaircissement ou bien pour corriger une non-faisabilité de la solution fonctionnelle

Vos missions :
Afin de pouvoir mener à bien cette mission, vous devrez réaliser ces différentes tâches :

  • Accompagner et challenger la définition des besoins PLM de manière agnostique
  • Rédaction et appréhension des besoins métiers / fonctionnels
  • Définition et structuration des hypothèses globales
  • Recherche et proposition de solution fonctionnelle adaptée aux besoins
  • Gap analysis OOTB vs besoins
  • Analyse de faisabilité / risques
  • POCs fonctionnels OOTB
  • Ecriture spécification, process méthodes et Test dossiers
  • Définition et support à la conduite du changement
  • Préparation et réalisation de démonstrations
  • Support aux Key users et utilisateurs finaux

Ainsi, vous pouvez en fonction de vos motivations, intégrer des projets variés et / ou connaître une évolution en termes de responsabilités.

Parlons de vous :

  • Vous êtes bon communicant/e et êtes reconnu/e pour votre capacité d’adaptation et votre organisation?
  • Vous avez d'excellentes connaissances du PLM PTC Windchill?
  • Vous êtes familier/e des échanges avec les sponsors ?
  • Vous êtes un leader au sein des équipes pour atteindre le succès des projets.
  • De formation supérieure Bac+5 de type Ecole d’Ingénieur/Informatique, ou formation équivalente, vous justifiez d’au moins deux ans d’expérience en tant qu’Architecte PLM?

Alors ce poste est fait pour vous !

S’appuyant sur son savoir-faire des produits complexes de haute technologie, la vocation de CIMPA est de fournir à ses clients un avantage concurrentiel en améliorant l'efficacité opérationnelle tout au long du cycle de vie du produit. Complexité technologique, long cycle de de vie, exigences de sûreté et sécurité, chaine logistique multi-dimensionnelle… : nous nous engageons pour transformer, optimiser et renforcer l’approche de conception et production industrielles et les systèmes d’information associés.

Nos services complets et modulaires autour du Product Lifecycle Management (PLM) couvrent chaque étape du cycle de vie du produit : la conception du produit, sa fabrication, l'entrée en service jusqu’à la maintenance et le support. La connaissance du métier industriel de nos clients conjuguée à notre savoir-faire dans les technologies de l’information fait notre force. Nous intervenons auprès des différentes Directions et Fonctions qui suivent l’évolution du produit.

CIMPA s'adresse à l'industrie manufacturière, ainsi qu'aux fournisseurs des grands donneurs d’ordre, opérateurs, partenaires et clients, dans le secteur de l’aéronautique, de la défense, de l’énergie et du transport.

  • Avoir le goût du challenge pour réussir vos missions à temps,
  • Développer votre autonomie et votre sens de l’initiative,

  • Profiter d’un encadrement bienveillant.

The world is how we shape it.

Position Summary

Arctera is seeking an elite, highly motivated Principal Account Executive to drive net-new logo acquisition and revenue expansion across highly regulated industries (Financial Services, Healthcare, Pharma, Energy, and Government).

In this strategic role, you will own the entire end-to-end sales lifecycle—from initial strategic targeting through complex technical evaluations to final contract negotiation. You will be responsible for positioning Arctera's enterprise-grade information governance, AI compliance, risk management, and cybersecurity SaaS solutions directly to C-suite and executive buyers.


Key Responsibilities

  • Full-Cycle Revenue Ownership: Own, manage, and close a highly strategic enterprise pipeline to consistently meet or exceed quarterly and annual ARR targets.
  • C-Suite Engagement: Identify, engage, and build trusted-advisor relationships with key executive stakeholders, including Chief Compliance Officers, CIOs, CISOs, General Counsels, and Chief Risk Officers.
  • Complex Deal Orchestration: Lead multi-stakeholder, long-cycle enterprise sales processes ($500K-$1M+ ARR) involving rigorous technical assessments, security reviews, and legal/procurement negotiations.
  • Strategic Account Planning: Collaborate with Solutions Engineers, Product, and Marketing teams to execute highly customized account-based sales campaigns into Fortune 500 prospects.
  • Value-Based Selling: Conduct deep discovery and deliver tailored, high-impact business cases demonstrating ROI, risk mitigation, and regulatory compliance (e.g., SEC, FINRA, GDPR).
  • Accurate Forecasting: Maintain an exceptionally clean, data-driven sales pipeline and provide accurate weekly/monthly revenue forecasts within Salesforce.

Required Qualifications

  • 10+ years of quota-carrying, direct enterprise software (SaaS) sales experience. 5+ years selling enterprise archiving or communications surveillance solutions.
  • Proven Track Record: A documented history of overachieving $1M+ ARR quotas and closing complex enterprise-grade deals.
  • Regulated Industry Experience: Demonstrated success selling into complex, highly regulated verticals (e.g., Finance, Healthcare, Legal).
  • Exceptional Communication: World-class verbal, written, and presentation skills with a natural ability to command a room of executive decision-makers.
  • Independent Execution: Highly disciplined, self-motivated, and capable of managing a complex pipeline autonomously in a fully remote environment.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Domain Expertise: Prior experience selling information governance, regulatory compliance, data archiving, eDiscovery, or cybersecurity solutions.
  • Advanced Tech Stack Proficiency: Deep experience leveraging CRM and sales enablement tools:
    • Salesforce / Oracle CRM / HubSpot
    • Gong, LinkedIn Sales Navigator
    • ZoomInfo, Outreach / Salesloft
  • Contract Negotiation: Strong expertise navigating complex corporate legal structures, enterprise master service agreements (MSAs), and data processing agreements (DPAs).

Desired Competencies

  • Enterprise Closing: Proven ability to drive complex contracts across the finish line.
  • Value & Solution Selling: Selling on business outcomes and ROI rather than features.
  • Executive Presence: Ability to establish immediate credibility with C-Suite leaders.
  • Strategic Prospecting: Self-sourcing enterprise pipeline alongside BDR support.
  • Advanced Negotiation: Navigating procurement, legal objections, and pricing structures.
  • Analytical Thinking: Evaluating complex customer environments to align technical solutions.
  • Resilience & Grit: High emotional intelligence, tenacity, and stamina to win long, competitive sales cycles.

Cloud Software Group is one of the world’s largest cloud solution providers, serving more than 100 million users around the globe. When you join Cloud Software Group, you are making a difference for real people, each of whom count on our suite of cloud-based products to get work done — from anywhere. Sumitomo Pharma Co., Ltd., is a global pharmaceutical company based in Japan with operations in the U.S. (Sumitomo Pharma America, Inc.), focused on addressing patient needs in oncology, urology, women's health, rare diseases, cell & gene therapies and CNS. With several marketed products and a diverse pipeline of early- to late-stage investigational assets, we aim to accelerate discovery, research, and development to bring novel therapies to patients sooner. For more information on SMPA, visit our website or follow us on LinkedIn.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:

Lead, manage, coach, and support Medical Information colleagues, including workload prioritization, performance guidance, professional development, and delivery of high-quality Medical Information services.


  • Provide strategic and operational oversight for Medical Information activities within assigned therapeutic area(s), ensuring accurate, timely, balanced, and compliant responses to unsolicited Medical Information requests.
  • Serve as a subject matter expert for assigned therapeutic area(s), maintaining in-depth knowledge of product data, disease states, treatment guidelines, labeling, literature, and relevant internal information.
  • Develop, update, and maintain Medical Information resources, including response documents, handling guides, scientific content, and other materials used to support Medical Information inquiries.
  • Evaluate scientific literature, clinical guidelines, data insights, and inquiry trends to identify scientific gaps and inform clear, appropriate, and medically accurate content.
  • Own and maintain Medical Information standard operating procedures, work instructions, controlled documents, and the Medical Information Communications Management Plan, ensuring alignment with SMPA requirements, call center vendor processes, and industry best practices.
  • Oversee Medical Information operational processes, workflows, governance, documentation, and logistics to support efficient, compliant, and inspection-ready operations.
  • Manage, train, and provide quality oversight of the Medical Information call center vendor, including therapeutic-area support, vendor performance, quality assurance, and issue resolution.
  • Coordinate Medical Information operational readiness for product launches, lifecycle management activities, congresses, scientific meetings, organizational changes, and call center training needs.
  • Provide Medical Information congress planning support for assigned therapeutic area(s), including coordination of booth staffing, staff training, and related Medical Information activities at designated scientific meetings.
  • Participate in the medical review of medical and promotional materials, as needed, to ensure scientific accuracy, balance, and compliance.
  • Partner cross-functionally with Medical Affairs, Regulatory, Legal, Quality, Pharmacovigilance, Commercial, and other stakeholders to align Medical Information activities, identify opportunities for improvement, and implement strategic solutions.
  • Monitor operational metrics, inquiry trends, and process performance to identify improvement opportunities and implement best practices that enhance consistency, efficiency, quality, and customer experience.

PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE/QUALIFICATIONS:

Key Core Competencies

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • People leadership, team management, coaching, and mentoring capabilities.
  • Strong relationship-building, collaboration, and stakeholder management skills.
  • Strategic thinking, sound decision-making, and effective problem-solving abilities.
  • Excellent organizational, prioritization, time-management, and planning skills.
  • Highly self-motivated and detail-oriented, with the ability to manage multiple priorities and deliver high-quality work on schedule.
  • Ability to collaborate effectively across functional areas, build alignment among stakeholders, and maintain a solution-oriented mindset.
  • Innovative, forward-thinking, pragmatic, efficient, and results focused.
  • Demonstrated accountability, follow-through, and ability to lead projects effectively and on schedule.
  • Ability to travel, as needed.

Education and Experience

  • Bachelor’s degree in a related field required.
  • Minimum of a Master's degree in pharmacy or related science. Advanced degree in related science preferred (PharmD, etc.).
  • Healthcare professional license preferred.
  • Minimum 10+ years of relevant experience in biotech or pharmaceutical industry.

Travel Requirements:

Primarily remote role with periodic on-site meetings in office. Must be able to travel domestically and internationally as needed.



Mental/Physical Requirements:

Fast-paced environment handling multiple demands is involved. Must be able to exercise appropriate judgment as necessary. Requires a high level of initiative and independence. Excellent written and oral communication skills required. Requires ability to use a personal computer for extended periods of time.

The base salary range for this role is

$193,400.00 - $241,800.00

Base salary is part of our total rewards package which also includes the opportunity for merit-based salary increases, short incentive plan participation, eligibility for our 401(k) plan, medical, dental, vision, life and disability insurances and leaves provided in line with your work state. Our robust time-off policy includes flexible paid time off, 11 paid holidays plus additional time off for a shut-down period during the last week of December, 80 hours of paid sick time upon hire and each year thereafter. Total compensation, including base salary to be offered, will depend on elements unique to each candidate, including candidate experience, skills, education and other factors permitted by law.

Aus Fachwissen Lernangebote schaffen, die in der Pflege ankommen

Als Pflegepädagoge E Learning & Webinarentwicklung (m/w/d) entwickelst du digitale Fortbildungsangebote, die Pflegefachkräfte in ihrem Arbeitsalltag wirklich weiterbringen. Deutschlandweit remote verbindest du pflegepädagogische Expertise mit zeitgemäßer Wissensvermittlung und gestaltest Lernformate, die verständlich, relevant und praxisnah sind.

Was du bewirkst

  • Entwickelst digitale Fortbildungsangebote, die Pflegefachkräfte gezielt bei den Herausforderungen ihres Berufsalltags unterstützen
  • Übersetzt komplexe Fachthemen in Lerninhalte, die verständlich sind und sich direkt in die Praxis übertragen lassen
  • Konzipierst Webinare, digitale Lernstrecken und E Learning Inhalte, die Wissen nachhaltig vermitteln und zum Austausch anregen
  • Begleitest neue Bildungsangebote von der ersten Idee über das didaktische Konzept bis zur konkreten Umsetzung
  • Erstellst Drehbücher und pädagogische Konzepte für synchrone und asynchrone Lernformate
  • Führst Webinare und digitale Lernveranstaltungen durch und sorgst dafür, dass aus Zuhören echtes Verstehen wird
  • Entwickelst bestehende Inhalte gemeinsam mit dem pädagogischen Team weiter und bringst dabei deine eigene fachliche Perspektive ein
  • Berücksichtigst fachliche Anforderungen und Anerkennungsvorgaben im Fortbildungsumfeld, ohne dabei die Lernenden aus dem Blick zu verlieren
  • Lernst die bestehenden Produkte sowie die Bedürfnisse der Kund:innen kennen und entwickelst daraus Bildungsangebote mit echtem Praxisbezug

Was du mitbringst

  • Verfügst über ein abgeschlossenes Masterstudium im Bereich Pflegepädagogik oder in einer vergleichbaren relevanten Fachrichtung
  • Besitzt eine abgeschlossene Qualifikation als Praxisanleiter:in
  • Bringst praktische Erfahrung aus dem Pflegeumfeld mit und kennst die Anforderungen, die Pflegefachkräfte im Arbeitsalltag begleiten
  • Hast Erfahrung in der Konzeption und Entwicklung von Bildungsangeboten
  • Bereitest Fachwissen didaktisch fundiert, zielgruppengerecht und verständlich auf
  • Vermittelst Inhalte souverän in digitalen Live Formaten und schaffst einen Austausch auf Augenhöhe
  • Entwickelst Konzepte und Lerninhalte eigenständig von Grund auf und bringst sie strukturiert in die Umsetzung

Ein Plus, aber kein Muss

  • Bringst Erfahrung in der Fortbildung und Weiterbildung von Pflegefachkräften mit
  • Kennst die Entwicklung digitaler und asynchroner Lernformate

Das zeichnet dich aus

  • Pädagogisches Gespür Du erkennst, welche Inhalte Menschen wirklich weiterbringen und wie aus Fachwissen ein nachhaltiges Lernerlebnis entsteht
  • Kommunikationsstärke Du vermittelst auch anspruchsvolle Themen verständlich, souverän und mit einem guten Gefühl für deine Zielgruppe
  • Gestaltungsfreude Du wartest nicht auf die perfekte Vorlage, sondern entwickelst Ideen, strukturierst sie und bringst sie ins Ziel
  • Eigenverantwortung Du organisierst deine Themen selbstständig, setzt klare Prioritäten und behältst auch bei mehreren Konzepten den Überblick

Unsere Benefits für dich

  • Du entscheidest: Hansefit, EGYM Wellpass, Kinderbetreuung oder JobRad – wir unterstützen Dich flexibel mit einem Zuschuss von bis zu 60 € monatlich. Zusätzlich profitierst Du von exklusiven Vergünstigungen mit Corporate Benefits
  • Du kannst auf uns zählen – TELUS Health stärkt Dich mit individuellen Angeboten für Deine mentale Gesundheit
  • Wir gestalten Deine Entwicklung – mit LinkedIn Learning hast Du Zugriff auf inspirierende Lerninhalte und praxisnahe Weiterbildung, die Dich wirklich voranbringen
  • Wir denken an Deine Zukunft – mit unserem Aktienkaufprogramm kannst Du direkt am Unternehmenserfolg teilhaben, und durch unsere betriebliche Altersvorsorge (bAV) sicherst Du Dir finanzielle Stabilität für die Zukunft
  • Du hast 30 Tage Urlaubsanspruch, um ausreichend Zeit für Erholung und persönliche Interessen zu haben

smartAware® ist Teil der MEDIFOX DAN Gruppe, mit einem Team von Experten arbeiten wir an der Fort- und Weiterbildungsplattform der Zukunft und setzen neue Standards – digital denken, digital handeln. Unsere Vision: Unseren Kunden einfache und effiziente Produkte und Dienstleistungen für die Fort- und Weiterbildung in der Pflegebranche – von der Planung bis zum Nachweis – anzubieten.     · Become involved in developing the standard macro library and take responsibility to implement standard macros within a study

    · Identify macros requirements, communicate and perform training

    · Implement and coordinate development and maintenance of PHASTAR standard specifications
    · Be an SDTM and ADAM expert providing consultancy, advice and training

    · Ensure the principles in the PHASTAR checklist are followed rigorously

    · Act as a Lead programmer on multiple studies and project, ensuring quality and timely delivery

    · Responsible for study level resources
    · Attend and input to company resourcing meeting
    · Point of contact for programming issues for the team, proactively ensuring everything is working cohesively
    · Persuade stakeholders to follow best practice within a trial

    · Identify areas where new processes are required
    · Create, review and update processes and SOPs

raw.description:
Lumen is the trusted network for the AI‑powered world, connecting people, data, and applications through our expansive fiber network and connected ecosystem. We enable secure, high‑performance connectivity across cloud, edge, and AI workloads for enterprises, governments, and communities.

At Lumen, you’ll work on infrastructure customers rely on today and build for what’s next, where performance, security, and resilience matter.

This is a high accountability environment where bold ideas drive real innovation for our customers, partners, and industry. The work is challenging, expectations are clear, and trust is built into how we operate. If you’re ready to take ownership, deliver meaningful impact, and help shape the future of AI‑ready connectivity, join us today.

The Role

Driving Technology Adoption, Consumption, and Growth

Lumen is evolving how we sell by bringing deeper technology fluency, consultative discovery, and business-outcome conversations into every customer engagement. Our Acceleration and Growth team offers multiple distinct opportunities to help shape this journey while building your own expertise as a technology-focused seller. This is an opportunity to be part of meaningful change - help define how we engage, advise, and support customers as their technology needs become more complex. If you are energized by building trusted relationships, shaping a more consultative customer experience, and making a visible impact as our sales approach evolves, this role offers the chance to help lead that change.

As an Account Director Senior Large Enterprise Majors, you will own growth across large, important, and potentially global enterprise accounts by translating customer business priorities into measurable outcomes enabled by Lumen’s network, cloud, security, managed services, and orchestration portfolio.

As the Account Director Senior, you operate independently from acquisition through modernization, activation, adoption, consumption, and expansion. You set account strategy, shape and negotiate commercial terms, mobilize cross-functional resources, and advise executive stakeholders. Your broad command of customer economics, markets, technology, and complex buying environments makes you a trusted expert to customers and colleagues.

The Main Responsibilities

  • Own and execute a self-directed strategy for a portfolio of large, important, or global accounts, grounded in each customer’s business model, financial priorities, operating risks, technology estate, market context, and competitive position.
  • Anticipate needs before they become formal requirements; develop points of view and use cases that connect modernization to growth, efficiency, resilience, risk reduction, and innovation.
  • Build qualified pipeline through executive relationships, account intelligence, focused prospecting, partners, marketing, and business development.
  • Prioritize investments and resources based on customer potential, solution fit, buying signals, competitive dynamics, and revenue opportunity.
  • Lead discovery across executive, business, technical, operational, and financial stakeholders to define the problem, value at stake, decision path, and urgency to act.
  • Integrate relevant capabilities across Lumen and its partners into a coherent outcome; direct architects and specialists through clear commercial and customer objectives while they own technical design and validation.
  • Build quantified business cases covering expected value, investment, implementation requirements, risk, and cost of inaction.
  • Develop customers’ and colleagues’ understanding of business, market, and solution tradeoffs; influence executive sponsors, economic buyers, technical decision makers, and internal champions.
  • Own new-logo acquisition and expansion against assigned sales, revenue, and consumption goals.
  • Lead complex, high-value sales cycles through qualification, validation, pricing, negotiation, procurement, legal review, and close.
  • Exercise substantial commercial discretion—and, within company governance, full authority to shape and negotiate product, service, pricing, and contract terms.
  • Establish mutual action plans, decision criteria, stakeholder commitments, milestones, and activation dates; surface risks and dependencies early.
  • Plan and manage the account resource model, mobilizing sales, technical, delivery, customer success, channel, and partner teams without relying on formal authority.
  • Retain commercial ownership through implementation and activation; hold downstream partners accountable for customer readiness, delivery commitments, adoption, and value realization.
  • Use consumption data and customer signals to remove adoption barriers, address underutilization, anticipate revenue risk, and identify expansion across workloads, locations, and business units.
  • Convert demonstrated value into modernization, additional use cases, broader executive relationships, recurring revenue, and sustained growth.
  • Serve as a recognized expert across business, financial, market, customer, and portfolio domains; coach peers and contribute account insight that improves sales approaches and solution fit.
  • Activate channel and technology partners through joint targeting, account planning, and selling, with clear ownership and measurable outcomes.
  • Use AI, agents, and automated workflows to improve research, prioritization, outreach, follow-through, and opportunity management; validate outputs and apply sound judgment.
  • Maintain rigorous qualification, stakeholder maps, next steps, forecasts, and CRM records.

What We Look For in a Candidate

  • 8+ years of enterprise sales experience and sustained quota achievement, with evidence of performance at the scope and complexity described above.
  • Success acquiring and expanding large, important, or global enterprise accounts and closing complex deals with multimillion-dollar total contract value.
  • Broad expertise across customer business and financial drivers, enterprise technology markets, complex buying environments, and relevant solutions such as networking, cloud, security, managed services, or enterprise software.
  • Demonstrated authority and judgment in structuring and negotiating complex product, service, pricing, and contract terms with senior customer leaders.
  • Technical fluency to lead credible discovery, recognize solution opportunities, and direct architects and specialists effectively.
  • Experience planning account strategy independently and orchestrating colleagues and partners across the full customer lifecycle without formal authority.
  • Understanding of recurring-revenue and consumption-based models, including how activation, adoption, and usage create customer value and revenue growth.
  • Practical experience using AI and automation to improve sales execution, with disciplined validation of outputs.
  • Executive presence, sound judgment, and an ownership mindset; you make decisions, surface risk early, give direct feedback, and take responsibility for outcomes.

Compensation

This information reflects the anticipated base salary range for this position based on current national data. Minimums and maximums may vary based on location. Individual pay is based on skills, experience and other relevant factors.

Location Based Pay Ranges

$132,847 - $177,122 in these states: CO

Life at Lumen is human and connected, even in a fast moving, AI‑focused organization. We set clear expectations and trust people to meet them. With real support and shared accountability, teams collaborate better, move faster, and deliver meaningful outcomes.
