Position Title: Senior Marketing Manager
Location: Remote (Miami or DMV)
Overview:
The Marketing Manager is a strategic leader responsible for developing and driving comprehensive marketing plans that advance our clients’ business goals. This role sits at the intersection of marketing strategy and program management, requiring the ability to translate high-level objectives into actionable initiatives while ensuring disciplined execution and accountability across projects. The Marketing Manager will lead cross-functional collaboration, align internal and external stakeholders, and champion organizational excellence throughout every phase of the marketing lifecycle. Strong strategic thinking, project and program management expertise, and exceptional communication skills are essential to success in this role.

Key Responsibilities
Leadership:
  • Build, develop, and lead a high-performing marketing team, providing coaching, clear direction, and accountability frameworks that drive consistent execution.
  • Develop and own strategic marketing plans that translate business goals into integrated, actionable initiatives across all client programs and services.
  • Drive cross-functional initiatives by aligning teams around shared marketing objectives, ensuring strong coordination across disciplines from strategy through delivery.
  • Champion organizational excellence by establishing clear workflows, prioritization processes, and performance standards that keep programs on track and on budget.
  • Develop and manage budgets, resources, and timelines to ensure disciplined, on-strategy execution of marketing plans.
  • Other duties as assigned.

Marketing:
  • Review, edit, and implement strategic plans, creative briefs, client presentations, and other crucial written communication materials.
  • Deliver insights on emerging trends and digital/social strategies for engaging multicultural and general market audiences.
  • Review all creative concepts to ensure marketing and creative work is on-strategy and on-brand before client delivery.
  • Establish success metrics and KPIs; identify ways to measure success against the campaign goals and achievable outcomes; and facilitate reporting.
  • Evaluate and analyze data, including developing succinct, accurate summaries and analyses of research that include strategic recommendations for clients.
  • Other duties as assigned.
Client Relationship:
  • Develop strong relationships with Client(s) establishing regular communication to ensure expectations are met.
  • Keep Agency management informed of the status of Client relations, including personnel changes and issues pertaining to agency performance.
  • Ensure compliance with the Scope of Work.
  • Develop client monthly reporting.
  • Other duties as assigned.
Management and Growth:
  • Lead end-to-end program management for complex, multi-workstream marketing initiatives, ensuring milestones, deliverables, and stakeholder expectations are consistently met.
  • Establish and maintain rigorous project governance structures, including timelines, dashboards, and reporting cadences that provide visibility and accountability across all active programs.
  • Proactively identify project risks, dependencies, and blockers, and develop contingency plans to keep initiatives on track.
  • Partner with cross-functional teams including creative, analytics, digital, and client services to drive integrated marketing execution and continuous program improvement.
  • Serve as a key stakeholder communication hub, keeping leadership, clients, and internal teams aligned on progress, priorities, and decisions.
  • Other duties as assigned.

Qualifications:

raw.description:
At Singing River Health System, caring isn’t just part of the job — it’s in our DNA. Whether we’re saving lives, supporting behind the scenes, or showing up for our community, we bring the energy, heart, and hustle every single day.

With pride, passion, and commitment, we will improve health and save lives in our community every day.

Shift:

8:00am-4:30pm

Location:

Remote Mississippi

Job Description Summary

Job Description

Position Overview:
The Outpatient Coding Specialist will evaluate medical records and charges, as appropriate, to ensure completeness, accuracy, and compliance with the International Classification of Diseases Manual - Clinical Modification (ICD-10-CM), Healthcare Common Procedure Coding System (HCPCS), and the American Medical Association’s Current Procedural Terminology Manual (CPT). Reviews medical records to identify diagnosis codes and CPT procedures relative to the patient’s encounter. Selects the first listed diagnosis and principal procedure, along with other diagnoses and procedures using outpatient ICD-10-CM coding conventions and guidelines as well as the general and disease specific guidelines. Abstracts appropriate information from the medical record. Solicits clarification from the physician regarding ambiguous or conflicting documentation in the medical record as well as querying for medical necessity. Ensure all coding complies with the ethical coding standards/guidelines and regulatory requirements. Maintains strictest confidentiality; adheres to all Health Insurance Portability and Accountability Act guidelines/regulations. The Specialist will also provide technical guidance and training on medical coding to physicians and staff.

DISCLAIMER: This is not necessarily an exhaustive list of all responsibilities, duties, skills, efforts, requirements or working conditions associated with the job. While this intends to be an accurate reflection of the current job, management reserves the right to revise the job or to require that other or different tasks performed as assigned.

Education:
High School diploma or equivalent required. Must have completed course work in medical terminology, anatomy, physiology, disease processes, ICD-9/10-Clinical Modification coding, and/or CPT coding.

License:

N/A

Certifications:
Certified (or certified within one year of employment) by the American Health Information Management Association (AHIMA), American Academy of Professional Coders (AAPC) or National Heathcareer Association (NHA) as a:

• CPC: Certified Professional Coder;

• COC: Certified Outpatient Coder;

  • CCS-P: Certified Coding Specialist-Physician-based;
    • Or other equivalent coding certification.
    Once certified, employee must complete all requirements (including continuing education) to maintain certification.

Experience:
One (1) year of healthcare-related work experience or coding experience directly applying codes preferred, or the equivalent combination of expertise, education, and training that would provide the required knowledge and abilities.

Reports to:

Coding Manager

Supervises:

None

Physical Demands:
Work is moderately active: involves sitting with frequent requirements to move about the office, move about the facility, and to travel to another facility within the SRHS service area. Work involves exerting a negligible amount of force frequently to lift, carry, push, pull, or otherwise move objects, including the human body.

Work involves using many physical motions in performing daily work activities; subject to exposure of body fluids, sputum and tissues, which may carry the hazard of infectious disease. Work involves using repetitive motions: substantial movements of the wrists, hands, and or fingers while operating standard office equipment such as computer keyboard.

Work involves being able to perceive the nature of sound at normal speaking levels with or without correction; the ability to make fine discriminations in sound. Work requires close visual and acuity and the ability to adjust the eye to bring an object into sharp focus, i.e. shift gaze from viewing a computer monitor to forms/printed material that are closer to compare data at close vision.

Must be able to be active for extended periods of time without experiencing undue fatigue. Must be able to work schedules assigned with the understanding that changes may be instituted according to the needs of the hospital for off days, shifts or weekends.

Mental Demands:
Must demonstrate keen mental faculties/assessment and decision making abilities. Must demonstrate superior communication/speaking/enunciation skills to receive and give information in person and by telephone. Must demonstrate strong written and verbal communication skills. Must possess emotional stability conducive to dealing with high stress levels. Must demonstrate ability to work under pressure and meet deadlines.
Attention to detail and the ability to multi-task in complex situations is required. Must have the ability to maintain collaborative and respectable working relationships throughout SRHS and other organizations

Special Demands:
Must possess superior customer service skills and professional etiquette. Must possess proficient knowledge and ability to use a computer (must be keyboard proficient) and other office technology (i.e., telephone, fax, etc.), MS Outlook and Word.

Must be able to demonstrate appropriate clinical judgment and apply appropriate professional skills to a patient population of all ages.
• Knowledge of ICD-10-CM and CPT/HCPCS coding guidelines; medical terminology; anatomy and physiology; state and federal Medicare reimbursement guidelines; fluent English grammar and usage.
• Ability to research and analyze data, draw conclusions, and resolve issues; read, interpret, and apply policies, procedures, laws, and regulations.
• Ability to read and interpret medical procedures and terminology.
• Ability to exercise independent judgment;
• Excellent written and verbal communication skills to prepare queries and related documents and to maintain working relationships with physicians and other staff.
• Ability to maintain confidentiality.

If you’re looking for purpose, teamwork, and a place where what you do truly matters, you’ve found it. Let’s do big things together. Apply now and join our team.

Roon is seeking a hands-on technical leader to drive engineering execution, architectural decisions, and technology strategy. In partnership with leadership and engineering management, this role ensures that technical direction aligns with business and product goals while balancing scalability, efficiency, and innovation. You will be the linchpin of our application development teams, steering us towards greatness. By blending state-of-the-art technology, creative design, and user-friendly features, the teams strive to enrich the lives of audiophiles and music lovers worldwide. Summary:

The Database Administrator VI provides senior-level database administration, development, performance tuning, data management, backup and recovery, and database integration support for EFMSS and associated systems. This position is responsible for maintaining database availability, integrity, performance, security, and recoverability while supporting application, reporting, and data requirements.

Responsibilities

Essential Job Functions:

  • Install, configure, upgrade and maintain database(s) and underlying server infrastructure. This includes updating processes, data flows, and objects (usually shown in diagrams).
  • Maintain databases at recommended maintenance levels prescribed by the product manufacturer.
  • Monitor data retrieval from the database to determine performance improvements.
  • Provide database performance tuning in support of improving applications performance and system-wide database contention and concurrent user tuning.
  • Maintain performance and tuning plans for online processes and databases.
  • Develop and maintain interfaces to allow existing exterior systems to exchange data and provide unique support required for various database applications.
  • Maintain a complete inventory of database and application interconnections and interfaces.
  • Assure maximum continuity of operations by minimizing database and data replication downtime associated with database modification or recovery.
  • Perform data/database backup and recovery routines for data integrity and recoverability.
  • Provide support to software and report developers with developing efficient application and report queries.
  • Provide support to software and report developers to troubleshoot issues that may be database or data related.
  • Maintain changes to the existing database structures and maintain software to provide synchronization.
  • Develop database solutions for application requirements when defined.
  • Perform production control and quality control functions (batch submissions, checking and corrections).
  • Merge data from various data sources import/export data from databases; extract and combine data from different sources.
  • Ensure that input data and output data and databases are correct and continually checked for accuracy and completeness.
  • Correct data accuracy and completeness errors when identified.
  • Produce exports of specific subsets of data.
  • Provide analysis of data and anomaly identification.
  • Recommend and implement corrective measures.
  • Develop data management and analysis procedures.

Qualifications

Necessary Skills and Knowledge:

  • Advanced knowledge of database administration, development, performance tuning, backup/recovery, and data management.
  • Knowledge of database architecture, structures, interfaces, data flows, and integration.
  • Knowledge of database security, availability, integrity, and recoverability practices.
  • Knowledge of data quality, analysis, and data management principles.
  • Ability to troubleshoot complex database and data-related problems.
  • Ability to develop database solutions supporting application requirements.
  • Ability to analyze data quality, performance, and system behavior.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills.
  • Strong technical documentation skills.

Minimum Qualifications:

  • Minimum of eight (8) years of progressively responsible experience in database administration, database development, or a related field.
  • Demonstrated experience administering production databases.
  • Experience with database performance monitoring and tuning.
  • Experience with database backup, recovery, and data integrity processes.
  • Experience developing or maintaining database interfaces and data exchanges.
  • Required to successfully pass a background investigation.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Information Systems, Database Administration, or a related technical field.

Pay and Benefits

The annual salary range for this position is $130,000 to $140,000.

At Goldbelt, we value and reward our team's dedication and hard work. We provide a competitive base salary commensurate with your qualifications and experience. As an employee, you'll enjoy a comprehensive benefits package, including medical, dental, and vision insurance, a 401(k) plan with company matching, tax-deferred savings options, supplementary benefits, paid time off, and professional development opportunities.

raw.title: Spécialiste Staff, opérations de sécurité
raw.excerpt: À propos de Workleap Workleap est une entreprise tech montréalaise fondée en 2006.
raw.description:
À propos de Workleap

Workleap est une entreprise tech montréalaise fondée en 2006. Bâtisseurs dans l'âme, on crée des produits simples qui font une réelle différence pour ceux qui les utilisent. On a deux lignes de produits : L'agent Workleap, notre nouvelle solution conçue pour aider chaque gestionnaire à être plus efficace et ShareGate, la référence mondiale de migration et de gouvernance Microsoft 365. Plus de 15 000 entreprises dans le monde nous font confiance pour faire exactement ça. On est intentionnels dans notre choix des gens qu'on recrute : des personnes qui ont envie de retrousser leurs manches et de construire quelque chose de significatif dans une des périodes les plus excitantes de l'histoire de la tech.

Ton rôle

Tu seras responsable de la façon dont Workleap détecte les menaces, enquête et y répond, chez Workleap comme chez ShareGate, et tu bâtiras la couche d'IA qui fait tourner tout ça. Nos outils de sécurité génèrent plus de bruit qu'une petite équipe peut en traiter, et trop de constats sont ambigus ou erronés. Ce rôle existe maintenant pour transformer la détection et la réponse en un système où des agents trient, enrichissent et enquêtent, et où les humains prennent les décisions qui demandent vraiment du jugement. C'est un rôle de contributeur.trice individuel.le de niveau Staff, très concret, sans gestion d'équipe.

Ton impact :

  • Bâtir le pipeline qui fait tourner les opérations de sécurité de bout en bout : les intégrations qui extraient les alertes et les constats de chaque outil source, un système agentique qui les trie, les enrichit, les corrèle et rédige l'enquête, et une connexion à Jira qui achemine chaque résultat vers l'équipe responsable avec les preuves et une voie de correction, pour qu'aucun constat ne soit jamais recopié à la main ;
  • Définir le modèle de confiance de ces agents : ce qu'ils ferment seuls, ce qu'ils recommandent et ce qui revient toujours à un humain, appuyé par des evals et protégé contre l'injection de prompt et l'abus de permissions ;
  • Éliminer les faux positifs et les constats mal évalués de nos outils de sécurité, pour que chaque constat qui arrive à une personne soit réel et bien priorisé ;
  • Piloter l'ingénierie de détection de bout en bout, écrite sous forme de code et alignée sur MITRE ATT&CK, pour que la couverture survive à tout changement de plateforme ;
  • Mener la réponse aux incidents de sécurité, du triage au postmortem, avec des agents qui rassemblent les preuves, et tenir notre partenaire de détection gérée à un standard mesurable ;
  • Faire de la sécurité un partenaire que les équipes de développement veulent avoir, en livrant les constats dans leur flux de travail avec des preuves claires et une voie de correction.

Ton équipe

Au cours des 12 prochains mois, LeapSec livre deux paris stratégiques : intégrer la sécurité dans les squads produit, avec des agents qui portent le travail de vulnérabilités et de détection, et automatiser la collecte de preuves SOC 2 pour que personne n'ait à la faire à la main. Tu seras responsable du volet détection et réponse : nettoyer l'outillage, bâtir les agents et démontrer jusqu'où on peut leur faire confiance.

LeapSec regroupe les Opérations de sécurité et la Conformité pour Workleap et ShareGate. Tu relèveras du directeur Infrastructure et Sécurité et tu travailleras au quotidien avec notre spécialiste Staff en sécurité applicative et l'équipe d'outillage de sécurité, et au besoin avec l'Infrastructure, l'ITX et l'ingénierie produit. On est une petite équipe avec un large mandat : on suit le travail honnêtement dans Jira, on livre à dates fixes et on s'attend à ce que chacun.e prenne ses résultats en charge de bout en bout.

Notre environnement est d'abord Azure, avec aujourd'hui une plateforme SIEM et XDR infonuagique, Zscaler, Cloudflare et un partenaire de détection gérée. On choisit nos outils au mérite et on compte continuer à le faire.

Ce que tu apportes

  • La maîtrise de l’anglais est requise, car tu vas collaborer régulièrement avec des collègues, des clients et des partenaires qui parlent une autre langue que le français;
  • 7 ans et plus en opérations de sécurité, réponse aux incidents ou ingénierie de détection, avec une expérience pratique récente dans un environnement SaaS infonuagique ;
  • Une solide expérience des constats qui ne sont pas clairs : valider ce que les outils signalent, éliminer les faux positifs à la source et trancher, avec des preuves incomplètes, si quelque chose est réel ;
  • Des années à travailler directement avec des équipes de développement, à faire livrer des correctifs sans autorité formelle et à préserver la relation quand la réponse est non ;
  • De l'expérience à bâtir et déployer des systèmes d'agents pour la sécurité dont d'autres dépendent, comme des serveurs MCP, des skills Claude ou des outils sur mesure, avec des evals qui déterminent quand leurs résultats sont fiables ;
  • Une bonne compréhension de la façon dont les systèmes agentiques échouent et sont attaqués, notamment l'injection de prompt, la gestion des permissions des outils et des identifiants ;
  • L'ingénierie de détection comme discipline : détections sous forme de code, un langage de requête SIEM que tu maîtrises et des taux de faux positifs réellement mesurés ;
  • Une solide compréhension des chemins d'attaque liés à l'identité et à l'infonuagique, idéalement dans Azure et Entra ID ;
  • Atout : expérience à diriger un partenaire de détection gérée, en chasse aux menaces ou en forensique, et aisance en français.

La plupart de cela te ressemble ? Postule.

Ce que le poste inclut

  • Salaire de base : 125 000$ - 160 000$. Cette fourchette reflète notre échelle salariale pancanadienne. L'offre finale peut être ajustée selon la région du candidat pour s'aligner avec les conditions du marché local.
  • Programme de bonus annuel.
  • Programme LTIP, participation à la croissance à long terme de Workleap.
  • REER + Assurances collectives familiales + télémédecine + budget bien-être annuel.
  • Politique de vacances flexible.
  • Télétravail, avec accès à nos bureaux de Montréal.
  • Rassemblement en personne deux fois par an.
  • Claude accessible à tous.

Ce qui nous anime

Chez Workleap, on construit des logiciels au cœur de l'expérience de travail, au quotidien, à tous les niveaux.

On avance vite. Les priorités évoluent, les décisions se prennent avec l'information qu'on a, et on itère. Si tu carbures à l'intensité et que l'ambiguïté ne te fait pas peur, tu vas te sentir chez toi. On est des bâtisseurs. On fait ce qu'il faut pour avancer. L'IA fait partie de l'arsenal. On l'utilise pour aller plus vite et décider plus intelligemment, pas pour remplacer le jugement.

Si tu veux de l'impact réel et un endroit où tes décisions comptent, c'est ici.

Comment on recrute

La transparence, c'est notre façon de recruter — pour toi comme pour nous.

Voici comment ça se passe : un premier échange avec un.e recruteur.euse, puis un entretien virtuel avec le.la gestionnaire d'embauche. Tu complètes ensuite une étude de cas à faire chez toi, suivie d'une rencontre avec de futur.es collègues pour en discuter ensemble. Selon le poste, le parcours peut varier légèrement — ton.ta recruteur.euse t'en donnera tous les détails lors de votre premier appel.

On utilise l'IA pour soutenir certaines étapes du processus, mais chaque décision d'embauche reste humaine.

On a hâte de te rencontrer.

En postulant, tu confirmes avoir lu et accepté notre politique de confidentialité.

Note: This role is a Remote, US but a strong preference for locations except CA, WA, DC, MD, NJ, NY, CT, MA, VA, AK. 


Meet the Team

Join Cisco’s Splunk Integrated Core Platform team and help shape the architecture behind the authorization infrastructure that powers Splunk’s enterprise observability and security platform.

Our Authorization team tackles some of the most sophisticated challenges in distributed systems, identity, and access control. We design high-performance services that establish trust and enforce authorization across interconnected systems, leveraging attribute-based and role-based access control (ABAC/RBAC) to support complex enterprise environments.

With a substantial C++ codebase and an evolving Go-based, cloud-native architecture, our team offers a unique opportunity to work on deep architectural challenges, influence long-term technical direction, and build foundational systems serving some of the world’s largest enterprises.


Your Impact

As a Senior Software Engineer on the Splunk Platform Authorization team, you’ll help shape the architecture of systems that enable secure, high-performance authorization across Splunk’s enterprise platform. You’ll take ownership of technically complex initiatives, make critical design decisions, and work across engineering teams to deliver scalable, reliable solutions. This is a hands-on technical leadership opportunity where you’ll influence long-term platform architecture while contributing directly to the development and evolution of our core systems.

  • Architect, design, and develop high-performance backend services using C++, while contributing to Go-based services and the modernization of Splunk’s core platform.
  • Lead technical design discussions and make architectural decisions involving distributed systems, scalability, performance, reliability, and service-to-service trust.
  • Own complex engineering initiatives from design through execution, breaking down large projects, identifying opportunities for parallel development, and coordinating work across engineers.
  • Improve and modernize large-scale C++ infrastructure, addressing architectural complexity, technical debt, and the transition toward cloud-native and Kubernetes-based services.
  • Provide technical guidance through design and code reviews, collaborate across teams, and contribute to production reliability, troubleshooting, and operational support.

Minimum Qualifications


  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field with 7+ years of relevant experience; or a Master’s degree with 4+ years of relevant experience; or a PhD with 1+ year of relevant experience.
  • Software development experience in C++, including designing, maintaining, or enhancing complex backend systems.
  • Experience designing and developing distributed systems or large-scale backend services in production environments.
  • Prior experience in software architecture, technical design, and translating complex requirements into scalable engineering solutions.
  • Experience leading technical initiatives, coordinating implementation across engineers, and driving projects from design through delivery.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with Go and cloud-native infrastructure, including Kubernetes, containers, or microservices.
  • Experience designing high-performance, highly available systems operating at enterprise scale.
  • Understanding of identity and access management, authentication, authorization, RBAC/ABAC, or service-to-service trust models.
  • Experience modernizing large legacy codebases, addressing architectural complexity, and improving system reliability and performance.
  • Experience with observability platforms, enterprise infrastructure, security systems, or highly distributed cloud services.

Why Cisco?

At Cisco, we’re revolutionizing how data and infrastructure connect and protect organizations in the AI era – and beyond. We’ve been innovating fearlessly for 40 years to create solutions that power how humans and technology work together across the physical and digital worlds. These solutions provide customers with unparalleled security, visibility, and insights across the entire digital footprint.

Fueled by the depth and breadth of our technology, we experiment and create meaningful solutions. Add to that our worldwide network of doers and experts, and you’ll see that the opportunities to grow and build are limitless. We work as a team, collaborating with empathy to make really big things happen on a global scale. Because our solutions are everywhere, our impact is everywhere.

We are Cisco, and our power starts with you.

Message to applicants applying to work in the U.S. and/or Canada:

The starting salary range posted for this position is $139,300.00 to $203,600.00 and reflects the projected salary range for new hires in this position in U.S. and/or Canada locations, not including incentive compensation*, equity, or benefits.

Individual pay is determined by the candidate's hiring location, market conditions, job-related skillset, experience, qualifications, education, certifications, and/or training. The full salary range for certain locations is listed below. For locations not listed below, the recruiter can share more details about compensation for the role in your location during the hiring process.

U.S. employees are offered benefits, subject to Cisco’s plan eligibility rules, which include medical, dental and vision insurance, a 401(k) plan with a Cisco matching contribution, paid parental leave, short and long-term disability coverage, and basic life insurance. Please see the Cisco careers site to discover more benefits and perks. Employees may be eligible to receive grants of Cisco restricted stock units, which vest following continued employment with Cisco for defined periods of time.

U.S. employees are eligible for paid time away as described below, subject to Cisco’s policies:

  • 10 paid holidays per full calendar year, plus 1 floating holiday for non-exempt employees

  • 1 paid day off for employee’s birthday, paid year-end holiday shutdown, and 4 paid days off for personal wellness determined by Cisco

  • Non-exempt employees** receive 16 days of paid vacation time per full calendar year, accrued at rate of 4.92 hours per pay period for full-time employees

  • Exempt employees participate in Cisco’s flexible vacation time off program, which has no defined limit on how much vacation time eligible employees may use (subject to availability and some business limitations)

  • 80 hours of sick time off provided on hire date and each January 1st thereafter, and up to 80 hours of unused sick time carried forward from one calendar year to the next

  • Additional paid time away may be requested to deal with critical or emergency issues for family members

  • Optional 10 paid days per full calendar year to volunteer

For non-sales roles, employees are also eligible to earn annual bonuses subject to Cisco’s policies.

Employees on sales plans earn performance-based incentive pay on top of their base salary, which is split between quota and non-quota components, subject to the applicable Cisco plan. For quota-based incentive pay, Cisco typically pays as follows:

  • .75% of incentive target for each 1% of revenue attainment up to 50% of quota;

  • 1% of incentive target for each 1% of attainment between 75% and 100%; and

For non-quota-based sales performance elements such as strategic sales objectives, Cisco may pay 0% up to 125% of target. Cisco sales plans do not have a minimum threshold of performance for sales incentive compensation to be paid.

raw.excerpt: About SmartcatSmartcat is building the future of work, where human expertise meets digital teammates to drive 10x to 1000x productivity gains for the world’s leading enterprises.
raw.description:
About Smartcat

Smartcat is building the future of work, where human expertise meets digital teammates to drive 10x to 1000x productivity gains for the world’s leading enterprises.

We’re on the frontier of an entirely new category: Agentic AI. We enable enterprises to build high-performing hybrid workforces made up of both humans and AI agents. These AI agents aren’t generic copilots. They’re fully trained digital teammates that learn from your best people, your content, and your business strategy—ready to get to work from day one.

Our platform combines generative AI, human-in-the-loop workflows, and a living Enterprise Skill Graph that continuously learns and improves. Whether you're launching a product globally, onboarding new hires, translating learning content, or aligning legal teams across regions, Smartcat turns knowledge into action and action into scale.

Over 1,000 companies, including 20% of the Fortune 500, rely on Smartcat to bring their business to the world—instantly, accurately, and in every language. As a Series C company with consistently high year-over-year growth, we’re scaling fast and investing in people who want to shape the future of work with us.

Join us in unlocking global potential, one human and agent team at a time.

WHY YOU SHOULD JOIN OUR TEAM

You’ll join a newly formed Technical Account Management team built to make sure every Smartcat customer, at every tier, can reach a human technical expert 24/7. AI already resolves a growing share of customer issues, so you’ll own the escalations beyond what AI can handle: technical troubleshooting, integrations, and workflow questions, solved in an AI-forward way. You’ll be assigned a portfolio of accounts, and on our largest accounts you’ll be the named technical resource and work directly with the account executive.

MISSION

Be the trusted technical expert behind Smartcat’s customers: meet their needs with passion and approachability, resolve complex escalations with AI-first problem solving, keep integrations and workflows healthy, and give customers around the world fast, expert technical support at any hour.

OUTCOMES

  • Act as the technical point of contact for an assigned portfolio of accounts within your tier (Strategic, Enterprise, or Corporate), partnering with the account team on each
  • Take ownership of customer escalations that go beyond what Smartcat’s AI capabilities can resolve, using technical troubleshooting and AI tools to reach resolution quickly
  • Resolve customer inquiries and requests in modern ticketing systems such as Zendesk and YouTrack, maintaining a consistently high customer satisfaction rate
  • Provide 24/7 coverage as part of a globally distributed team, so every customer can reach a human regardless of tier
  • Own technical onboarding and implementation: API and connector integrations (CMS, TMS, DAM, dev tools), SSO/SAML setup, workspace architecture, and workflow configuration
  • Escalate feature requests, bugs, and issues that need engineering to Support, Product, and Engineering with clear reproduction steps, and own root-cause communication through resolution
  • Advise customers on best-practice use of Smartcat’s platform (CAT tools, AI Coworkers, Marketplace, PDF pipeline, custom workflows) to maximize adoption and ROI
  • Monitor technical health signals (integration failures, API error rates, usage drop-offs) and flag risk to the account team before it becomes churn
  • Collaborate with engineers, analysts, testers, success managers, and product managers, and relay customer technical feedback to influence the roadmap
  • Develop and maintain help center content, internal documentation, runbooks, and reusable integration patterns, using AI to keep them current
  • Support renewal and expansion conversations with technical proof points: performance data, integration health, and use-case expansion opportunities

How the tiers differ: On Strategic accounts (our largest named customers), you’ll be the go-to technical resource and work directly with the assigned account executive. On Enterprise and Corporate accounts, you’ll cover a larger number of accounts, with less day-to-day customer-facing time and more emphasis on efficient, AI-powered issue resolution.

HOW YOU’LL RAMP

By Day 30:

  • Learn Smartcat’s platform end to end: CAT tools, AI Coworkers, Marketplace, PDF pipeline, custom workflows, and the integration and API landscape
  • Learn how AI handles first-line customer issues today, where human escalation takes over, and how tickets flow through Zendesk and YouTrack
  • Meet your account team, Support, Product, and Engineering counterparts, and get oriented on your assigned accounts: architecture, integrations, open issues, and health signals

By Day 60:

  • Resolve customer escalations independently, using AI tools to diagnose and solve, and escalating to Engineering with clear reproduction steps when needed
  • Lead technical onboarding or integration work for at least one account
  • Monitor health signals across your accounts and flag at least one emerging risk to the account team

By Day 90:

  • Carry your full account portfolio, including your share of 24/7 coverage
  • Run a technical workshop with a customer’s team and summarize it cleanly for their business stakeholders
  • Contribute help center content, a runbook, or a reusable integration pattern to the team’s library, and relay customer feedback that informs Product and Engineering

WHAT YOU’VE ACCOMPLISHED

  • Background in the localization or translation industry, for example as a localization engineer at a translation agency or language service provider, with a strong understanding of languages and international customers
  • An AI-first approach to problem solving: you already use AI tools to troubleshoot, diagnose, and work faster
  • Exceptional troubleshooting and problem-solving skills, with a track record of owning issues through resolution
  • A genuine love of helping and teaching people, and excellent written communication skills in English
  • Working knowledge of REST APIs and webhooks, and comfort reading logs and debugging integration failures; scripting experience (Python or JavaScript) is a plus
  • Experience with ticketing systems such as Zendesk and YouTrack
  • The ability to explain technical root cause to both engineers and non-technical stakeholders, and to run a technical workshop with a customer’s team and then summarize it cleanly for their VP
  • Comfort owning multiple accounts at once and prioritizing under pressure, including during crisis de-escalation
  • Experience working on remote, globally distributed teams
  • Openness to feedback and to others’ opinions and ideas, and eagerness to grow
  • Bonus: technical support or quality assurance experience, and experience with CMS/TMS integrations or content supply chain tooling

Why joining Smartcat might be your best move so far

  • A global, connected team We’re a team of 200+ people across 30+ countries, working together through a hub-and-spoke model anchored in eight key locations: New York, London, Lisbon, Costa Rica, Serbia, Armenia, Georgia, and Spain. Most of our roles are remote-friendly, giving you the flexibility to do your best work from where you thrive. For customer-facing teams, we prioritize proximity to our customers, ensuring we stay deeply connected to their needs and deliver an exceptional experience. No matter where you’re based, you’ll be part of a highly collaborative, globally-distributed team that values ownership, speed, and meaningful impact.
  • Be part of an AI Native OrganizationWe are highly innovative, using AI across all areas of the organization to accelerate decision-making and free people to focus on strategy and high-impact work. We embrace new ideas and encourage all Smartcaters, regardless of level or department, to manage their own AI Agents. At Smartcat you’ll shape how AI transforms the workplace and play an integral role in ensuring Smartcat remains a leader in AI innovation.
  • Innovating a $100 Billion industrySmartcat is reshaping the $100B multilingual content industry with an AI-powered platform that makes it easy for companies to create, translate, and localize global content at scale. Our platform enables enterprise teams to move away from slow, traditional outsourcing methods, and achieve fast, high-quality results, at a fraction of the cost.
  • Join the rocketship to scale-up 10x and beyond together We are looking for someone to become an integral part of our team and play a crucial role in the most exciting part of our journey: transitioning from a post-Series C startup to a company exceeding $100M in ARR and $1B in valuation. Our journey isn’t for the faint of heart. We are growing at 130% YoY, thanks to our strong product-market fit and high-performing team, and plan to accelerate from here.
  • Smartcat Culture Code: Where Diversity Meets High PerformanceAt Smartcat, we are committed to building a culture that highlights respect and appreciation for each individual's unique background and perspective, while maintaining a strong focus on results and engagement. We believe in welcoming everyone and fostering an inclusive environment where team members can be their authentic selves at work. Our commitment to inclusion is steadfast, and we stand firmly against discrimination and harassment.

STV currently is seeking a suitably experienced rail vehicle system Electrical Engineer with experience in propulsion systems to join the Rail Vehicle Engineering group. The primary responsibilities of this position include preparing propulsion engineering specifications and reports, evaluating proposed carbuilder designs on behalf of transit agencies, and evaluating drawings and test reports from various manufacturers. The Propulsion Engineer will report to the Chief of Propulsion Engineering.

Responsibilities:

  • Preparation of equipment performance design criteria and engineering technical specifications.

  • Preparation and review of test specifications and reports.

  • Witness equipment and vehicle testing and First Article Inspections.

  • Review and evaluation of carbuilder and propulsion equipment supplier design packages.

  • Assist with preparing technical and cost proposals for new work.

  • Assist with preparing change orders for existing work.

  • Working knowledge of relevant industry standards: EN, IEC, UL, ANSI, APTA, IEEE etc.

  • Interface with railway clients and other departments within STV.

Qualifications:

Overview

JOB TITLE: Senior ServiceNow Developer

GOVERNMENT AGENCY: Department of State

POSITION INFORMATION: Full-Time Position; Government contractor supporting federal agency clients

LOCATION: Fully Remote (U.S.); availability during East Coast business hours required

BENEFITS: Health, Dental and Vision, 401(k), Flexible Spending Account (FSA), 11 Paid Federal Holidays, PTO, education reimbursement

CLEARANCE: Must have, at minimum, an active Interim Secret security clearance, with the ability to obtain and maintain a final Secret clearance.

ITC Federal, LLC (ITC) connects technology advancements in automation and AI, customer experience, and financial services to solve government mission challenges, enabling smoother operational efficiency and bolstering national security. We leverage the latest technology innovations and proven approaches to better serve the mission and support the DHS, DOJ, and DoW workforce, customers, and programs, regardless of scale or complexity. ITC is located in Fairfax, VA and offers outstanding compensation and benefits plan and a challenging and rewarding professional work environment.

ITC is seeking a Senior ServiceNow Developer to design, build, and deploy ServiceNow solutions for our federal agency clients. This role owns complex builds from requirements through rollout—custom applications, Service Catalog items, Flow Designer automations, IntegrationHub integrations, and the server- and client-side scripting underneath them—with the judgment to recognize when well-configured baseline functionality is a better answer than another custom script. The Senior ServiceNow Developer sets and enforces development standards, mentors other developers, leads peer reviews, and represents technical solutions in client-facing design discussions, keeping the instance clean, upgradeable, and maintainable long after go-live.

Responsibilities

RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Build & Configure
    • Design, develop, test, and deploy ServiceNow configurations, custom applications, and automated workflows.
    • Write and maintain server-side and client-side JavaScript using Glide APIs, Business Rules, Script Includes, Client Scripts, and ACLs.
    • Favor configuration over customization, keeping the instance upgradeable and avoiding custom scripts that create long-term technical debt.
  • Service Catalog & Workflow Automation
    • Build advanced Service Catalog items, including catalog client scripts, UI policies, variable sets, and record producers.
    • Design and build Flow Designer automations that are readable and maintainable by developers who did not build them.
    • Deliver request experiences that end users adopt willingly rather than work around.
  • ITSM Platform
    • Support ongoing improvement and optimization of core ITSM modules, including Incident, Problem, Change, Request, and Knowledge Management.
    • Partner with business analysts and platform administrators on process design, advising when a requested configuration will create risk in future releases.
  • Integrations
    • Design and implement integrations with third-party systems using REST and SOAP web services and IntegrationHub.
    • Build the transforms, error handling, and retry logic that keep integrations reliable and supportable over time.
  • Quality, Release & Compliance
    • Execute unit, integration, and regression testing, including Automated Test Framework (ATF) coverage, with the goal of clean deployments.
    • Maintain update sets, release documentation, and technical design records so every release can be explained and, if necessary, reversed.
    • Identify risks, dependencies, and design gaps early in the development lifecycle, when they are still inexpensive to fix.
    • Ensure solutions meet federal IT standards, including Section 508 accessibility and FISMA/NIST security controls.
  • Technical Leadership & Mentorship
    • Mentor developers and promote ServiceNow development best practices across the delivery team.
    • Set and enforce development standards, and lead code reviews, peer reviews, release management support, and governance and compliance checks.
    • Participate in client calls and technical design discussions, translating business requirements into clear, actionable technical solutions.

Qualifications

REQUIRED:

  • 6+ years of hands-on ServiceNow development and configuration experience, including experience guiding or mentoring other developers.
  • Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related field from an accredited University, required.
  • Strong platform scripting skills, including server-side and client-side JavaScript, Glide APIs, Business Rules, and Script Includes.
  • Experience building Service Catalog items, workflows or Flow Designer automations, and integrations using REST, SOAP, and IntegrationHub.
  • Demonstrated ownership of complex builds from requirements through rollout.
  • A track record of setting or enforcing development standards on a team and representing technical solutions in client-facing discussions.
  • Demonstrated experience delivering in an Agile/Scrum environment.
  • Strong communication skills and the ability to work independently and across technical and functional teams.

PREFERRED:

  • ServiceNow Certified Application Developer (CAD) and at least one ServiceNow Certified Implementation Specialist (CIS) certification (CIS-ITSM preferred; additional CIS tracks such as CSM are a plus).
  • Hands-on proficiency with the ServiceNow Automated Test Framework (ATF).
  • Experience with release coordination, version control, and automated testing strategies.
  • Prior experience supporting federal or defense contracting environments.
  • Experience with Service Portal, UI Builder, or the Now Experience framework.
  • Development experience outside ServiceNow, including JavaScript, REST and SOAP integrations, or other platforms.
  • Working knowledge of ITSM, IT asset and configuration management, and ITIL practices.

SECURITY CLEARANCE REQUIREMENTS:

  • Must have, at minimum, an active Interim Secret security clearance, with the ability to obtain and maintain a final Secret clearance.
  • U.S. Citizenship is required due to the nature of this government contract.

WORK ENVIRONMENT AND PHYSICAL DEMANDS: This is a fully remote position within the U.S. Candidate must be available during East Coast business hours for client workshops and stakeholder sessions; occasional travel may be required for major planning events. No relocation or office reporting is expected.

ITC Federal is an equal opportunity employer and will not discriminate against any application for employment on the basis of age, race, color, gender, national origin, religion, creed, disability, veteran status, marital status, sexual orientation, genetic information, military status, disability, or sex including pregnancy and childbirth or related medical condition or on any other basis prohibited by law.

raw.description:
About Step

Step's mission is to improve the financial future of the next generation. Millions of people use our banking and borrowing products to manage, build, and grow their money. Now that we're part of Beast Industries – the company behind MrBeast – we're poised for a new phase of growth to deliver financial literacy and tools at massive scale.

About the Role

At Step, we believe the gap between design and engineering should be as close to zero as possible. We're looking for a Design Systems Engineer to help make that vision a reality.

This role sits at the intersection of design and engineering, owning the systems, tooling, and infrastructure that allow our teams to build beautiful, consistent, high-quality products at speed. You'll work across Figma, code, and AI-powered workflows to ensure our design system isn't just documented—it lives equally in design and production.

You'll partner closely with Product Design and Engineering leadership to evolve our design platform, reduce friction in the product development process, and create a future where moving from an idea to production is faster, more reliable, and nearly lossless.

This isn't a role for someone who simply enjoys maintaining component libraries. We're looking for someone who enjoys building the platform that enables great product teams to do their best work.

In this role, you will:

  • Own the connection between our design system and production code, ensuring they evolve together rather than separately
  • Build and maintain reusable components, design tokens, and shared foundations across iOS, Android, and Web
  • Partner closely with Product Designers to translate high-fidelity designs into production-quality components with exceptional visual accuracy
  • Collaborate with Engineering to create scalable component architecture that is flexible, performant, accessible, and easy for teams to adopt
  • Continuously improve our design-to-code workflow through better tooling, automation, documentation, and developer experience
  • Develop systems that allow designers and engineers to move faster while maintaining an exceptionally high bar for quality and consistency
  • Improve governance around component APIs, tokens, naming conventions, versioning, and adoption across teams
  • Review implementations, identify opportunities to improve the design system, and raise the overall quality of our products
  • Explore and build AI-powered workflows that improve how we design, build, document, and maintain our products
  • Help shape the future of how product development happens at Step

You might thrive in this role if you have:

  • Significant experience building and evolving design systems for modern consumer software products
  • Strong frontend engineering experience building reusable component libraries and design infrastructure
  • Deep understanding of design tokens, component architecture, accessibility, documentation, and modern design system best practices
  • Strong understanding of Figma and how modern design teams build and maintain systems
  • A systems thinker who naturally looks beyond individual components to improve the entire product development workflow
  • An exceptional eye for visual detail and a passion for building interfaces that feel polished and intentional
  • Someone who enjoys collaborating equally with designers and engineers and can comfortably speak both languages
  • Excellent communication skills and the ability to influence technical and product decisions across disciplines
  • Curiosity about AI and emerging design tools, with a desire to continually rethink how products are designed and built
  • Experience shipping high-quality mobile or web applications
  • A portfolio or examples of work demonstrating both technical execution and thoughtful design systems thinking

Even better if you have:

  • Experience with React Native or building cross-platform component libraries
  • Experience building token pipelines or design system tooling
  • Experience with Storybook or similar documentation platforms
  • Experience building Figma plugins or internal developer tools
  • Experience using AI to improve design workflows, automate repetitive work, or build design tooling

Logistics

Location: Remote (US) or San Mateo, CA, with occasional travel for team offsites and key meetings

Reports to: Head of Design

Education: Bachelor's degree or an equivalent combination of education, training, and experience

We encourage you to apply even if you don't meet every single qualification. Strong candidates rarely check every box, and we'd rather meet you than miss you.

How we're different

We stand for the side hustlers, the creators, the freelancers, and the investors — people who are not afraid to take on challenges, especially when it comes to their finances. Step is focused on disrupting the banking industry by delivering a differentiated, mobile-first consumer experience, and we operate like the customers we serve: customer obsessed, acting as owners, moving with urgency, and breaking the norm.

Step is a wholly owned subsidiary of Beast Industries, the media and entertainment company founded by Jimmy Donaldson (MrBeast), the most-watched person in the world. Beast Industries spans digital media, consumer products, philanthropy, and new ventures, with an audience reach no consumer company has ever had — and Step is tasked with turning that reach into financial literacy and tools for the next generation at massive scale. With Beast's distribution and brand behind it, Step is positioned to scale significantly over the next 12 months, and joining now means helping shape that trajectory from the inside.

Come work with us!

Step is a remote-first company building banking for the next generation. We offer competitive compensation and stock options, generous medical, dental, vision, and company-paid life insurance, a 401k plan with Safe Harbor company matching, a flexible vacation policy and paid company holidays, 12 weeks paid parental leave with flexible return to work, and a company-provided technology package. If you're looking to join a fast-growing company with a strong mission and vision that puts people first, we want to meet you!

Step is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other status protected by applicable federal, state, or local law.

Step is committed to providing reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities throughout the application and interview process. If you need an accommodation, please let us know at and we'll work with you to provide appropriate support.

Introduction: A Career at HARMAN Corporate

We’re a global, multi-disciplinary team that’s putting the innovative power of technology to work and transforming tomorrow. At HARMAN Corporate, you are integral to our company’s award-winning success.

  • Enrich your managerial and organizational talents – from finance, quality, and supply chain to human resources, IT, sales, and strategy
  • Augment your comprehensive skillset with expert training across decision-making, change management, leadership, and business development
  • Obtain 360-degree support throughout your career life cycle, from early-stage to seasoned leader

About the Role

The Director of Global Corporate Travel serves as a key leadership role responsible for managing HARMAN’s global travel program across 33 countries. This position requires strong collaboration with cross-functional partners — including C-Suite and Divisional Leaders, HR, Finance, Procurement, and Security — well as the cultivation of strategic relationships with external travel vendors.

The Global Director will lead the development and execution of travel strategy, policy, and cost-optimization initiatives while ensuring compliance with local government regulations in every region. Reporting directly to the Chief People Officer, this role oversees a global team of nine direct reports located in China, Germany, Hungary, India, and the United States.

What You Will Do
Strategic Leadership & Program Management:

  • Design, implement, and lead the global travel strategy in alignment with the company’s overall business objectives.
  • Drive ongoing enhancements to the travel program, focusing on efficiency, cost optimization, and traveler satisfaction.
  • Oversee the evolution of the global travel program, including policy development, vendor partnerships, current technology and service delivery, to support changing business needs.
  • Remain informed on emerging practices, innovations, new technologies and trends within the corporate travel management industry.

Travel Policy & Compliance:

  • Establish, enforce, and monitor corporate travel policies across all regions.
  • Work closely with legal, finance, and risk management to ensure compliance with regulatory requirements and industry standards.
  • Review and update travel policies regularly to align with business needs, employee satisfaction, and market conditions.

Vendor Management & Partnerships:

  • Develop and manage strategic relationships with global travel suppliers (airlines, hotels, car rental companies, travel agencies, corporate card providers, duty of care partners, etc.), leading contract negotiations to achieve cost savings, ensure service quality, and maintain mutual compliance with contract performance standards.
  • Conduct regular evaluations of travel providers to monitor performance, optimize service levels, control costs, and support business continuity.
  • Stay informed of industry trends and organizational changes to identify, assess, and implement potential new suppliers or vendors that can enhance the Corporate Travel program.

Budget & Cost Management:

  • Support the management of HARMAN’s global travel budget, ensuring alignment with financial goals and cost control measures.
  • Implement strategies to reduce travel costs while maintaining employee satisfaction and safety.
  • Monitor and report on global travel expenses, identify trends, and recommend actions to improve cost efficiency.

Data Analytics & Reporting:

  • Utilize data analytics to track and optimize travel spending, monitor policy compliance, and ensure the travel program meets financial and operational KPIs.
  • Provide detailed reporting to senior management on travel performance, costs, and trends.
  • Conduct post-trip analysis to evaluate effectiveness and identify opportunities for improvements.

Global Travel Operations & Service:

  • Lead and manage a global team responsible for delivering travel services across multiple regions.
  • Oversee day-to-day operational support for travelers, ensuring a seamless and safe travel experience.
  • Maintain a traveler risk management program, ensuring safety and compliance with global travel regulations and policies.

Team Leadership & Development:

  • Lead and mentor a team of travel professionals, fostering a culture of excellence, accountability, and continuous learning.
  • Develop and deliver training programs to ensure consistent knowledge and adherence to travel policies across the organization.

What You Need to Be Successful

  • Bachelor’s degree in business administration, Supply Chain, Hospitality, or a related field, or experience equivalence.
  • 5–10 years of progressive corporate travel management experience, including 3–4 years in a global leadership role.
  • Industry-recognized credentials such as those from the Global Business Travel Association (GBTA), Association of Corporate Travel Executives (ACTE), or Project Management Professional (PMP) certification, Travel Risk Management are highly desirable.
  • Demonstrated success in leading global teams and managing large-scale travel programs, with the ability to motivate, support, and recognize team contributions.
  • Strong skills in vendor negotiation, contract management, and supplier relationship building.
  • Deep understanding of corporate travel policies, systems, and best practices, including duty-of-care frameworks and global travel risk management.
  • Proficiency with enterprise travel and expense systems (e.g., Emburse, Sabre, online booking tools, AMEX@Work, supplier portals, hotel RFP platforms).
  • Strong data analysis and management capabilities with the ability to convert insights into actionable strategies.
  • Excellent communication, leadership, and cross-cultural collaboration abilities.
  • Proven ability to excel in fast-paced, dynamic, and global environments.
  • Basic knowledge of website management and HTML.

What is Nice to Have

  • You are bilingual in other languages i.e., Spanish, Mandarin, German, etc.

What Makes You Eligible

  • A willingness to travel, if necessary
  • Due to the nature of global infrastructure, you understand that flexibility in working hours is required.
  • Successfully completing a background investigation and drug screen as a condition of employment

What We Offer

  • Flexible work environment, allowing for full-time remote work globally for positions that can be performed outside a HARMAN or customer location
  • Access to employee discounts on world-class Harman and Samsung products (JBL, HARMAN Kardon, AKG, etc.)
  • Extensive training opportunities through our own HARMAN University
  • Competitive wellness benefits
  • Tuition reimbursement
  • “Be Brilliant” employee recognition and rewards program
  • An inclusive and diverse work environment that fosters and encourages professional and personal development

You Belong Here

HARMAN is committed to making every employee feel welcomed, valued, and empowered. No matter what role you play, we encourage you to share your ideas, voice your distinct perspective, and bring your whole self with you – all within a support-minded culture that celebrates what makes each of us unique. We also recognize that learning is a lifelong pursuit and want you to flourish. We proudly offer added opportunities for training, development, and continuing education, further empowering you to live the career you want.

Ever since the 1920s, we’ve been amplifying the sense of sound. Today, that legacy endures, with integrated technology platforms that make the world smarter, safer, and more connected.

Across automotive, lifestyle, and digital transformation solutions, we create innovative technologies that turn ordinary moments into extraordinary experiences. raw.description:
Do you want to work with high-caliber professionals in a dynamic and growing company? Are you entrepreneurial, hard-working, and collegial? Join us at SB Energy, a leading infrastructure company backed by SoftBank Group and Ares Infrastructure, pairing cutting-edge innovation with best-in-class execution. Our mission is to deliver reliable and secure data center and power infrastructure to strengthen America's future.

Founded in 2019, SB Energy is a SoftBank Group company headquartered in Redwood City, California. In 2026, SoftBank Group and OpenAI announced a $1 billion investment to support SB Energy as their leading development and execution partner for data center campuses, while Ares Infrastructure continues its long-standing support of the company's growth. SB Energy develops, builds, owns, and operates some of the largest and most technically advanced energy and data center infrastructure projects in the United States. Since its founding, the company has rapidly grown into a top-tier integrated platform with more than 3 gigawatts (GW) in operation and a multi-GW pipeline of energy and data center infrastructure nationwide.

SB Energy also leverages a strong culture of innovation to identify and integrate new technologies into its projects, including its AI-based digital platform, delivering energy infrastructure that is local, reliable, and matched to load. We are building the energy and infrastructure future—today.

Come join us in accelerating the energy and infrastructure transition!

Basic Function:

SB Energy is seeking a Permitting Senior Manager dedicated to the Data Center team.

In this role, you will lead building, civil, fire and life safety, and operational permitting for SB Energy’s data center campuses and supporting facilities. You will organize complex approval workflows, establish clear responsibilities, and integrate permit schedules with phased construction, occupancy, and operational readiness across projects and jurisdictions.

This role requires strong management skills, disciplined follow-through, and the ability to hold multidisciplinary teams and consultants accountable for timely, complete deliverables. You will own the Data Center team’s permitting execution and partner with Development, Real Estate, Legal, and environmental specialists on related land-use, site-control, and environmental approvals.

Responsibilities:

  • Lead building and civil permits for data centers and support facilities, including site development, grading, drainage, roads, utilities, foundations, core and shell, interiors, and coordinated trade permits.
  • Establish and maintain a consolidated permit matrix identifying jurisdiction, scope, applicant, responsible owner, prerequisites, submission dates, review durations, approval milestones, conditions, and expiration dates.
  • Integrate permitting activities with design and construction schedules; identify critical dependencies, required design maturity, agency review cycles, and sequencing for early works and phased permit packages.
  • Lead recurring coordination meetings with clear agendas, decisions, action owners, and due dates; track commitments through closure and resolve handoff gaps between teams.
  • Direct permitting consultants and coordinate architects, civil engineers, contractors, and internal stakeholders; establish scopes, resource plans, deliverable expectations, and accountability for performance.
  • Manage application readiness reviews, submission logistics, fees, agency comments, and resubmittals; confirm packages contain coordinated drawings, calculations, forms, and required supporting studies.
  • Lead fire and life safety permitting with design professionals, fire marshals, and building officials, including fire protection systems, fire alarm, access, and applicable fuel-storage and hazardous-material approvals.
  • Maintain controlled records application versions, agency correspondence, and approvals so teams work from consistent information.
  • Assess permitting impacts of changes to building locations, utility routes, access roads, staging and laydown areas, and construction phasing; coordinate amendments before affected work proceeds.
  • Partner with Development, Real Estate, and Legal to align submissions with verified site control, parcel boundaries, ownership information, easements, access agreements, and parcel consolidation or subdivision requirements.
  • Support Development-led environmental permitting by coordinating design inputs and schedules for wetlands and streams, stormwater, air, species, and cultural-resource reviews, as applicable.
  • Maintain risk and issue registers; flag missing inputs, overdue decisions, and potential delays early, and present recovery plans, options, and leadership decisions needed.
  • Develop repeatable processes, dashboards, templates, and lessons learned; coach contributors and strengthen permitting execution across the portfolio.

Qualifications/Requirements:

  • 10+ years of experience in permitting, land development, design management, or construction delivery, including substantial responsibility for building and civil approvals on complex projects.
  • Demonstrated management experience leading multidisciplinary teams and external consultants, establishing ownership, allocating resources, resolving conflicts, and driving commitments to completion.
  • Proven ability to organize simultaneous permitting workstreams across multiple buildings, parcels, phases, and jurisdictions under demanding schedules.
  • Strong working knowledge of building, civil, fire and life safety, and operational permitting, including agency reviews, inspections, occupancy approvals, and recurring permit requirements.
  • Experience building integrated schedules, permit matrices, responsibility assignments, action logs, risk registers, and concise leadership reporting.
  • Ability to read architectural and civil drawings, site plans, surveys, permit boundaries, and technical reports and identify missing information or conflicting assumptions.
  • Strong written communication, meeting facilitation, negotiation, and stakeholder-management skills, including effective engagement with permitting authorities.
  • Proficiency with project tracking and scheduling tools, Excel, document-control systems, and drawing-review platforms such as Bluebeam.
  • Data center or mission-critical campus experience preferred; experience with phased construction, Section 401/404 coordination, construction stormwater permits, and complex land assemblies is valuable.
  • Professional credentials such as PMP, AICP, PE, or RA preferred but not required

Location: Redwood City, CA or Denver, CO or San Diego, CA or Remote

Base Pay: $150,000-$200,000

The pay range mentioned above is a guideline. We tailor each offer based on your unique skills, experience, location, and market benchmarks—while ensuring internal parity across our teams. The compensation range provided reflects base pay. Total rewards may also include performance-based bonuses, equity grants, and a market leading comprehensive health and wellness benefits package. Final details will be discussed during the later stages of the hiring process.

Our Health & Wellness Benefits

At SB Energy, we invest in our people and their families with benefits designed for flexibility, support, and peace of mind. Full-time employees enjoy:

  • 100% Company-Paid Medical, Dental & Vision (for employees and dependents)
  • 401(k) with Company Match
  • Generous Paid Time Off + 11 Paid Holidays
  • 12 Weeks Parental Leave
  • Life, AD&D & Long-Term Disability Coverage
  • Flexible Spending Accounts (FSA) for Medical, Dependent Care, Transit & Parking (with company contributions)
  • Mental, Physical & Social Wellness Support (with company contributions)
  • Flexible Work Arrangements & Hybrid Office Setup Benefits
  • Monthly Reimbursement for Phone, Internet & Data
  • Optional Legal & Pet Insurance Plans
  • Device Purchase Support

At SB Energy, the success of our projects is driven by a desire to see our projects benefit as many people as possible. We work to serve local communities through volunteering, fundraising, and much more. For example, we’re proud to support access and opportunity in engineering and clean energy through impactful mentorship programs and workforce training. When you join SB Energy, you can become a part of these efforts, collaborating with team members who share a vision of building a better future now!

SB Energy is built on a foundation of collaboration and inclusion. We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, creed, gender, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, marital status, pregnancy, sex, gender expression or identity, sexual orientation, citizenship, or any other legally protected class.

raw.description:
Standard Job Description

WHAT WE'RE DOING

Join the Kingdom of Saudia Arabia (KSA) Command, Control, Communications, Computers, and Intelligence (C4I) Modernization Team and be a critical contributor on the first-phase design team helping to shape the project’s overarching modernization initiatives.

The team’s primary focus during the design stage is to shape the functional architecture and system capabilities that will rapidly modernize the customer’s product line. Day-to-day activities will include (but are not limited to) requirements governance, architecture definition, system documentation, CONOPs development, and integration guidance/planning. This is an opportunity to help design and develop the updated baseline while working directly with an international customer.

THE WORK

The KSA C4I Team is seeking a systems engineer to join our development team. In this role, you will:

  • Decompose customer requirements and use cases into system capabilities and functions
  • Perform requirements tracing to ensure that the necessary system and subsystems are developed in accordance with customer requirements/expectations
  • Create/refine MBSE models depicting system architecture and system activity/sequence diagrams
  • Help contribute to various SE CDRL documents, including (but not limited to): SEMP, ICD, SDD’s, TEMP
  • Help refine and develop overall system CONOPs to ensure planned modernization capabilities continue to meet the overall mission needs

PLEASE NOTE

  • This position may require travel to customer sites throughout the KSA.
  • This position may occasionally support off-hours test events, including overnight and weekend activities.

WHO WE ARE

The KSA C4I Modernization Team is a geographically dispersed project team that will operate in an Agile Scrum environment. Team members have the opportunity to work directly with an international customer and gain exposure to the technologies and processes supporting this upgrade.

Come be a part of a rapidly developing, fast-paced project team that is empowered to quickly develop and iterate potential design upgrades, with a condensed feedback loop that allows for quick iterations on proposed updates. This customer environment is a unique experience for an engineer to put their stamp on drafting new system functionality with a very engaged customer in an accelerated design cycle. If the thought rapidly performing various design activities and growing your knowledge on the numerous types of systems engineering artifacts that are developed and delivered as part of design stage of a modernization upgrade project is exciting, then the KSA C4I Team is the place to be!

This team/position is contingent upon contract award.

Basic Qualifications

  • Experience in MBSE (Cameo, Rhapsody)
  • Experience Owning Requirements Traceability across various levels of systems/subsystems (DOORS, Jama)
  • Experience with Use Case and CONOPs Definition/Decomposition
  • Experience owning System/Subsystem Architecture Defintion/Decomposition
  • Experience Developing CDRL Documentation
  • 7+ years of relevant work experience

Desired Skills

  • Experience eliciting requirements/needs from customer interactions
  • Experience participating in System Verification/Validation activities
  • Previous C2 Domain Experience
  • Experience in Agile Methodologies & Tools
  • Previous International Customer Experience
  • Active Secret Clearance

Pay Information

GeoZone Definition: GeoZones are geographic groupings created by Lockheed Martin to align compensation ranges with regional labor markets and cost-of-labor differences across the United States. Locations are assigned a Geo Zone based on the primary work location of the role.

  • Full-time salary range (GEOZONE 1): $131100.00 - $243500.00
    • Includes metropolitan areas such as Sunnyvale CA; Pal Alto, CA; New York City metropolitan area; Newark, New Jersey; etc.
  • Full-time salary range (GEOZONE 2): $118000.00 - $219100.00
    • Includes metropolitan areas such as Denver, CO; King of Prussia, PA; Stratford, CT; Moorestown, NJ; etc.
  • Full-time salary range (GEOZONE 3): $104900.00 - $194700.00
    • Includes metropolitan areas such as Dallas–Fort Worth, TX; Orlando, FL; Grand Prairie, TX; Marietta, GA; etc.
  • Full-time salary range (GEOZONE 4): $94400.00 - $175200.00
    • Includes metropolitan areas such as Camden, AR; Lexington, KY; Lufkin, TX; etc.

At Lockheed Martin, we know mission success starts with taking care of our people. Our Total Rewards program is designed to attract top talent, support your well-being, and help you grow—both professionally and personally.

The salary range for this position is as listed on the requisition. Please note that the salary information listed is a general guideline only.
Lockheed Martin considers factors such as (but not limited to) scope and responsibilities of the position, candidate's work experience, education/ training, key skills as well as market(work location) and business considerations when extending an offer.

Benefits offered: Medical, Dental, Vision, Flexible work arrangements and schedules (e.g., 4x10), 401(k) match, Paid time off, Holidays, Parental Leave, EAP, Flexible Spending Accounts, Education Assistance, Life Insurance, Short-Term Disability, and Long-Term Disability.

  • Annual short-term and/or long-term incentive compensation programs may be offered depending on the position. Payments under these annual programs are not guaranteed and can vary from year to year and are tied to a range of performance metrics.
  • For (Washington state applicants only) Non-represented full-time employees: accrue at least 10 hours per month of Paid Time Off (PTO) to be used for incidental absences and other reasons; receive at least 90 hours for holidays. Represented full time employees accrue 6.67 hours of Vacation per month; accrue up to 52 hours of sick leave annually; receive at least 96 hours for holidays. PTO, Vacation, sick leave, and holiday hours are prorated based on start date during the calendar year.
