Rush Street Interactive (NYSE: RSI) is a market leader in online casino and sports betting, currently operating real-money gaming with our brands: BetRivers.com, PlaySugarHouse.com, and RushBet.co. We’re building bridges between online, social and land-based gaming businesses to create amazing, integrated experiences that keep players in the game.

The Product Manager is responsible for driving product initiatives within the casino area, from problem discovery through to delivery handoff and outcome measurement. Working under the guidance of the Director, Casino Product Management, this role owns day-to-day stakeholder engagement, problem definition, initiative shaping, and roadmap management within the casino product vertical, encompassing areas such as game content and merchandising, lobby experience and navigation, promotions and bonusing mechanics, and core gameplay features across casino games.

Product Managers collaborate closely with cross-functional teams to identify opportunities, validate problems, and shape well-defined epics. They are expected to be hands-on practitioners who bring analytical rigor, player empathy, and commercial awareness to every initiative.

This role requires a strong understanding of the online casino ecosystem, including slot and live dealer game mechanics, lobby merchandising and discovery, bonusing and free-play structures, and the player engagement loops that drive casino-specific retention and monetization. The Product Manager will work closely with Casino Operations, Data, and CRM teams to ensure the game catalog, lobby experience, and promotional mechanics reflect player preferences and deliver measurable engagement, retention, and revenue outcomes. Operating within the fast-paced and highly regulated online gaming and sports betting industry, success in this role depends on strong analytical skills, a data-driven mindset, and an understanding of the regulatory landscape that shapes product decisions across multiple markets.

Our mission is to engage and delight players by delivering fun, fair, friendly, and focused experiences. We are committed to transparency, responsible gaming, and building an award-winning platform that provides exciting, differentiated, and personalized offerings to our customers.

What You'll Do:

Product Discovery & Problem Definition

  • Conduct discovery activities to identify, validate, and prioritize problems and opportunities within your product area
  • Develop a strong understanding of player needs, business goals, and operational constraints through research, data analysis, and stakeholder conversations
  • Translate inputs from stakeholders, data, and player feedback into clearly defined problem statements and opportunity spaces

Stakeholder Engagement

  • Build and maintain productive working relationships with stakeholders across the business domain
  • Ensure stakeholders have visibility into priorities, tradeoffs, and progress within your product area
  • Communicate roadmap updates, initiative status, and outcomes clearly and consistently

Ideation & Initiative Shaping

  • Collaborate with Design, Data, and Engineering to ideate product solutions that address validated problems
  • Shape initiatives into well-defined epics, including:
    • Clear problem statement and context
    • Value hypothesis and expected impact
    • Success metrics and measurement approach
    • High-level solution direction and scope
    • Initial wireframes or conceptual designs where applicable

Roadmap Management

  • Contribute to and maintain the product roadmap for your area, ensuring alignment with the broader product strategy set by senior product leadership
  • Prioritize initiatives based on impact, feasibility, and strategic relevance
  • Continuously refine the roadmap based on new insights, data and changing conditions

Outcome Ownership & Impact Assessment

  • Define success metrics for each initiative and ensure proper measurement is in place
  • Evaluate the impact of delivered initiatives against expected outcomes
  • Take accountability for results, identifying gaps and recommending follow-up actions
  • Feed learnings back into future discovery and roadmap planning

Data-Driven Decision Making

  • Leverage analytics platforms, A/B testing frameworks, and player behavior data to inform product discovery, prioritization, and post-launch evaluation
  • Partner with Data and Analytics teams to define KPIs, build dashboards, and run experiments within your product area
  • Use quantitative and qualitative research methods to validate hypotheses and measure outcomes

Regulatory & Responsible Gaming Awareness

  • Factor regulatory requirements, licensing conditions, and market-specific compliance considerations into product decisions within your area
  • Support responsible gaming principles by ensuring product features align with player safety and responsible play standards
  • Stay informed on relevant regulations across RSI’s operating markets and flag product implications to senior leadership

Personalization & Player Experience

  • Contribute to product initiatives that enhance personalization, player engagement, and retention within your area
  • Collaborate with CRM, Marketing, and Data teams to support tailored player journeys and differentiated offerings
  • Advocate for the player experience in product decisions, ensuring alignment with RSI’s mission

Collaboration with Technology & Product Delivery

  • Partner with Product Owners and the Product Delivery organization, providing clear, well-defined epics that are ready for delivery planning
  • Serve as a point of contact for stakeholders on product needs within your scope
  • Ensure initiatives meet a high bar of readiness before handoff, including clear problem definition, scope, success metrics, and business context
  • Collaborate with Technology Product Managers to support solution shaping, ensuring alignment between product intent and technical approach
  • Work with Product Owners during delivery planning to clarify intent, resolve ambiguities, and support prioritization decisions
  • Stay available throughout delivery to answer questions, validate assumptions, and ensure alignment with the original problem and expected impact
  • Participate in continuous improvement efforts around handoff quality and planning effectiveness

What You'll Bring:

  • Bachelor’s degree in computer science, business administration, information systems, data science, marketing, economics, engineering, or a relevant field required.
  • 5+ years in product management with progressive responsibility, including ownership of product roadmaps and cross-functional stakeholder management.
  • Experience in iGaming, online casino, sports betting, or adjacent regulated consumer tech industries.
  • Familiarity with agile delivery, A/B testing, and analytics platforms.
  • Able to travel occasionally both domestically and internationally

rockITdata is seeking a highly experienced Senior Subject Matter Expert (SME) – Federal Healthcare IT Acquisition & Contracts to provide expert-level consulting and strategic advisory services supporting complex federal healthcare technology modernization initiatives.

The ideal candidate will possess extensive experience in federal acquisition, contract strategy, enterprise technology licensing, and complex contractual arrangements, with a strong understanding of large-scale healthcare IT programs. This individual will serve as a trusted advisor to program and executive leadership, providing independent analysis, strategic recommendations, and subject matter expertise related to acquisition planning, contract terms and conditions, commercial licensing arrangements, and contractual risk mitigation.

This position requires an independent, strategic thinker capable of evaluating complex contractual and technical challenges, developing innovative solutions, and advising senior stakeholders on high-visibility initiatives.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Provide expert-level consulting and strategic advisory services related to federal acquisition, contract management, and complex healthcare IT modernization programs.

  • Provide strategic advisory support to program and executive leadership on acquisition strategies, contract structures, commercial agreements, and contractual risk mitigation.

  • Analyze complex contract terms, conditions, pricing structures, licensing arrangements, and performance requirements to identify risks, opportunities, and recommended business positions.

  • Conduct independent analysis of complex contractual arrangements, including cost and pricing structures, enterprise software licensing, intellectual property, data rights, and long-term sustainment considerations, to inform business decisions.

  • Provide subject matter expertise on the Federal Acquisition Regulation (FAR), Defense Federal Acquisition Regulation Supplement (DFARS), and applicable federal contracting policies and procedures.

  • Evaluate contract requirements, statements of work, acquisition documentation, and proposed contractual changes to ensure alignment with program objectives and business requirements.

  • Advise on acquisition and contracting considerations associated with large-scale electronic health record (EHR) implementations, enterprise technology modernization, and multi-agency healthcare initiatives.

  • Develop strategic recommendations, executive briefings, contract assessments, and decision-support materials for senior program and business leadership.

  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams, including contracts, legal, finance, technical, and program management personnel, to address complex contractual and business challenges.

  • Identify and evaluate contractual, financial, operational, and programmatic risks, recommending practical solutions to support successful contract execution.

  • Provide guidance on Indefinite Delivery/Indefinite Quantity (IDIQ) contracts, task orders, contract modifications, and alternative acquisition strategies.

  • Independently plan, conduct, and lead specialized research and analysis resulting in recommendations and solutions to complex, high-visibility challenges.

  • Serve as a senior subject matter expert on complex federal healthcare technology contracting matters, providing independent assessments and recommendations to support informed decision-making and successful program outcomes.

  • Interface effectively with senior client and management personnel regarding strategic issues and perform effectively under demanding assignments and compressed timelines.

Required Qualifications:

  • Master's degree in Business Administration, Finance, Acquisition Management, Contract Management, or a related discipline.

  • 20+ years of relevant professional experience in federal acquisition, government contracting, contract management, technology program management, or related fields.

  • Extensive experience with federal acquisition strategies, complex contractual arrangements, enterprise technology agreements, and advising senior leadership on federal contracting matters.

  • Demonstrated expertise in FAR, DFARS, federal procurement regulations, and government contracting practices.

  • Strong understanding of enterprise software licensing, contract pricing, intellectual property, data rights, and complex technology acquisition structures.

  • Experience supporting major federal technology programs involving multiple stakeholders, significant contract values, and complex contractual requirements.

  • Demonstrated ability to independently evaluate complex business and contractual challenges and develop innovative, actionable recommendations.

  • Exceptional analytical, written communication, and executive-level presentation skills.

  • Ability to effectively engage with senior government, contractor, and executive stakeholders.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Prior experience serving as a federal Contracting Officer, senior acquisition executive, contracting office leader, or equivalent senior contracting advisor.

  • Extensive experience supporting Department of Defense (DoD), Defense Health Agency (DHA), Department of Veterans Affairs (VA), Indian Health Service (IHS), or other federal healthcare organizations.

  • Experience with federal EHR acquisition, deployment, modernization, and sustainment programs.

  • Demonstrated experience assessing enterprise software licensing agreements and complex commercial technology contracts.

  • Experience conducting cost and price evaluations, source selections, and acquisition strategy development for major federal programs.

  • Familiarity with large-scale healthcare IT implementations, system integration, and multi-agency program governance.

  • Defense Acquisition Workforce Improvement Act (DAWIA) contracting certification or equivalent federal acquisition credentials.

  • Certified Federal Contracts Manager (CFCM), Certified Professional Contracts Manager (CPCM), or comparable professional certification.

The Director, Audience & Connections Strategy at Wpromote x Giant Spoon will be a key strategic partner, blending audience intelligence with connections planning to design cross-channel strategies that connect brands with their most valuable consumers. As an individual contributor reporting to the VP, Strategy & Insights, this person will apply data, insights, and cultural understanding to develop meaningful, cross-channel communication strategies across media touchpoints for assigned clients.

You must have deep expertise in both audience strategy and connections planning, with the ability to turn complex insights into actionable, full-funnel strategies that deliver cohesive, connected brand experiences. This role is built for someone who can think holistically about how audiences engage across platforms and bring that vision to life through smart, integrated media solutions.

You Will Be

  • Contributing to the development of comprehensive connections strategies across paid, owned, and earned channels

  • Conducting analysis and research to uncover category, cultural, and consumer insights

  • Creating meaningful consumer journeys that map the path to purchase, identify key moments of influence, and inform cross-channel strategy decisions

  • Serving as a strategic thought partner to clients, providing expert guidance on media investment decisions

  • Collaborating closely with media, data, account and creative teams, ensuring strategic guidance aligns with broader campaign objectives

  • Defining the measurement framework across the consumer journey, ensuring we aren't just tracking "clicks," but meaningful business outcomes

  • Representing the agency's strategic point of view in client presentations and new business pitches

  • Leading strategy and insights on new business pitches and collaborating closely with media strategy

  • Contributing to thought leadership initiatives that position the agency as an industry leader

  • Providing strategic guidance and feedback to cross-functional partners on assigned accounts

You Must Have

  • 6-8 years of experience in consumer insights, connections strategy, or related field in an Advertising/Media agency environment

  • Deep expertise in using audience and competitive intelligence tools like GWI, MRI-Simmons, Resonate, Kantar/Media Radar, Pathmatics, EDO, and Similarweb to translate data into bold, insight-driven strategies that push brands forward

  • Proven success partnering with integrated media teams to develop and execute strategies across both traditional and digital channels

  • The ability to cultivate and grow client partnerships, driving collaboration, trust, and strategic alignment to deliver outstanding results

  • A background supporting new business pitches and collaborating closely with media strategy

  • Experience presenting strategic recommendations to senior client stakeholders and internal leadership

  • Deep understanding of the media landscape, including digital, social, programmatic, and traditional channels

  • Strong analytical skills with the ability to identify meaningful insights and patterns

  • Experience developing consumer journey frameworks and campaign platforms

  • Working knowledge with AI tools and being able to design creative prompts for ideation and framework development

  • A strategic mindset with a consumer-centric approach

  • Strong communication and presentation skills that inspire clients and teams

  • An understanding of media planning, research, and measurement methodologies

What We Offer

    At Wpromote, we believe that great work is only possible with great people. Our goal is to build a better, more inclusive work environment and support our people at every stage of their careers by prioritizing a strong work-life balance through our policies and benefits listed below. As a Best Place to Work according to both Ad Age and Glassdoor and Adweek’s Fastest Growing Digital Agency, we are moving fast to expand our teams and bring new experts into the fold to keep pushing the boundaries of what’s possible in marketing.
    We offer:
    -Remote-first culture
    -Unlimited PTO
    -Extended Holiday break (Winter)
    -Flexible schedules
    -Work from anywhere options*
    -100% paid parental leave
    -401(k) matching
    -Medical, Dental, Vision, Life, Pet Insurance
    -Sponsored life insurance
    -Short Term Disability insurance and additional voluntary insurance
    -Annual Class Pass credits and more!
    The anticipated annual salary for this role will range from $118,000 - $130,000, based on consideration of a wide array of factors unique to each candidate, including but not limited to skill set, years and depth of experience, education and certifications, competitive benchmarks, scope of responsibility, market dynamics, geographic location, and respective state’s salary threshold for exempt employees. The total compensation package for this role will include benefits and an annual performance bonus.

    This role has an associated annual target bonus component which is paid out based on a number of factors which include Company performance, department performance, and individual performance. Bonuses are not guaranteed and you must be an active employee in good standing and not on a Performance Improvement Plan to be eligible for the annual bonus.

    *This position may be performed remotely in most states within the US, with some exclusions
    **While this role offers the flexibility to work remotely, we have office hubs in Los Angeles and New York, where you can join in on learning and development opportunities, fun events, take advantage of a space to work, and collaborate in person!
    ***This position is not eligible for immigration sponsorship
    Important Notice: Beware of Job Scams

If you see a posting elsewhere that is not reflected on Wpromote.com/careers, it may be a fraudulent posting. We do not require payment or fees during the hiring process nor do we request sensitive information, such as Social Security numbers or payment details. Please safeguard yourself against possible scams and contact us if you encounter any suspicious activity.
Wpromote is committed to bringing together individuals from different backgrounds and perspectives, providing employees with a safe and welcoming environment free of discrimination and harassment. We strive to create a diverse & inclusive environment where everyone can thrive, feel a sense of belonging, and do impactful work together. As an equal opportunity employer, we prohibit any unlawful discrimination against a job applicant on the basis of their race, color, religion, gender, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, national origin, family or parental status, disability*, age, veteran status, or any other status protected by the laws or regulations in the locations where we operate. About Us:

Verifiable is a provider credentialing and network monitoring platform, delivering industry-leading AI, API and Software solutions to help healthcare organizations optimize operations at enterprise scale. We are a top Salesforce partner, winning the 2024 Salesforce Partner Innovation Award, and also were named to Inc. 5000 2025, the most prestigious ranking of America's fastest-growing private companies. We work with leading healthcare organizations such as Humana Dental, Talkspace, Headway, Empower Pharmacy, and many others.
We're a fast-moving, early-stage team that values impact, ownership, and follow-through. Everyone here rolls up their sleeves, dives into ambiguity, and takes end-to-end responsibility for meaningful work. Priorities shift, problems aren’t always perfectly defined, and we move with urgency so we look for people who are energized by hard problems, rapid learning, and stepping in wherever the team needs support.
We’re collaborative and human, but we keep a high bar. If you thrive in a scrappy, high-ownership environment where your work directly shapes the company’s trajectory, you’ll feel right at home here.
Verifiable is seeking an experienced Senior Customer Success Manager to drive customer satisfaction, retention, and growth within our strategic accounts. This role will be the primary point of contact for key customers—ensuring seamless onboarding, delivering ongoing technical support, identifying expansion opportunities, translating customer feedback into actionable insights, and ultimately delivering ROI for customers. You’ll work cross-functionally with Product, Solutions, Enablement, and Support to build lasting relationships and maximize customer value.

Key Responsibilities

  • Develop Verifiable product expertise to build credibility and add value for customers, including an understanding of underlying technical architecture and APIs for integration discussions.
  • Partner with sales and implementation to support smooth onboarding, ongoing training, and adoption of contracted functionality.
  • Form deep relationships with customers, serve as a trusted advisor, and ensure ongoing success, engagement, and strategic conversations with key executive stakeholders and decision makers.
  • Conduct regular touch bases and quarterly business reviews across your accounts to ensure retention and strategic alignment between Verifiable and our customers.
  • Identify upsell and expansion opportunities by understanding customer goals and aligning them with new product features or services.
  • Drive commercial negotiations with customers and internal legal and finance teams to efficiently and symbiotically close deals and restructure contracts.
  • Drive a feedback loop with cross-functional teams by gathering and synthesizing customer inputs to inform product development and prioritize roadmap enhancements.
  • Support accounts with custom reporting needs outside of the standard product. This includes leveraging advanced reporting features and building Salesforce workflows for complex custom use cases.
  • Monitor account health and proactively resolve and escalate issues to reduce churn.
  • Maintain CRM hygiene, ensuring account records and documentation are up to date. This includes optimizing Salesforce instances and ensuring data integrity.
  • Pursue ongoing healthcare industry and CRM platform education and training.
  • Contribute to team-wide initiatives to make Verifiable a great place to work and drive Customer Success department efficiencies.

Qualifications

  • 5+ years of Senior Customer Success in B2B SaaS (healthcare and Salesforce experience preferred)
  • Familiarity with Salesforce CRM and customer success tools, including experience building or troubleshooting basic Salesforce process builder/flow automations and reports.
  • Experience managing a book of business > $3M ARR, building pipeline, & closing deals
  • Strong Executive relationship-building, communication, presentation and problem-solving skills
  • Experience navigating complex, matrixed client relationships and driving retention
  • Proven ability to translate technical concepts into business value for non-technical stakeholders.

More About Verifiable:

In just five years, we’ve grown to nearly 150 people, and we’re not slowing down. Strong, steady revenue growth helped us land a $27M Series B led by Craft Ventures, bringing our total funding to $47M. Our latest launch, CredAgent, brings autonomous AI agents to healthcare credentialing for the first time. Join us as we keep scaling!

Benefits & Perks:

  • Health that’s got your back: we invest in your coverage, with options for you and your family's needs.
  • Unlimited PTO: flexible time off built on ownership. We trust you to plan ahead, own your deliverables, and make sure your team is set up for success while you’re out.
  • Own a piece of what you build: startup equity means you share in our success.
  • Work from anywhere: we’re fully distributed, and you can work from home in one of our eligible US states.
  • New Apple setup: a company-issued MacBook and accessories are yours to work on. Heads up that we’re Mac-only, since our systems are built for macOS.
  • Modern tools: Google Workspace, Notion, and company-wide AI tools like Claude for seamless collaboration and to help you work smarter.

Clearance: Ability to obtain a Public Trust clearance

The USAID Office of the General Counsel (OGC) advice and legal services on litigation, contracting, legislative and administrative matters is seeking a Senior Contract Attorney - Ligitation Support.

The position requires deep expertise in litigation before federal courts and administrative forums within the Federal Government. The Senior Contract Attorney – Litigation Support works closely with other OGC lawyers to provide authoritative legal opinions on complex or sensitive matters and in offering strategic guidance on legal risk management and compliance. This role includes the preparation of high-level legal memoranda, discovery requests and responses and communication with outside counsel, e.g. DoJ, and internal offices to meet litigation deadlines. Responsibilities

  • Reviews legal documents to extract selected data and information relating to specific cases;
  • Drafts and edits non-legal memoranda, research reports, and correspondence relating to cases; and

Qualifications

  • Ability to handle, defend and monitor responses to cases, including drafting timely pleadings and correspondence with outside counsel as needed;
  • Conduct research and analyze information to support decision-making;

  • Advanced level of proficiency in the use of Google Applications and Microsoft Office Suite (Word, Excel, PowerPoint); and

raw.description:
About Verve

At Verve, we’re redefining how insight works in an AI-powered world — combining Human, Cultural and Artificial Intelligence to help clients act with greater speed and confidence.

Through Verve Vero — our AI-powered platform and consultancy ecosystem — we build AI-enabled insight tools, simulations and models that bring human truth into the heart of decision-making. From Verve Intelligent Personas & Simulations to bespoke solutions grounded in client data, everything we create is designed to enable confident decisions of consequence with real-world impact.

Our work spans categories and continents, helping global brands navigate complex challenges — from innovation and brand strategy to customer experience and future planning. We combine deep human understanding with AI to deliver insight that is faster, more scalable, and more actionable.

This is a hands-on environment. We move quickly, test and learn, and continuously build and refine the tools that power our work. Curiosity, experimentation and practical application sit at the heart of how we operate.

About the Role

If you’re a hands-on technical builder who wants to experiment with AI and turn ideas into working products — this is it.

As a Technical AI Developer in our R&D Lab, you’ll be responsible for bringing ideas to life — rapidly prototyping, testing emerging technologies and building the technical foundations of new Vero tools and processes.

This isn’t a role where you’ll simply oversee development. You’ll build.

You’ll work closely with our product team and wider R&D colleagues to explore what’s possible, test ideas quickly and turn the strongest experiments into robust, scalable solutions.

Your Contribution

  • Rapidly prototype new AI-enabled Vero tools, features and processes
  • Build and test solutions using Python, APIs, LLMs and emerging AI technologies
  • Develop and experiment with RAG, vector embeddings, MCP and agentic pipelines
  • Explore new technologies and assess where they can solve real user and business problems
  • Run fast, lightweight technical experiments to test feasibility and value
  • Build integrations between AI models, data sources and other services
  • Test, debug and refine prototypes based on real-world use
  • Improve the technical performance and capability of existing Vero tools and workflows
  • Work with product and R&D colleagues to translate successful prototypes into production-ready solutions
  • Bring technical judgement to decisions around feasibility, scalability and how things should be built

What We’re Looking For

  • Strong, hands-on Python experience
  • Practical experience building with LLMs and APIs
  • Working knowledge of AI concepts and infrastructure including prompt engineering, RAG, MCP, vector embeddings and agentic pipelines
  • Evidence that you’ve built and experimented with AI applications, not just worked alongside teams that have
  • A practical problem-solving mindset — you like making things, testing them and figuring out why they don’t work
  • Comfortable experimenting with emerging technologies where there may not yet be a clear playbook
  • Able to balance speed of experimentation with building solutions that can ultimately scale
  • Comfortable working collaboratively with product and other non-technical colleagues
  • Able to explain technical decisions and complexity clearly
  • A growth mindset — you’re comfortable with ambiguity, take initiative and thrive in fast-moving, entrepreneurial environments
  • A Computer Science degree or similar is preferred, but not required.

Bonus Points For

  • Experience building modern web applications, for example using React or TypeScript
  • Experience using rapid prototyping or low/no-code tools such as Lovable
  • Experience building AI tools that improve business processes or ways of working
  • Experience taking early-stage AI experiments towards production
  • Experience in the market research or insight sector

What We Offer

  • Exposure to cutting-edge AI tools and thinking — practical, not theoretical
  • The opportunity to build AI products that solve genuine business and insight problems
  • Working at the intersection of AI, technology, product and consultancy
  • A fast-paced, agile and empowering environment
  • Autonomy to experiment, test, learn and influence how things get built
  • Collaboration with an ambitious global team solving real-world problems

If you’re excited by the opportunity to build the tools shaping the future of AI-empowered consultancy — experimenting quickly, solving difficult technical problems and turning ideas into things people can actually use — we’d love to hear from you.

By applying to Verve, you acknowledge our use of AI-assisted tools to help screen applications against job-related criteria. All outcomes are reviewed by humans and are not determinative. You can request human review, express your views, or contest any assessment at any time via . Full details can be found in our Recruitment Privacy Notice.

raw.description:
TTEC Digital seeks a Senior Frontend Engineer (React + Chrome Extension) to join our team. This role is a full-time and fully remote opportunity!

The work:

We're an innovation group inside TTEC (NASDAQ: TTEC), building the next generation of AI CX tools — automated QA, conversational analytics, knowledge assist, and agentic automation — for the world's biggest brands and the millions of customers they serve. We move like an early-stage startup, backed by the scale, distribution, and enterprise client base of a company that's been obsessed with customer experience since 1982.

This is the rare seat where getting in early actually matters at scale. TTEC is a public company at an AI inflection point. Ship the right products into thousands of live enterprise deployments and you don't just move a metric — you move the trajectory of the company and the value of the stock. The leverage is real, and the work compounds.

Who we hire — the DNA

  • Self-starters and do-ers with grit — hackers in the best sense, with a startup mentality and a show-me bias: working software over slides, prototypes over proposals.
  • Want to learn, love new technology. This platform is built on the latest technology, and that technology changes and advances monthly. You adapt to change quickly — new tools, new models, new priorities — without drama.
  • Master debuggers and problem solvers. You love solving complex problems, you think outside the box, and you multitask across domains without losing the thread.
  • AI-native. You work with AI on all levels — you understand the technology around you (LLMs, SLMs, RAG, knowledge graphs, agents, training, eval) and you use AI tools daily to exponentially increase your velocity.
  • Distributed-systems literate. High-efficiency, event-driven, low-latency systems are our world; you understand what that demands.
  • Innovators who ship. You demonstrate ideas easily, fail fast, and move forward. You make committed timelines and hit them.
  • You consider yourself exceptional — and you like winning. So do we.

No one will have everything in this description. We're looking for well-rounded, smart people who move fast.

What You Will Do:

The role:

  • Build the Agent UI shell, the Chrome extension, the slide-out / pill workspace, the Control UI, and the per-module panels. This is the product wedge — what an evaluator demos in 5 minutes and decides "yes."
  • Real-time UI over live voice, desktop, and AI event streams, in a startup environment: 1-week sprints, Friday demos, fail fast and move forward.

What you'll own:

  • React app + Chrome extension (Manifest V3, content scripts, injected iframe, page-overlay pill) ·
  • WebSocket-driven real-time UI · plugin / module-federation patterns
  • Screen-real-estate management
  • The design system in code
  • Your committed timelines.

Who you are:

  • A self-starter with a show-me mentality — you move from prototype to real-world product quickly and demonstrate ideas with working UI, not mockups.
  • You love new technology and adapt fast when it changes.
  • Consistent by discipline: you use shared libraries and established patterns instead of reinventing per feature — consistency is what keeps a small team fast.
  • You use AI tools daily to multiply your velocity.
  • You consider yourself exceptional, love solving hard problems, and like winning.

What You Will Bring:

  • 7+ years frontend; senior-level React + TypeScript mandatory. HTML5, JavaScript, and graphics skills all ++++ —
  • You're a master of the browser platform itself, not just a framework user (canvas/SVG/WebGL, animation, rendering).
  • Strong design/UI skills a +++ — you have taste; your UIs look and feel professional without a designer holding your hand.
  • Real Chrome Extension experience — Manifest V3, content scripts, the messaging model, injecting UI over a host page. This is core, not a footnote.
  • Strong API skills — you design and consume clean APIs, and you understand the backend messaging systems behind them (pub/sub, event streams, WebSocket) well enough to reason about ordering, reconnects, and state sync.
  • Heavy WebSocket / real-time UI; you've built interfaces that update from a live event stream.
  • Plugin / module-federation or dynamic-component-loading experience.
  • Performance as a habit — render profiling, virtualization for dense data, sub-frame updates under a firehose event stream; the UI must never be the latency bottleneck.
  • State management under streaming data — optimistic updates, reconnect/replay handling, conflict resolution.
  • Extension security fluency — CSP, sandboxing, isolated worlds; we inject UI into other companies' pages and can never break or leak.
  • Automated UI testing (Playwright-class) as part of shipping, not a QA handoff.
  • Accessibility and keyboard-first flows as defaults — agents live in this UI 8 hours a day.
  • A master debugger in the browser — DevTools is an extension of your hands; you see the render bug, the leak, the layout thrash.
  • Go literacy is a plus (you'll read it).

As we’re scaling, our Grip team is looking for a Junior Project Support, who is going to work closely with our Project Management team to support and coordinate data for projects.

What’s Grip?

Grip supports brands to cope with the fast-accelerating challenge of the exponential grow and need for content. Grip is web-based software that automatically generates visual content. It’s based on photorealistic 3D, capitalizing on INDG’s twenty-year-long experience in that field. 3D is good because once your beer or your juicer or your rocket is on Grip, it can be used and re-used for multiple media: images, videos, iOS apps, and such.

Requirements

What will you be doing?

  • Work closely with Project Management team to ensure productivity

  • Ensure that issues and challenges related to the project are identified

  • Keep track of Jira tasks and tickets

  • Renaming files

  • Uploading of files to KO Assets using a standard uploading tool

  • Upload renderings for revision or client’s Sharepoint

  • Create project codes

  • Registration of approvals on templates and images

  • Support in administration and registration

Would be amazing if you have:

  • Excellent organizational and time management skills

  • Excellent attention to details, data, facts and numbers, accuracy and analytical mindset

  • Advanced user level experience with MS Office (Excel, PowerPoint)

  • Get the job done mentality

  • Good communication skills

  • English proficiency (written and spoken)

Nice to have:

raw.description:
Overview

Nakupuna Companies is seeking a Senior Computer Systems Engineer/Architect with Informatica expertise to join our team of talented consultants. The individual will provide solution architecture execution strategy for the Informatica implementation in NAVSUP AWS GovCloud. This role is responsible for the cross-platform design, Everything as Code approach, security architecture, availability and recovery strategy, CI/CD practices, technical integration decisions, and day-to-day engineering coordination needed to move the solution from architecture through production sustainment.

The individual will support NAVSUP Business Systems Center as the senior solution architect for the design, integration, testing, deployment, documentation, and sustainment of the Informatica Data Governance Suite within NAVSUP’s AWS GovCloud environment. Develop the cross-platform architecture and engineering standards for high availability, disaster recovery, security, Everything as Code, CI/CD, monitoring, configuration management, and change control. Coordinate technical activities across the Informatica, database, cloud, cybersecurity, and testing workstreams; identify architecture dependencies and risks; and ensure technical artifacts are secure, reproducible, supportable, and ready for Government review. Support RMF/ATO activities, performance and capacity planning, operational readiness, and knowledge transfer to NAVSUP personnel.

Responsibilities

The following reflects management's definition of essential functions for this job but does not restrict the tasks that may be assigned. Management may assign additional duties and responsibilities to this job at any time due to mission requirements and reasonable accommodation.

  • Develop the high-availability architecture recommendation and agile prototype, including component sizing, dependencies, network design, compute, storage, load balancing, capacity, and cost considerations.
  • Define reliability objectives, RTO and RPO targets, failover strategies, backup and retention methods, restoration procedures, disaster-recovery tests, and rollback plans.
  • Lead the Everything as Code approach across infrastructure, configuration, security, governance policy, testing, and CI/CD deployment; ensure artifacts are reproducible and retained in Government version control.
  • Design AWS GovCloud resources and controls, including EC2, S3, networking, routing, security groups, load balancers, IAM roles, service accounts, logging, monitoring, and approved encryption.
  • Establish technical standards for source control, branching, peer review, automated testing, automated deployment, configuration management, and change control.
  • Lead security engineering for PKI, SSO, LDAP, OCSP, certificates, RBAC, least privilege, Zero Trust, logging, vulnerability remediation, and integration with NAVSUP security operations.
  • Coordinate RMF/ATO and STIG compliance activities, including control mappings, diagrams, system-security documentation, hardening evidence, POA&M inputs, retesting, and closure support.
  • Guide Informatica platform architecture, data integration, performance testing, interoperability, and operational-readiness decisions across the team.
  • Review and approve internal technical designs, scripts, code, configurations, tests, diagrams, runbooks, and deployment packages for quality, consistency, security, and supportability.
  • Establish continuous monitoring for availability, performance, errors, capacity, cost, API metrics, and data-quality indicators using CloudWatch, Splunk, AppDynamics, Informatica, or comparable tools.
  • Coordinate technical risk management, issue resolution, root-cause analysis, vendor coordination, sprint planning, milestone reviews, Government briefings, and stakeholder decision support.
  • Plan and deliver hands-on knowledge transfer so NAVSUP administrators and engineers can operate, maintain, recover, and enhance the solution.
  • Performs other related duties as assigned

Qualifications

Skills/Qualifications:

In addition to being able to confidently perform the above job duties, the candidate should demonstrate the following:

  • Technical Leadership - Provides clear day-to-day direction across Informatica, AWS, security, testing, and sustainment work; reviews designs and engineering artifacts critically and resolves cross-platform risks before they reach production.
  • Agile / DevSecOps - Turns architecture into prioritized, testable work with clear dependencies, acceptance criteria, and decision points; establishes repeatable source-control, peer-review, automated-testing, and CI/CD practices.
  • Analytical / Problem Solving - Balances mission needs, security, reliability, performance, capacity, recovery, cost, and long-term supportability; uses evidence and prototypes to resolve uncertainty and clearly frames options for Government decisions.
  • Communication / Teamwork - Communicates technical issues, risks, and tradeoffs in terms that both engineers and Government leaders can act on; creates a collaborative environment across a small multidisciplinary team and external stakeholders.
  • Quality / Coaching - Sets and enforces standards for architecture, code, configuration, tests, diagrams, runbooks, and security evidence; builds Government ownership through practical mentoring, recorded walkthroughs, and current sustainment documentation.

Education and Experience:

Education: A bachelor's degree in computer science, engineering, information systems, cybersecurity, or a related technical field is preferred.

Required experience: The candidate must be able to demonstrate the following:

  • 7 years of hands-on Informatica experience
  • 10 years of senior-level experience architecting working with enterprise platforms in AWS or AWS GovCloud from design through production operations.
  • Strong knowledge of cloud computing, storage, networking, security groups, load balancing, identity and access management, encryption, monitoring, performance, capacity, and cost optimization.
  • Experience implementing Infrastructure as Code, Configuration as Code, Security or Policy as Code, automated testing, Git-based version control, and CI/CD pipelines.
  • Experience designing high availability, backup, disaster recovery, RTO/RPO, failover, restoration testing, and rollback for production systems.
  • Working knowledge of enterprise API, data-integration, data-governance, metadata, data-quality, and relational data-warehouse architectures.
  • Strong knowledge of RMF/ATO, STIGs, NIST 800-53 controls, system hardening, PKI, SSO, RBAC, logging, vulnerability remediation, and Zero Trust concepts.
  • Demonstrated ability to lead a small multidisciplinary engineering team and work directly with Government technical, security, contracting, and program stakeholders.
  • Ability to review technical work critically, resolve cross-platform issues, manage risk, and maintain clear architecture and operational documentation.
  • U.S. citizenship and ability to meet all privileged-access, background-investigation, CAC, SAAR, training, certification, and NDA requirements.

Preferred experience: The following experience will strengthen the candidate's fit for this role:

  • Recent AWS GovCloud architecture and DevSecOps experience supporting DoD or other Federal production systems.
  • AWS Solutions Architect Professional, AWS DevOps Engineer Professional, AWS Security Specialty, or comparable current certification.
  • Experience with Terraform, AWS CloudFormation, Ansible, or comparable IaC/CaC tooling and Azure DevOps repositories and pipelines.
  • Architecture or technical-lead experience involving MuleSoft Anypoint Platform and Informatica Enterprise Data Catalog, Axon, Data Quality, or PowerCenter.
  • Experience integrating CloudWatch, Splunk, AppDynamics, or comparable observability platforms with enterprise applications.
  • Prior experience with Navy data, WDP/Jupiter, Flank Speed, Microsoft Power Platform, logistics systems, or Government API-management initiatives.

Certifications:

Required: Current DoD 8140.03 IAT Level II baseline certification at the start of performance: CompTIA Security+ CE or a PWS-listed substitute (CCNA, CySA+, GICSP, GSEC, or CND).

Required within six months: An applicable computing-environment certification in AWS, Windows, Oracle, UNIX, or Linux, coordinated to the assigned environment.

Clearance and access: This position requires U.S. citizenship, CAC eligibility, and a final, favorably adjudicated T5, T5R, SSBI, or equivalent investigation before privileged access is granted. Interim privileged access is authorized. The certification requirements stated above also apply.

raw.description:
Launched in 2012, BorrowMyDoggy is the UK’s leading dog-sharing marketplace, connecting dog owners with trusted local dog lovers.

We’ve recently brought Meta advertising in-house. We spend a significant budget on paid social every month, and we want our creative to work as hard as our budget does.

What it’s like working with us

We’re a fun, supportive and ambitious team where people are encouraged to take initiative and find better ways of doing things.

We’re a small company, so there’s plenty of room to make an impact, take ownership and grow into new responsibilities.

Who we’re looking for

We’re looking for a hands-on Meta Ads Specialist to own our Meta account end to end: running campaigns and budgets, making the ads, and using data to decide what to make next.

This replaces our agency. You’ll be the person who launches, monitors and optimises campaigns, and who turns our large library of in-house and community content into static and short-form video ads, working closely with our small in-house marketing team.

This is a part-time role (1-3 days per week). It could suit a freelancer or someone who wants to add meaningful, flexible work alongside another role, consultancy or portfolio career.

You’ll work in a creative analytics tool (such as AdNova, Motion or Superads), Meta Ads Manager and AI tools, so you’ll need to be both a confident media buyer and a capable ad maker.

What you’ll do:

Run the account

  • Manage our Meta Ads account day to day: campaign structure, audiences, budgets, pacing and bids
  • Launch and test ads at pace in Meta Ads Manager and any bulk-launch tools we use
  • Monitor performance daily and shift budget towards what’s working; pause what isn’t
  • Keep tracking and conversion data healthy (Pixel, Conversions API) and flag issues fast
  • Own channel reporting: a monthly report with clear top 5 takeaways, plus weekly headlines


Make the ads

  • Turn our existing content library into ads: we have lots of organic social, member photos and videos, and UGC. You’ll find the gems and cut them into ready-to-run statics and short-form video
  • Edit and design ads yourself (Canva, Figma, CapCut or similar), including fast iterations of winners: new hooks, captions, crops and formats from the same footage
  • Build the organic-to-paid pipeline: spot our best-performing organic posts and put them to work in paid
  • Refresh creative at least monthly, with a clear testing plan for new hooks, angles and formats
  • Keep a simple content wishlist of the gaps the data shows, so our in-house team and community can fill them, rather than commissioning expensive new shoots


Use the data to decide what’s next

  • Use a creative analytics tool to track hook rate, hold rate, CTR and CPA by concept and iteration, and spot fatigue early
  • Mine ad comments and audience feedback for new angles and objections
  • Use AI tools (e.g. Claude) with our brand guidelines to speed up analysis, copy and ideation, with a sharp eye for what’s actually usable


Ideal attitude

  • Curious and commercial: you always ask why an ad worked, not just whether it did
  • Self-motivated and comfortable working independently (fractional setup)
  • Clear communicator: you turn messy data into a few sharp, actionable points
  • Proactive: you bring ideas and new tools to us without being asked


Time commitment & setup

  • 1-3 days per week (flexible, but you’ll need to check the account briefly on other days)
  • Fully remote (we do have a small office in London, you can go to)
  • Hands-on: you build, launch and optimise, not just advise

Requirements

Essential:

  • 3+ years running Meta Ads accounts hands-on, agency or in-house, for a consumer, subscription or online business
  • Has independently managed £20k+/month in Meta spend, including budgets, structure and testing
  • A portfolio of ads you’ve made yourself (statics and short-form video), especially ads cut from existing or user-generated footage
  • Proven ability to diagnose creative fatigue and decide what to iterate, refresh or retire
  • Data-aware, with a clear grasp of hook rate, hold rate, CTR, CPM, CPA and ROAS, and the attribution limits behind them
  • Clear written communication, including concise reports for non-specialists


Ideally:

  • Hands-on use of a creative analytics or launch platform (e.g. AdNova, Madgicx, Superads, Atria, Motion or Segwise)
  • Confident using AI tools like Claude or ChatGPT for analysis, copy and creative ideation
  • Experience working with UGC creators and community content, and editing raw footage into ads
  • Experience in a marketplace or two-sided platform


Nice to have:

  • TikTok Ads experience (we run a small budget there)
  • Familiarity with Windsor.ai, Metabase or similar reporting tools
  • Motion design or AI video tools for fast iterations

Benefits

  • Competitive day rate
  • A fun and friendly dog-loving team
  • Real ownership of creative in a newly in-housed channel
  • Work with a mission-driven brand and an engaged, dog-loving community

*No recruiters please.

Coalition is the world's first Active Insurance provider designed to help prevent digital risk before it strikes. Founded in 2017, Coalition combines comprehensive insurance coverage and innovative cybersecurity tools to help businesses manage and mitigate potential cyberattacks.

Opportunities to make an impact with bold thinking are real—and happening daily at Coalition.

About the role

In this role, you will be responsible for driving profitable business from an assigned group of brokers and partnering closely with our Sales organization. You will underwrite and manage
products across Coalition’s portfolio while serving as a trusted partner to brokers and customers. Along the way, you will help clients better understand how to protect their
businesses, bringing together underwriting expertise, business acumen and a relationship-first approach.

This is a remote opportunity that can be based anywhere in the Northeast with a strong preference for New York City.

Responsibilities

  • Underwrite new and renewal accounts within authority, while maintaining alignment to underwriting guidelines, risk appetite, and carrier requirements.
  • Build and deepen relationships with cyber specialists and sophisticated P&C placing brokers, becoming a trusted underwriting partner in the market.
  • Maintain disciplined underwriting files, documentation, and internal tool usage in line with Coalition’s workflows and governance standards.
  • Participate directly in broker and client meetings, with responsibility for external presentation, account strategy, and underwriting rationale.
  • Handle more nuanced coverage, structure, and wording discussions, escalating or partnering with CPU and other leaders as needed on non-standard issues.
  • Partner with Coalition’s security team and other internal stakeholders to bring technical and portfolio insight into underwriting decisions and broker/client discussions.
  • Contribute feedback on underwriting guidelines, tools, and process improvements that help Coalition scale high-quality production underwriting.
  • Regular travel required for broker relationship management, client meetings, broker education, and market development activity.

Skills and Qualifications

  • Ability to analyze risks associated with underwriting and pricing decisions using established policies, guidelines, and authority parameters.
  • Strong communication, relationship-building, and marketing skills, with the ability to represent Coalition professionally with brokers and clients.

raw.description:
Posting Description We’re hiring for a Health and Safety Consultant to support our growing Health and Safety team in the Midlands! To keep up with our growth in the UK and Ireland, we are recruiting for a Health and Safety Consultant to join our Health and Safety team. You will be responsible for planning and delivering a variety of health & safety tasks, including audits, inspections, health and safety gap analysis reports, risk assessments and method statements, for our clients across the UK. This role is remote with travel to clients predominantly in the Midlands. This role can be considered on a part time basis. We’re looking for someone with: A full clean UK driving license – our client base is predominately within the Midlands or occasionally further afield Access to their own vehicle, with appropriate business insurance cover A high standard of report and document writing skills Good communication skills, both verbal and written Logical thinking and an outstanding problem-solving ability Good commercial awareness An ability to research and apply advice, based upon the clients’ legal duties Work experience in one or all of the following sectors would be advantageous – Construction Manufacturing Engineering Warehouse/Transport Level 6 Health and Safety qualification is essential - examples include, but are not limited to: NEBOSH Diploma NVQ Level 6 in Occupational Safety & Health Using these skills, you’ll be: Visiting clients and undertaking full health and safety audits and inspections using app based software Handling your own diary, keeping in regular contact with clients, answering health and safety related queries and scheduling meetings Producing health and safety audit reports, identifying areas where improvements are required and advising the client on improvement options moving forward Reviewing the production of policies, risk assessments and method statements (RAMS) Supporting the client with other safety related systems and processes, such as Incident investigation, RIDDOR advice, COSHH documentation and management, workplace transport, asbestos management Acting as the key point of contact (proficient advisor) for the client on any health and safety related matters Assisting clients with the management and attainment of industry accreditations, such as CHAS, Safecontractor or Constructionline We’re committed to creating an inclusive and accessible recruitment process. If you require any reasonable adjustments at any stage of the application or interview process, please let our Talent Team know – we’ll do our best to support you. Please email for more on this. Who is NFP? With over 600 people in the UK and Ireland and over 8,000 employees worldwide, NFP is part of the Aon group and specialise in helping businesses in four core areas: Insurance (helping them manage key risks) Health and safety (supporting them to create a safer workplace for their employees) Employee benefits (helping them reward their people more effectively) HR, people and talent (supporting employers and their people to thrive through changes and challenges) What you’ll love about working here working in a multifaceted, fast-paced organisation in an exciting industry the opportunity to do globally impactful work from day one learning from industry and business line specialists with decades of experience a huge variety of projects to work on and challenges to tackle our People First culture, which illustrates our dedication to your wellbeing and development, not just as an employee but as a human being a rich suite of employee benefits and out-of-work perks #NFPUK 2590147

raw.description:
BUILD YOUR FUTURE WHILE YOU HELP BUILD A BETTER WORLD!

Tremco CPG is an aggressive, growth-oriented company with revenues of over $1 billion. We are a world leader in solving complex waterproofing and roofing problems for our commercial, institutional, and industrial customers.

If you’re looking for a place to build a career, with great benefits, advancement opportunity, technology, people and a commitment to a sustainable future, you’ve found it with us.

Tremco CPG is currently searching for a Sr. Product Manager with extensive metal roofing experience.

The Sr. Product Manager plans, organizes, and controls an assigned product or product line(s) from conceptual stages through product life cycles to optimize profit and meet marketing, financial, and corporate growth objectives by performing the following duties.

Collaborates with a wide variety of functional areas such as sales, engineering, marketing, manufacturing, and operations to develop and provide product definitions responsive to customer needs and market opportunities.

ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:

MARKET INTELLIGENCE

Responsible for the following:

  • Conducting customer interviews and surveys
  • Competitive investigations and analysis
  • Trade organization participation

LIFECYCLE MANAGEMENT

Responsible for the following:

  • Supporting the Sales Team
  • Forecasting
  • Market analysis
  • Warranty extensions

NEW PRODUCT DEVELOPMENT

Responsible for the following:

  • Creating product charters
  • Managing the product development process
  • Orchestrating product launches

STRATEGY DEVELOPMENT

Will be responsible for the following:

  • Product pricing strategies
  • Prioritizing new product initiatives
  • Will be responsible (with guidance) for product portfolio pricing strategies

EXPERIENCE:

  • More than 10 years related experience and/or training
  • Extensive metal roofing experience

OTHER SKILLS AND ABILITIES:

  • Ability to grasp technical details.
  • Proficiency in MS Word, MS Excel and MS PowerPoint. CAD and/or SAP experience is a plus.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities, effective team player, self-motivated, quick learner.
  • Must have interpersonal versatility, well developed business acumen, and highly developed planning, problem solving, negotiating and decision-making skills.
  • Ability to respond to common inquiries or complaints from customers, sales and marketing staff, regulatory agencies, or members of the business community.
  • Exceptional ability to analyze data and discern trends. Ability to think creatively in order to address customer and product issues.
  • Ability to write/edit reports, business correspondence and marketing collateral. Ability to present information and effectively respond to managers, customers and sales / marketing staff.
  • Does require occasional overnight travel. May also be required to visit Tremco plants and/or customer facilities.

The salary range for applicants in this position generally ranges between $110,000 and $130,000. This range is an estimate, based on potential employee qualifications, operations, needs, and other considerations permitted by law.

Benefits:

Tremco offers a variety of benefits to its employees, including not limited to: health insurance, paid holidays, paid time off, 401(k) with company match, Company Pension Plan, Performance Based Commission, and continuing education.

Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to their race, color, religion, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, protected veteran status or disability.
